jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

•          Owning and evolving the brand's creative direction and visual identity across all customer touchpoints.

•          Developing creative concepts and leading the visual execution of campaigns, content and brand experiences.

•          Design and deliver exciting, engaging graphics across web pages, newsletters, logos, signs, advertisements, instore window layouts and other communication materials.

•          Leading art direction for photo, video and content productions while ensuring a consistently high creative standard.

•          Overseeing the visual expression across digital platforms, retail, events and all brand communication.

•          Collaborating closely with Marketing, Ecommerce and other key teams to translate business objectives into compelling creative solutions.

•          Leading selected collaborations, special projects and brand activations that strengthen the brand's visual identity and positioning.

 

Who You Are

•          A confident creative thinker with a strong eye for aesthetics, detail, and visual storytelling.

•          5+ years of experience within the fashion and lifestyle industry, with a scope including execution on design processes, graphic design, and campaign development.

•          Experience with developing visual concepts from idea to final execution.

•          Passionate about fashion, sneakers, culture, and contemporary brand building.

•          Comfortable balancing creativity with ambitious commercial goals and deadlines.

•          Able to work independently while collaborating closely with different teams while translating the creative agenda and vision.

•          Structured, proactive, and able to manage multiple projects at once as we always operate with an ambitious marketing calendar.

•          Strong understanding of digital platforms, social media trends, and content creation.

•          Communicate confidently in English, written and spoken.

•          Have experience from a similar creative, design, or brand-focused role.

About the Marketing & Creative Team

You’ll join our Marketing & Creative Team led by Simon, our Buying & Marketing Director. Together, the team shapes and executes everything from campaigns and launches to shoots, social content, events, and brand collaborations.

What We Offer

•          A fast-moving and creative work environment.

•          A role where your ideas directly shape the NAKED Copenhagen brand.

•          Creative ownership and responsibility from day one.

•          Close collaboration with a passionate team across marketing, e-commerce, retail, and buying.

•          Hands-on involvement in campaigns, launches, collaborations, and brand experiences.

•          A workplace where creativity, energy, and teamwork matter.

•          A job that goes beyond the desk.

Interested?

Please send your CV and application in English or Danish to job@nakedcph.com with “Creative Lead” in the subject line.

We’re looking forward to meeting you.

On behalf of,
Simon, Marketing & Creative Department
& the rest of the NAKED Copenhagen Team

jobs.description:
Heb jij een warm hart en zin om écht iets bij te dragen aan iemands leven? Dan ben jij misschien wie we zoeken!

Bij vzw Op Maat zijn we op zoek naar een persoonlijk assistent die mensen met een beperking ondersteunt in hun dagelijks leven. Dankzij jouw hulp kunnen zij hun leven op hun eigen manier vormgeven.

Wat verwachten we van jou? Geen specifiek diploma vereist. Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar motivatie en een positieve houding tellen het meest. We vragen een warme, respectvolle en flexibele aanpak, afgestemd op de noden van de persoon die je begeleidt.

Wie zijn onze klanten? We bieden persoonlijke assistentie aan mensen met een beperking in West-Vlaanderen — dit kan gaan om een mentale, fysieke, visuele of auditieve beperking, autisme of niet-aangeboren hersenletsel.

Voor een jongedame uit Zedelgem met een meervoudige beperking, die rolstoelgebonden is, zijn we op zoek naar een assistent die haar kan ondersteunen tijdens haar vrije tijd. Ze woont bij haar ouders. Ze is heel creatief en doet aan schilderen, keramiek, ... Daarnaast staan er ook andere activiteiten op het programma, zoals wandelen of een uitstap maken. Op dinsdag ga je samen zwemmen. Ook rijd je af en toe met het minibusje, dus rijervaring hiermee is een pluspunt.

De assistentie vindt plaats op zaterdag, om de twee weken, van 13u30 tot 18u, en op dinsdag van 16u tot 20u.

  • Je werkt graag met mensen en zorgt graag voor anderen.

  • Je kan je inleven in de situatie van de klant.

  • Je kan zelfstandig werken. Je durft twijfels en problemen bespreken met je coach.

  • Je kan je goed mondeling uitdrukken in het Nederlands zodat je vlot kan samenwerken met je klant(en).

jobs.title: Kinesitherapeut
jobs.description:
Wat je gaat doen:

Als kinesitherapeut verzeker je aangepaste kinesitherapeutische zorgen aan de bewoners, teneinde hun capaciteiten en hun autonomie te behouden, te verbeteren en/of te herwinnen.

Uitvoeren van kinesitherapeutische onderzoeken en opstellen van een kinesitherapeutische diagnose, met bijzondere aandacht voor het behoud en de verbetering van de mobiliteit, functionaliteit en zelfredzaamheid van de bewoners.

Behandelen en begeleiden van bewoners volgens de voorschriften van de arts en de individuele zorgdoelstellingen, waarbij de evolutie systematisch wordt opgevolgd en bijgestuurd.

Actief inzetten op het behoud van fysieke functies en het voorkomen van achteruitgang door middel van gerichte activering, mobilisatie en oefentherapie.

Stimuleren en motiveren van bewoners om dagelijks te bewegen en actief deel te nemen aan hun therapie, rekening houdend met hun mogelijkheden en wensen.

Ontwikkelen, organiseren en begeleiden van individuele en collectieve bewegingsactiviteiten die bijdragen aan mobiliteit, spierkracht, evenwicht, conditie en algemeen welzijn.

Een actieve rol opnemen in preventieve zorg, met bijzondere aandacht voor valpreventie, contractuurpreventie, preventie van immobiliteitsgerelateerde complicaties en het bevorderen van een gezonde en actieve levensstijl.

Adviseren en coachen van bewoners en medewerkers inzake ergonomie, lichaamshouding, transfers, positionering en het correct gebruik van hulpmiddelen.

Nauw samenwerken binnen het multidisciplinair team en deelnemen aan overlegmomenten.

Zorgvuldig registreren, rapporteren en administratief opvolgen van uitgevoerde behandelingen en observaties.

  • Je beschikt over een diploma kinesitherapeut.
  • Je beschikt over kennis van hef- en tiltechnieken.
  • Je hebt een voor ouderenzorg.
  • Je beschikt over sociale en luistervaardigheden.
  • Je hebt een basiskennis van diverse ziektebeelden zodat er kan ingegrepen worden in crisissituaties.
  • Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden; je kan duidelijk en objectief communiceren met je leidinggevende, collega’s, onze bewoners en hun familie.
  • Je bent empathisch ingesteld en hebt een luisterend oor voor onze bewoners.
  • Je bent sociaal ingesteld en bent vaardig in het plannen en organiseren.
  • Je hebt respect voor de privacy van onze bewoners en houd je aan het beroepsgeheim.
  • Je kan je aan gemaakte afspraken houden.
  • Je stelt je professioneel op ten aanzien van je leidinggevende, collega’s en bewoners.
  • Je bent stressbestendig en flexibel.

jobs.title: Ravintola- ja tapahtumapalveluiden vuoropäällikkö
jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme pääkaupunkiseudulle kokenutta ravintola- ja tapahtuma-alan ammattilaista vastuulliseen ja monipuoliseen tehtävään.

Kyseessä on kokoaikainen työ, joka alkaa 6 kuukauden määräaikaisella työsuhteella. Tämän jälkeen vakituinen työsuhde on mahdollinen.

Roolissa yhdistyvät käytännön ravintolatyö, tapahtumien toteuttaminen, asiakaspalvelu sekä toiminnan sujuvuudesta huolehtiminen. Työ sopii henkilölle, joka viihtyy vaihtelevassa ympäristössä, ottaa mielellään vastuuta ja pystyy pitämään kokonaisuuden hallussa myös kiireessä.

Taustasi voi olla esimerkiksi ravintolasta, hotellista, tapahtumatalosta tai cateringista. Toivomme, että olet päässyt työskentelemään vaativampien asiakastilaisuuksien ja suurempien tapahtumien parissa sekä ottamaan vastuuta niiden käytännön toteutuksesta.

Arvostamme erityisesti sitä, että:

- tunnet ravintolan arjen ja palveluprosessit käytännössä


- sinulla on kokemusta suurempien tilaisuuksien ja tapahtumien toteuttamisesta


- olet tottunut ottamaan vastuuta vuorosta, tiimistä tai tapahtuman kokonaisuudesta


- ymmärrät hyvän palvelun lisäksi myös myynnin, tehokkuuden ja kannattavan tekemisen merkityksen


- sinulla on varmuutta ruoka- ja juomapalveluista


- pystyt suunnittelemaan, organisoimaan ja viemään asioita käytäntöön


- toimit luontevasti asiakkaiden, henkilöstön ja muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa


Alan koulutus sekä kokemus à la carte-, banketti-, catering- tai tapahtumaravintolatoiminnasta katsotaan eduksi.

Jos tehtävä kuulostaa kiinnostavalta, laita minulle viestiä ja kerro lyhyesti kokemuksestasi sekä palkkatoiveesi.

Etenemme haussa nopeasti.


Bondata Helsinki

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Mobile Platform (iOS)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the iOS platform that helps engineers ship confidently. As Notion’s mobile team grows, we’re turning the first generation of mobile foundations into a durable platform: clearer architecture, ergonomic testing, dependable observability, and faster CI/CD. This role is broad—you’ll shape the iOS stack end to end, from shared frameworks and build systems to release quality, with opportunities to work across our shared Rust layer and AI infrastructure for mobile development. You’ll pair with mobile AI and core product engineers to understand friction, evaluate new iOS capabilities, and decide what should become part of the platform.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Make the iOS platform agent-ready: Give engineers and agents dependable ways to build, run, test, screenshot, and iterate through the app so mobile teams can move faster without lowering the quality bar.

 - By the end of your first year, define how iOS features are built: establish architecture and ship developer tools, then partner with product engineers to adopt them.

 - Raise the bar for iOS reliability and release quality: Improve the systems that catch regressions, prevent incidents, and help engineers understand issues quickly across builds, tests, observability, and CI/CD.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Deep iOS engineering experience at scale: You’ve helped build and deploy mobile applications used by millions, and understand the reliability, performance, and operational practices required at that scale.

 - Platform or infrastructure experience: You’ve worked below the product-feature layer on mobile CI/CD, testing platforms, build systems, developer tooling, or shared frameworks—and can turn recurring friction into durable systems.

 - Strong architectural judgment: You’re familiar with multiple approaches to iOS architecture and can explain the trade-offs clearly, choosing patterns that make features easier to build, test, and maintain.

 - Cross-functional influence: You can partner closely with product engineers, understand their pain points, and earn adoption for new platform APIs, workflows, and standards without relying on authority.

 - AI-native engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective.

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.title: Barne- og ungdomsarbeidarar, vikariat barnehage
jobs.description:
Om stillinga

Vil du vere med og skape ein trygg, leiken og meiningsfull kvardag for barna våre?

I Gulen kommune har vi barnehagar kor omsorg, leik, læring og gode relasjonar står i sentrum. No søkjer vi ein engasjert og varm barne- og ungdomsarbeidar som ynskjer å vere med og gi barna ein trygg start, gode opplevingar og utviklingsmoglegheiter i kvardagen. Hjå oss får du bruke kompetansen din i eit inkluderande arbeidsmiljø, kor samarbeid, nærvær og barnets beste er viktige verdiar. 

Me lyser etter fylgjande, for tida ved eining Dalsøyra barnehage og skule: 

  • I inntil 100% vikariat som barne- og ungdomsarbeidar/eller tilsvarande, frå snarast/etter avtale til medio august 2027. Kan verte moglegheit for noko forlenging av vikariatet. Stillinga er, for tida, knytt til avdeling Hovden barnehage

Barnehagane i Gulen tilbyr
  • Eit sterkt fokus på fagleg utvikling, kor idear og innspel frå både nyutdanna og erfarne medarbeidarar vert verdsett
  • Små og oversiktlege barnehagar som gir nærleik, gode relasjonar og ein trygg start for deg som er ny i yrket
  • Eit godt, varmt og inkluderande arbeidsmiljø
  • Rettleiing og støtte som del av arbeidskvardagen
  • Eit godt fagleg nettverk og tett samarbeid mellom barnehagane i kommunen

Arbeidsoppgåver for ein barne- og ungdomsarbeidar
  • Medverke til at barnehagen er ei god pedagogisk verksemd
  • Medansvar for tilsyn, omsorg og pedagogisk arbeid med barna
  • Delta i planlegging, rettleiing, gjennomføring, evaluering og vurdering i verksemda
  • Nokre av fagarbeidarstillingane i eininga er knytt til arbeid med enkeltborn
  • Andre arbeidsoppgåver som måtte kome til

Kvalifikasjonar 
  • Fagbrev som barne- og ungdomsarbeidar eller tilsvarande kompetanse
  • Dersom det ikkje melder seg kvalifiserte søkjarar med fagbrev/tilsvarande kompetanse, kan andre søkjarar verte vurderte 
  • Erfaring frå arbeid i barnehage eller anna arbeid med barn er ynskjeleg 
  • Evne til å arbeide i tråd med barnehagen sitt samfunnsoppdrag og verdigrunnlag 
  • Grunnleggjande digital kompetanse
  • Gode norskkunnskapar - både munnleg og skriftleg

Det vert stilt krav om tilfredsstillande politiattest før oppstart i stilling


Personlege eigenskapar 
  • Du er ein trygg, tydeleg og omsorgsfull vaksen
  • Du tek initiativ og er aktivt med i leik og kvardagsaktivitetar
  • Du samarbeider godt med barn, føresette og kollegaer
  • Du er fleksibel, ansvarsmedviten og løysingsorientert
  • Personlege eigenskapar vil verte lagde vekt på

Anna 
  • Tenestespråket i Gulen kommune er nynorsk
  • Tilsetjing etter gjeldande lover, føresegner og avtalar
  • For tilsetjing innan pleie og omsorg, miljøteneste, barnevern, i skule, SFO og i barnehage, vert det stilt krav om politiattest etter aktuell/gjeldande lovheimel før oppstart i stillinga. Det skal berre krevjast politiattest av den som får tilbod om stillinga
  • Vi gjer merksam på at søkjarlister med namn, kjønn, alder og noverande stilling er offentleg informasjon. Dersom søkjarar likevel ber om konfidensiell handsaming, og grunnen for å unnta offentleggjering ikkje vert godkjent, får søkjen høve til å trekke søknaden sin før offentleggjering 
  • Løn etter tariff 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Gulen kommune ligg vakkert til ved innløpet til Sognefjorden. Kommunen består av både fjell- og kystlandskap, med 1500 øyer, holmar og skjær, som innbyr til eit aktivt friluftsliv både på land og ved sjøen. Kommunen har 2301 innbyggjarar, ledige barnehageplassar, og er eit godt oppvekstmiljø for barn og unge. Sjå Gulen kommune for meir informasjon.  

I Gulen kommune får meir enn ein jobb - du får vere ein del av eit lokalsamfunn med nærleik, tillit og sterke felleskap. Her arbeidar me saman for å skape gode tenester og ein trygg og attraktiv kommune for alle som bur her. Med vakker natur kring oss, gode moglegheiter for friluftsliv og eit arbeidsliv prega av samarbeid og utvikling, ligg alt til rette for ein meiningsfull arbeidskvardag i Gulen.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer H/F
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will take Alta Ares’ autonomous air-defense systems from the lab to the field, deploying, integrating, testing, troubleshooting and improving them alongside military operators and customers.

You will work at the intersection of Engineering, Product and Operations, across our interceptors, AI guidance, mission-management software, sensors and customer C2 systems.

This is not a traditional support role. You will own technical outcomes in real operational environments, often under time pressure and with incomplete information. You should be equally comfortable writing code, debugging systems, analysing telemetry and working directly with operators on a test range.

Deployment & Field Operations

  • Prepare and execute customer deployments, live-fire exercises, demonstrations and acceptance trials.

  • Deploy and validate Alta Ares systems, including interceptors, AI guidance and Cyclops mission-management capabilities.

  • Configure systems, networks and interfaces and execute test scenarios against defined success criteria.

  • Work directly with military operators, test teams, integrators and partners.

  • Troubleshoot issues rapidly in the field while maintaining safety and mission objectives.

  • Document test results, incidents, lessons learned and follow-up actions.

Systems Integration

  • Integrate Alta Ares systems with sensors, radars, C2 systems, networks and third-party platforms.

  • Develop scripts, configuration tools, APIs and integration components required for deployments.

  • Translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Execute integration and acceptance testing across software, hardware, communications and system performance.

  • Work closely with Software, AI, Embedded, GNC, Hardware and Product teams.

Troubleshooting & Product Improvement

  • Diagnose issues across software, hardware, GNC, sensors, networking, communications, and operator workflows.

  • Use logs, telemetry and test data to identify root causes.

  • Implement safe field workarounds and drive permanent fixes with Engineering.

  • Improve system observability, diagnostics, deployment automation, and reliability.

  • Contribute to hardening systems for GNSS-denied, disconnected, and degraded environments.

  • Turn field experience into concrete product improvements and reusable solutions.

Customer & Technical Interface

  • Build trusted relationships with military operators, engineers, integrators, and program stakeholders.

  • Deliver technical briefings, training, and system onboarding in English and French.

  • Communicate system capabilities, limitations, and technical risks clearly.

  • Represent Alta Ares with technical credibility during high-stakes demonstrations and exercises.

  • Create deployment guides, runbooks, and troubleshooting procedures.


Candidate Profile

  • 3–7 years in software engineering, systems integration, robotics, embedded systems, DevOps/SRE, solutions engineering or a similar hands-on technical role.

  • Strong Python and Linux skills, with good understanding of networking, APIs, logs and distributed systems.

  • Proven experience deploying and debugging complex hardware/software systems outside a controlled development environment.

  • Ability to understand and troubleshoot systems end-to-end.

  • Experience with UAVs, robotics, autonomous systems, AI/ML, sensors or mission-management systems is highly relevant.

  • Defense, aerospace, C-UAS, ISR or other mission-critical experience is a strong plus.

  • Experience working directly with demanding customers or end users in the field is highly valued.

Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on and technically curious, comfortable moving between code, hardware, networks, telemetry, and field operations.

  • Calm and structured under pressure, with strong operational judgment.

  • High ownership and able to solve ambiguous problems independently.

  • Strong communicator who can translate between operators and engineering teams.

  • Pragmatic, balancing speed, performance, safety and maintainability.

  • Comfortable with frequent travel and flexible hours during deployments and exercises.

  • Fluent English required; professional French strongly preferred.

  • High integrity and discretion when handling sensitive defense technologies.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment.

jobs.title: Siivooja terveydenhoitokohteeseen- Parainen
jobs.description:
**Haluatko tehdä työtä, jolla on merkitystä? Oletko asiakaspalveluhenkinen ja pidät siitä, että näet heti oman työsi tulokset?** Meillä Siskon Siivouksella siivoojat ovat puhtauden ammattilaisia – he varmistavat, että asiakkaidemme tilat ovat puhtaat ja turvalliset.

**Haemme nyt siivoojaa terveydenhoitokohteeseen Paraisille**

**Miltä työpäiväsi näyttää?**

Siivoojana vastaat asiakkaan tilojen puhtaudesta ja turvallisuudesta. Noudatat täsmällisesti sovittuja ohjeita ja tehtävälistoja, jotta potilas- ja hoitohuoneet ja odotustilat ovat vaadittujen hygieniatasojen mukaiset / mutta älä huoli – meillä sinut perehdytetään kunnolla ja saat tarvittavan koulutuksen.

Työssä tarvitaan erityistä huolellisuutta ja tarkkuutta, jotta voimme osaltamme taata korkean potilasturvallisuuden. Tarkka työohjeiden noudattaminen sekä asiakaspalvelu tilanteet edellyttävät kommunikointi taitoa suomen kielellä.

**Menestyt työssäsi, jos sinulla on:**

- Kokemusta siivousalalta

- Hyvät organisointi- ja vuorovaikutustaidot

- Positiivinen palveluasenne ja vastuullinen ote työhön

- Kykyä kommunikoida suomeksi, muu kielitaito on plussaa


**Miksi meille?**

Meillä saat vastuuta, mutta et jää yksin. Työyhteisömme on monimuotoinen ja reilu – teemme asiat kerralla kuntoon. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen ja mahdollisuuden kouluttautua lisää. Työssäsi sinua tukee esihenkilö ja tapaat työkavereita säännöllisesti mm. tiimipalavereissa. Käytämme laadukkaita siivousvälineitä ja ympäristöystävällisiä aineita.

**Työ pähkinänkuoressa:**

- **Työn sijainti** Parainen– tarkistathan sijainnin ennen kuin haet työtä

- **Vakituinen työsuhde**

- **Kilpailukykyinen palkka** 12.59 €/h

- **Viikoittainen työaika** 0-37.5 h / viikko. Työtä tehdään tarvittaessa. Huomioithan, että kyseessä ei ole kokoaikainen työ, vaan työtuntien määrä vaihtelee tarjolla olevien työvuorojen ja toiminnan tarpeiden mukaan.

- **Työaika sijoittuu** maanantaista lauantaihin klo 6–7 tai kohteen aukioloaikojen ulkopuolelle

- **Rehti työnantaja** – noudatamme kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos tunnistat itsesi kuvauksesta, älä epäröi – lähetä hakemuksesi ja tule mukaan tekemään työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä. Meillä pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista tiimiä, jossa puhtaus ei ole pelkkää siivoamista – se on turvallisuutta, hyvinvointia ja sujuvaa arkea. Siskon Siivous Oy on hyväntuulinen vuonna 1994 perustettu yritys, jolle on sydämen asia pitää hyvää huolta työntekijöistään sekä tarjota luotettavaa ja laadukasta siivouspalvelua asiakkailleen.

jobs.title: Position(s) as Associate Professor in Accounting
jobs.description:
About the position

Oslo Business School is a relatively new business school (founded in 2014) focusing on teaching quality and excellence in research. The school has currently about 2000 students and 80 employees and offers study programs at Bachelor, Master, and PhD level. The Finance and Accounting group, one of the school’s five sections, is a vibrant and diverse group consisting of researchers that regularly publish in recognized international journals. Oslo Business School is located in downtown Oslo and is part of the Oslo Metropolitan University. The school is currently working on obtaining international accreditations and is strongly focusing on enhancing research output in high quality journals. 

Oslo Business School is expanding and invites applications for 1-2 faculty positions in accounting. The positions are within the Finance and Accounting group, and the person(s) appointed will contribute to Oslo Business School's research and teaching in accounting and auditing and related subjects. The formal recruitment will be at the associate professor level with tenure. Candidates who qualify may be promoted to full professor following their appointment.


Your main duties and areas of responsibility will be
  • teaching and supervision at the Bachelor, Master, and PhD level 
  • active contribution to the development of a high-quality education 
  • initiating and carrying out high quality academic research 
  • contributing to the continued development of the research group in accounting and auditing and the department’s study programmes 
  • academic-administrative tasks 
  • active contribution to the development of Oslo Business School, and OsloMet in general 
  • disseminating research outcomes to the academic community and to the broader society

Qualification requirements

The ranking of qualified applicants is based on scientific merits. Teaching experience, personal qualities and suitability for the position are also important factors. We mainly consider recent publications and the potential for future publications in high-quality journals. The candidates we hire should fit the profile of our bachelor and master programs and must be able to contribute to the school’s long-term academic development. We encourage women to apply.

Applicants must:

  • hold a PhD in accounting or related fields (or be close to completion) 
  • have published in international journals and/or document the potential for quality publications in accounting 
  • have good teaching skills 
  • written and oral proficiency in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish (minimum level B2), and English (Language requirements for employees at OsloMet)

Applicants who do not have adequate proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language, will be offered Norwegian courses, and must acquire Norwegian skills corresponding to at least level B2 within three years of appointment.

The applicant must document relevant educational competence in accordance with OsloMet’s Guidelines for the assessment of educational competence at OsloMet. Applicants who do not possess the required educational qualifications must obtain them within two years of employment.

General criteria for appointments to academic positions are covered by the Regulations for appointment and promotion to academic posts.


It will be an advantage if you have
  • high quality research in recognized international journals
  • experience with research networks and externally funded projects
  • teaching and supervision experience from different degree levels
  • quantitative skills, related to empirical research or teaching
  • proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language
  • capability in communicating and cooperating with students and colleagues
  • a relevant professional credential (such as statsautorisert revisor)
  • ability to teach Norwegian accounting standards (GRS norsk regnskapslov)
  • personal qualities that contribute positively to the working environment

Personal qualities

OsloMet evaluates teaching qualifications in conjunction with interviews. It is important for OsloMet to reflect the population in our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavours to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work, under education or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer
  • engaging professional opportunities at Norway’s third largest university
  • an exciting job opportunity at a new and fast-growing business school in the middle of downtown Oslo 
  • participation in a dynamic professional environment, research groups, and unique academic community
  • a possibility to help map out the direction of a new and growing business school
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • interaction with a diverse student group
  • loan and pension arrangements through the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • beneficial welfare schemes and a wide range of sports and cultural offers
  • free Norwegian language classes to employees 
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMet’s pay policy for Associate Professor in code 1011, corresponding to 708 000 – 923 000 NOK per year. A higher salary may be considered for particularly well-qualified applicants. The salary depends on the qualifications of the applicant. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process and Expert Committee

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.
An expert committee will conduct the assessment of relevant applications. Before the application documents are sent to the expert committee, all applications will be reviewed by the faculty. Applications from unqualified candidates will not be forwarded to the expert committee for assessment. If the number of applications requires it, an internal screening committee at OsloMet will carry out an initial selection of candidates. The selected applicants will then be assessed by the expert committee. 

Please upload the following documents by the application deadline: 

  • application letter 
  • CV, letters of recommendations, and all pages of certificates/diplomas. Foreign education should be pre-approved, and a letter of approval must be attached. Information is available via the following link: Recognition of foreign education - to work in Norway | HK-dir 
  • a list of scientific publications/working papers 
  • up to 5 scientific publications (from the last five years), including your PhD thesis 
  • documentation of educational competence including a profiling document

For applicants who cannot document the required competencies in teaching in higher education have to develop this within two years from accession. OsloMet offers courses in teaching and learning in higher education which covers this requirement.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in English or a Scandinavian language. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered. If you have documents that cannot be uploaded electronically, please contact stale.bie@oslomet.no

jobs.title: Process Engineer - Semiconductor Processes
jobs.description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Process Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. 

At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Process Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. 

The role will have a strong focus on dry etching processes, particularly ICP and RIE, as well as PECVD and metal evaporation. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Process Development & Industrialization 

  • Develop, optimize and stabilize semiconductor fabrication processes, with a primary focus on ICP / RIE dry etching, PECVD deposition and metal evaporation. 
  • Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes. 
  • Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. 
  • Use structured experimentation, including Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate, to understand process sensitivities and optimize performance. 
  • Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. 
  • Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes and production volumes. 

R&D to Production Transfer 

  • Act as a key technical interface between Advanced R&D and Production. 
  • Convert R&D process building blocks into stable, documented and manufacturable processes. 
  • Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transfer to production. 
  • Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. 
  • Lead or contribute to Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical fabrication steps, identifying potential failure modes, their effects on device performance and appropriate prevention and control measures. 
  • Translate PFMEA outcomes into process controls, monitoring plans, acceptance criteria, Control Plans and documentation. 
  • Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training and technical communication. 

Process Control & Yield Improvement 

  • Monitor and improve production process performance, yield and throughput. 
  • Establish regular process checks, controls and monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) where relevant. 
  • Detect process drifts, investigate deviations and define corrective and preventive actions. 
  • Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting activities for yield losses, process excursions and equipment-related issues. 
  • Define and maintain relevant process KPIs and contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives. 
  • Promote best practices that increase process stability, repeatability and equipment utilization. 

Equipment & Production Support 

  • Provide hands-on technical support to cleanroom operators and production teams. 
  • Support equipment qualification, troubleshooting and process recovery following equipment interventions. 
  • Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. 
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. 

Process Characterization & Data Analysis 

  • Characterize the impact of fabrication parameters on material and device performance. 
  • Correlate process data with structural, optical and electrical characterization results. 
  • Use experimental data to identify process sensitivities, failure mechanisms and optimization opportunities. 
  • Develop appropriate data-analysis tools to support process monitoring and engineering decisions. 
  • Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support process development and troubleshooting. 

Documentation & Communication 

  • Create and maintain high-quality process documentation, including process specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), equipment recipes, qualification reports, Control Plans, process-development reports and troubleshooting guides. 
  • Ensure frequent and clear reporting of process status, experimental results, risks and improvement actions. 
  • Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. 
  • Train and support operators and other team members on new or updated processes. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience 

  • Master's degree or PhD in Semiconductor Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic-device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. 
  • Strong knowledge of dry etching, ideally including hands-on experience with ICP-RIE. 
  • Experience with one or more complementary processes such as RIE, PECVD, physical vapor deposition / metal evaporation and lithography. 
  • Strong understanding of how fabrication parameters can influence material properties and device performance. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. 
  • Strong communication and documentation skills. 
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in a semiconductor manufacturing, pilot-line or production environment. 
  • Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. 
  • Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DoE or other structured process-risk and continuous-improvement methodologies. 
  • Experience with optical and electrical characterization of semiconductor or optoelectronic devices. 
  • Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators or VCSEL-type technologies. 
  • Knowledge of Python or other programming languages for process-data analysis, automated reporting, instrument control or experimental automation. 

Profile 

We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new processes where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. 

You should enjoy working directly in the cleanroom, analyzing data, solving complex fabrication problems and collaborating across R&D and production teams. 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

    • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
    • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
    • Use Case / Practical Assessment : The use case will consist of a simple practical exercise focused on the alignment of an optical bench. The assessment will take place in the cleanroom, they are not considered PPE for this exercise.
    • Meeting with the teams
    • 2 reference check
    • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

jobs.title: Fiber Pigtailing Engineer (Master level)
jobs.description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient quantum processing units that scale, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

With a team of more than 140 people, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and quantum algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation using Quandela's cutting-edge quantum dot technology.

Achieving this vision requires not only advances in photonic quantum computing, but also the development of scalable spin-photon interfaces, distributed entanglement capabilities and future SPOQC (Spin-Optical Quantum Computing) architectures that will enable modular and fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About this position:

Join Quandela’s Source Production team to work on the fiber pigtailing of single-photon sources.
The role focuses on developing, improving and operating highly precise fiber coupling methods for photonic quantum devices.

The role is part of the Source Production team, which currently includes 11 people across fabrication, fiber pigtailing and optical characterization. The role is part of the pigtail team, currently composed of one person, and works in close interaction with the fabrication and characterization teams.

The objective is to improve the reliability, reproducibility and productivity of the pigtailing process, from prototype development to production-ready methods.

Key responsibilities

  • Perform high-precision fiber coupling between single-mode fibers and individual micropillars, with alignment precision below 100 nm 
  • Work on fiber preparation and assembly steps, including: 
    • fiber cleaving 
    • fiber gluing 
    • fiber mounting with ferrules and holders 
    • fabrication of structures on fiber tips 
    • anti-reflection coating treatment 
  • Develop and improve methods to evaluate coupling and alignment quality through clear metrics
  • Cool down pigtailed sources and support the validation of the assembled devices
  • Perform optical characterization of quantum emitters using quantum optics techniques, including single-photon detection

About Skeleton

Skeleton Technologies is a global leader in critical power infrastructure for AI data centers and electrical grid stability, founded in 2009. Power today is more than electricity.

It is national security, digital continuity, and economic resilience. Skeleton is the Backbone of Power: equipping AI data centers, electrical grids, defense systems, and critical infrastructure with the resilience to withstand surges, instability, and failure. Our power systems protect GPU clusters from millisecond-level spikes, enable hyperscalers to run at higher rack densities without grid compromise, and make AI data centers up to more 40% energy efficient. jobs.title: Senior Projektleiter (m/w/d)

Du übernimmst die übergreifende Steuerung großer Kundenaccounts mit mehreren parallelen IT- und Softwareentwicklungsprojekten. Dabei verantwortest du Termine, Budgets, Ressourcen, Qualität und Risiken und führst Projektmanager und Projektteams fachlich. 
Dein Fokus liegt auf einer belastbaren, projektübergreifenden Steuerung. Du erkennst Risiken und Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig und greifst gezielt ein, wenn Projekte aus der Spur geraten. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Delivery Management sorgst du dafür, dass komplexe Kundenaccounts erfolgreich gesteuert werden.


Aufgaben

  • Du begleitest die Übergabe neuer Projekte aus dem Vertrieb in die Delivery und schärfst Scope, Erwartungen und Kalkulation. 
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Delivery Excellence Projektmanagement-Standards, Methoden und Best Practices weiter. 


Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer IT-Projekte, Programme oder größerer Kundenaccounts mit mehreren parallelen Projekten 
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Projektcontrolling, Budget- und Forecaststeuerung sowie Risiko- und Eskalationsmanagement

  • Fähigkeit, kritische Projekte schnell zu erfassen, geeignete Maßnahmen einzuleiten und nachhaltig zu stabilisieren

jobs.title: Site Quality Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Site Quality Manager for a construction and installation project.

This is a consulting assignment. The location is Kiruna, Sweden.

The position is full-time.

The assignment involves close collaboration with the client, requiring a high degree of flexibility and strong collaboration skills.

The Assignment

As Site Quality Manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and following up quality management activities at site. The role includes ensuring that quality processes, inspections, documentation, and corrective actions are carried out in accordance with the contract and agreed project procedures.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Establishing and maintaining project-specific Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for site activities and ensuring compliance with contractual requirements.

    

Following up the quality inspection process and ensuring that responsible supervisors and installation teams perform their own inspections and basic inspections according to agreed plans and procedures.

    

Coordinating third-party inspections, including NDT inspections, and ensuring appropriate actions are taken when deviations are identified.

    

Coordinating and arranging inspections together with the client, including witness points and hold points as specified in the contract.

    

Participating in weekly and site meetings and reporting on quality management progress across the different site areas.

    

Using Dalux for documentation management and quality tracking.

    

Organising and following up activities according to the project's daily management model.

    

Identifying and managing deviations and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).

    

Performing root cause analysis and implementing actions to minimise the risk of recurring non-conformities.

    

Preparing and delivering quality documentation and reports to the client as agreed.

    

Ensuring that subcontractors understand and comply with the project's quality management requirements.

    

Introducing and reviewing scope-specific ITPs together with responsible supervisors, foremen, and subcontractors.

    

Managing the handover documentation process and ensuring that required documentation is collected and submitted to the client correctly and on time.

    

Collaborating with the Project Manager and the wider project team regarding quality and risk management.

    

Coaching and supporting site management, installation teams, and subcontractors in quality-related matters.

    

Organising site meetings and reporting on quality activities and progress.

Requirements

We are looking for a candidate with relevant education and professional experience suitable for the role.

You should have relevant experience in areas such as:

    

Quality management and quality follow-up in construction and/or installation projects.

    

Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).

    

Quality inspections and inspection processes.

    

Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and deviation management.

    

Root cause analysis.

    

Third-party inspections and NDT inspections.

    

Witness points and hold points.

    

Quality management and follow-up of subcontractors.

    

Handover documentation and document management.

    

Quality and risk management.

    

Digital quality and documentation management systems, preferably Dalux.

    

Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

You are structured, quality-focused, and communicative, with the ability to coordinate quality activities between several stakeholders. You are comfortable working closely with project management, site teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and the client.

If this assignment sounds interesting and matches your experience, we look forward to receiving your application and CV.

About Us

Centio’s overall goal is to be a consulting company that provides smart and sustainable solutions that contribute positively to the development of society.

We offer our employees individually tailored working conditions. This means that working hours, workload, workplace, and professional development are, as far as possible, adapted to each employee’s individual needs.

Our team consists of dedicated professionals who are passionate about contributing to the development of society. We work in small teams where you have the opportunity to contribute your own experience while also benefiting from the knowledge and expertise of others.

Employee well-being and maintaining a healthy work-life balance are important to us. We therefore have a zero-vision for work-related stress and place well-being and health at the forefront.

You can read more about us at centio.se.

Please submit your CV in Swedish.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Myymälämyyjä, DNA Kauppa Rauma
jobs.description:
Sytytkö tavoitteista ja hyvistä asiakaskohtaamisista? DNA Kaupassa pääset tekemään myyntiä omalla tyylilläsi, oppimaan joka päivä ja näkemään onnistumisesi myös palkassa.

Tässä työssä et jää tiskin taakse odottamaan

Hyvä kauppa ei synny päälle puhumalla. Se on aidon, huolellisen ja asiantuntevan palvelun lopputulos. Kuuntelet, kysyt ja teet asiakkaalle vaikeista asioista helppoja. Et tarvitse valmista myyntiuraa. Tarvitset rohkeutta avata keskustelu, halua oppia ja nälkää onnistua. Me perehdytämme sinut tuotteisiin, palveluihin, järjestelmiin ja DNA:n tapaan palvella.

Työ on aktiivista ja monikanavaista. Päivän aikana kohtaat asiakkaita myymälässä ja autat verkkokaupan asiakkaita chatissa. Kartoitat tarpeen, ehdotat toimivan kokonaisuuden ja varmistat, että asiakas tietää, mitä ostaa ja miksi.

- Myyt DNA:n liittymiä, nettiä, viihdepalveluja, laitteita ja lisätarvikkeita.
- Palvelet asiakkaita kasvokkain myymälässä sekä chat-palvelussa viesteillä ja puhelimitse.
- Otat aktiivisesti kontaktia ja viet asiakaskohtaamisen luontevasti kohti kauppaa.
- Pidät myymälän ilmeen, esillepanot ja arjen perusasiat kunnossa.
- Seuraat tavoitteita, harjoittelet uutta ja sparraat tekemistä tiimin kanssa.
- Työskentelet myymälöiden aukioloaikojen mukaan, myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.

Tämä voi olla sinun paikkasi, jos

- tavoitteet motivoivat sinua ja haluat vaikuttaa omiin ansioihisi
- kohtaat erilaiset ihmiset luontevasti ja uskallat aloittaa keskustelun
- osaat kuunnella, kysyä ja selittää tekniset asiat ymmärrettävästi
- pidät vauhdista ja pystyt toimimaan myös paineen alla
- haluat oppia, pyydät palautetta ja kannat vastuun omasta tekemisestäsi

Tehtävä edellyttää täysi-ikäisyyttä, sujuvaa suomen kieltä ja hyvää englannin kielen taitoa. Valittavalta henkilöltä tarkistetaan luottotiedot. Aikaisempi myyntikokemus on etu, mutta ei vaatimus.

Mitä saat meiltä

- Hyvät eväät onnistumiseen. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen työhösi esihenkilöltä sekä tiimiltä.
- Tunnetun brändin ja laajan valikoiman. Pääset tarjoamaan ratkaisuja liittymistä ja netistä laitteisiin, viihteeseen ja tietoturvaan.
- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä. Opit myyntiä, asiakastyötä ja tavoitteellista työskentelyä. Näistä taidoista on hyötyä pitkälle työelämässä.
- Tilaa onnistua omalla tavallasi. Tavoitteet ovat selkeät, mutta oma persoona saa näkyä asiakaskohtaamisissa.
- Porukan, joka sparraa. Tulosta tehdään yhdessä, onnistumiset huomataan ja apua saa, kun sitä tarvitsee.
- Aidot uramahdollisuudet. Kun osaaminen ja vastuu kasvavat, seuraava askel voi löytyä saman katon alta.

Työsuhteen faktat

- Työsuhde: Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, 30-37,5 h/vko työtilanteen mukaan
- Työpaikka: DNA Kaupassa; lisäksi verkkokaupan chat-myynti
- Aloitus: Sopimuksen mukaan
- Palkka: Pohjapalkka + henkilökohtainen myyntiprovisio. Ansaitset aina vähintään ICT-alan TES:n mukaisen takuupalkan 13,76 €/h. Myyjien keskimääräinen kuukausiansio on tällä hetkellä noin 2 800 €.
- Edut: Koeajan jälkeen saat puhelin-, liikunta- ja työsuhdepyöräedun sekä muut voimassa olevat henkilöstöedut.
- Työnantaja: Barona

Kiinnostuitko? Laita hakemus tulemaan

Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka voidaan täyttää heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Käytämme videohaastattelua osana rekrytointia, joten tarkkaile sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen.

DNA Kaupassa saat olla omanlainen ja tehdä töitä nopeasti, rohkeasti ja mutkattomasti. Jos haluat rakentaa myyntiuraa hyvässä porukassa, nyt on oikea hetki hakea.

Kurkista DNA Kaupan arkeen

Video: työpäivä DNA Kaupan myyjänä. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yyjLyMjJiUs

Video: millaista DNA Kaupassa on töissä? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wT3_2FFAHlU&t=2s

Video: tutustu Baronan DNA-myyjiin. https://www.youtube.com/shorts/LYd_kxEdGGE

Miksi Barona

Barona tarjoaa sinulle vakaan työsuhteen, monipuoliset uramahdollisuudet ja kattavat edut isossa työelämän ratkaisutalossa.

Näin haet

- Kirjaudu sisään tai luo profiili
- Tsekkaa profiilin tiedot kuntoon
- Lisää CV
- Vastaa hakemuskysymyksiin ja lähetä hakemus
- Saat sähköpostiisi erillisen vahvistuksen hakemuksen vastaanottamisesta.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Naantali, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
NAANTALI

Etsimme myyjää Sale Naantaliin ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon!
Tehtävä on vakituinen ja osa-aikainen 10 tuntia viikossa. Tämä tehtävä sopii myös opiskelijalle! Työt olisi tarkoitus aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Salessa myyjän työpäivät koostuvat ihan perustehtävistä, kuten asiakaspalvelusta, kassa- ja hyllytystyöstä, robotilauksien keräilystä sekä myymälän yleisestä järjestelystä ja siivouksesta. Työssä muun muassa varmistat tuotteiden saatavuuden ja tuoreuden sekä sen, että myymälä on asiakkaille houkutteleva. Työskentely on nopeatempoista ja vaatii kykyä hypätä työtehtävästä toiseen. Käytät kaupan järjestelmiä, huolehdit saldojen oikeellisuudesta ja näin vaikutat omalla tekemiselläsi suoraan myyntiin. Seuraat myymälän toimintatapoja ja viestintää, huolehdit turvallisista ja ergonomisista työtavoista sekä osallistut tarvittaessa uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämiseen. Myymälässä työskentely on fyysistä, sillä liikumme päivän aikana paljon, nostamme ja siirrämme tavaraa ja olemme suurimman osan päivästä jaloillamme.

Työhön sisältyy myös hetkiä, jolloin työskentelet vuorossa yksin, joten edellytämmekin sinulta täysi-ikäisyyttä. Työvuorot vaihtelevat arkisin ja viikonloppuisin kello 6.30–22.00 väillä. Varmistathan, että sinulla on mahdollisuus kulkea toimipaikkaan kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina.

Olet saletisti etsimämme myyjä, jos sinulla on reipas ja positiivinen työskentelyote. Haluat olla luomassa onnistunutta asiakaskokemusta ja tervehtiminenkin tulee sinulta luonnostaan. Nautit työskentelystä hektisessä myymäläympäristössä, jossa toimit sovittujen toimintatapojen mukaisesti ja edistät omalla tekemiselläsi yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamista. Olet valmis tarttumaan oma-aloitteisesti erilaisiin työtehtäviin ja pidät tiimityöskentelystä, jossa pääset jakamaan omaa osaamistasi työkavereille sekä auttamaan muita onnistumaan. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa ja työtehtävissä sekä kohtaat paljon ihmisiä päivän aikana. Eduksi katsomme aiemman työkokemuksen vastaavista työtehtävistä, mutta tärkeintä on halu oppia, toimia tehokkaasti ja tavoitteellisesti sekä työskennellä asiakaslähtöisesti.

Myyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen palkkaluokkaan B. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 10,89-14,57 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

jobs.title: Maria söker timvikarier till sitt stjärnteam av assistenter, är det du?
jobs.description:
Vårt mål är att ha de mest nöjda kunderna samt de mest stoltaste medarbetarna i branschen. Visionen för AssistansExperten är att vara den självklara utföraren av personlig assistans för kunder, anhöriga, medarbetare och beställare med höga kvalitetskrav. Vi är en trygg personlig assistansanordnare som lägger stort hjärta i det vi gör. Vi har den nära kontakten från ett litet bolag och den stora kunskapen från ett stort bolag. Hos oss är du inte en i mängden utan en viktig kugge i vårt dagliga arbete. Vi är måna om vår personal som är ryggraden i vår verksamhet, hos oss får du möjligheterna. att utvecklas i din roll.AssistansExperten´s värdegrund bygger på kompetens, engagemang och värme. Genom hög kompetens säkerställs att varje insats håller hög kvalitet och anpassas efter individens behov. Med genuint engagemang arbetar vi nära våra kunder för att skapa trygghet och delaktighet. Vår värme genomsyrar allt vi gör- vi bemöter varje person med respekt, omtanke och ett stort hjärta. Tillsammans skapar dessa värden en grund för en trygg och meningsfull assistans.

Vi på AssistansExperten söker nu en trygg och erfaren personlig assistent som vill jobba hos vår 17-åriga kund.

Kunden är en glad och social tjej som är 17 år gammal. Hon har nära till bus och skratt och vill nu hitta en ny engagerad och trygg personlig assistent till sitt team som kan hjälpa henne leva ett aktivt och så självständigt liv som möjligt. Hon har en CP-skada, epilepsi och intellektuell funktionsnedsättning och behöver hjälp med det mesta i sin vardag. Du kommer att finnas i hennes närvaro hela tiden för att hon ska kunna få ett väl fungerande liv och må bra och därför är det viktigt att ni trivs bra tillsammans.

Kunden behöver hjälp med allt i vardagen, till exempel vid matsituationer, träning, personlig hygien och vid sina fritidsintressen. På fritiden tycker honom att gå ut på promenader, gunga, springa med sin Race Runner, bygga med lego, lyssna på musik, sjunga, rida, bowla och åka och bada.

Tjejen bor i en villa i Västerås med sin familj så din arbetsplats kommer framförallt att vara hemma hos henne men ni kommer även att åka ut på olika äventyr tillsammans och assistansen sker därför där hon befinner sig. Kunden har beslut på dubbelbemanning vissa delar under dygnet vilket betyder att du ofta kommer att arbeta tillsammans med en kollega.

Kunden har inget eget talat språk men kommunicerar med sin omgivning på en massa olika sätt, bland annat genom kroppsspråk, tecken som stöd och bilder. Som assistent behöver du vara nyfiken och ha en vilja att lära hennes sätt att kommunicera så att i kan förstå varandra på bästa sätt.

Ni kommer att hänga ihop i vått och torrt och vi kommer att utveckla en nära relation till varandra. Därför är det viktigt att personkemin stämmer och att ni trivs ihop. Kunden tycker bäst om att leka och busa med tjejer, så vi ser gärna att du som söker är tjej.

Teamet runt kunden

Du får ett härligt gäng av kollegor som är en sammansvetsad grupp. I teamet sätter vi lojalitet, engagemang, ansvar, delaktighet och glädje som viktiga egenskaper för att passa in och kunna göra ett bra jobb.

För denna tjänst krävs det att du:

    Ser detta uppdrag som långsiktigt
    Är rökfri
    Är simkunnig
    Tycker om lek & bus
    Är lugn, trygg, tålmodig och inkännande
    Har hög ansvarskänsla och är flexibel
    Är en pigg och driven person
    Är arbetsvillig och lojal
    Behärskar det svenska språket obehindrat i tal och skrift
    Erfarenhet av CP-skada & epilepsi är meriterande
    Det är önskvärt att du har körkort
    Stor vikt kommer att läggas på personlig lämplighet

Anställningsform: Timvikarie

Arbetstider: Dag, kväll, helg. Det kan även vara aktuellt med vaken nattjänstgöring så småningom.

Lön: Fast timlön enligt överenskommelse. Övriga ersättningar enligt kollektivavtal.

jobs.title: Laboratory Test Engineer
jobs.description:
For our client we are looking for a Laboratory Test Engineer to strengthen the project engineering team on automation and protection testing including real time simulations. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power systems, testing and real time simulations. The role focuses on designing and implementing automation, protection and secondary injection tests according to customer specifications. Ideally, the candidate has a vision on how to productize simulation and testing offering. 

You will be mainly accountable for:
· Designing and implementing automation and protection testing including hardware-in-the-loop testing for power systems according to customer specifications
· Leading customer approvals and factory testing of distribution protection relays
· Maintaining the customer approval test laboratory in Vaasa
· Productizing the simulation and test offering

Qualifications For The Role:
· A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in electrical or electrical power system engineering or equivalent
· Several years of experience working with power systems and prior experience with electrical installations or a commissioning background
· Prior experience of leading customer approvals or FATs (Factory Acceptance Testing)
· Experience with real time simulators such as RTDS, Typhoon Hil or Opal RT and relay test devices and amplifiers such as Omicron
· Experience with PSCAD or a similar software is seen as a strong benefit
· Good communication and presentation skills, including fluency in English (written and spoken), Finnish and Swedish language skills are seen as benefits

jobs.description:
Etsimme kokeneita hitsaajia ja teollisuusputkiasentajia suureen teollisuusprojektiin Kotkaan.

Työ tehdään suuressa teollisuuskohteessa, ja tehtävä edellyttää vahvaa ammattitaitoa, merkittävää käytännön työkokemusta sekä kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti.

Työtehtäviin kuuluvat:

– teollisuusputkistojen ja metallirakenteiden hitsaus – teollisuusputkistojen asennus ja kokoonpano – putkien, osien ja metallikomponenttien valmistelu asennusta ja hitsausta varten – putkistojärjestelmien osien asennus ja liittäminen – työskentely teknisten ja isometristen piirustusten mukaisesti – muut teollisuusputkistojen asennukseen ja hitsaukseen välittömästi liittyvät ammattityöt.

Hakijalta edellytämme:

– merkittävää käytännön työkokemusta hitsaajana tai teollisuusputkiasentajana – tehtävään soveltuvaa ja osoitettavissa olevaa ammattitaitoa – kokemusta työskentelystä teollisuuskohteissa – kykyä lukea teknisiä ja isometrisiä piirustuksia – kykyä suorittaa ammattialan työtehtäviä itsenäisesti – vastuullista työotetta ja työturvallisuusmääräysten noudattamista.

Hitsaajilta edellytetään työtehtävissä tarvittavien hitsausmenetelmien hallintaa. Mikäli työtehtävät edellyttävät voimassa olevia hitsauspätevyyksiä tai muita pätevyyksiä, hakijalla tulee olla kyseiseen työhön soveltuvat voimassa olevat pätevyydet.

Alan ammatillinen koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta se voidaan korvata riittävällä ja osoitettavissa olevalla käytännön työkokemuksella.

Hakijoiden työkokemus ja ilmoitettu ammattitaito tarkistetaan rekrytointiprosessin aikana. Hakijan tulee tarvittaessa olla valmis osoittamaan ammattitaitonsa haastattelussa ja/tai käytännön ammattitaitotestissä.

Tehtävään huomioidaan hakijat, joilla on riittävä työkokemus ja ammattitaito edellä kuvattujen työtehtävien itsenäiseen suorittamiseen.

jobs.title: Liker du å levere førsteklasses service og bidra til en trivelig atmosfære? Bli vår nye renholdsmedarbeider i Kongsberg!
jobs.description:
Vi søker en ny kollega til tilkallingsvikariat til vårt team i Kongsberg!

Hos ISS handler det ikke bare om renhold. Hver dag jobber vi for å skape gode serviceopplevelser og bidra til en bedre hverdag for kundene våre.

Om stillingen og teamet

Som renholder i kundenes lokaler vil du ha ansvar for rengjøring og desinfisering av ulike områder, i henhold til fastsatte planer og omfang. Arbeidet innebærer renhold av kontorer, fellesområder, kaffekjøkken, toaletter og øvrige deler av lokalene.

På lokasjonen jobber du sammen med flere kollegaer og blir en del av et sosialt, mangfoldig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø. Teamet er preget av godt samarbeid og høyt tempo.

Stillingen innebærer følgende arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Utføre daglig renhold hos kunden.
  • Bruk av renholdsmaskiner og manuelt utstyr.
  • Følge renholdsplaner, rutiner og kvalitetskrav.
  • Bidra til gode serviceopplevelser.

Arbeidstid: Mandag til fredag, i tidsrommet 06:00-14:00.

Gode grunner til å velge oss

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser: Vi tilbyr lønn etter tariff, samt gode betingelser og forsikringsordning. 
  • Grundig opplæring: Du får opplæring sammen med en erfaren renholder og tilgang til e-læringskurs.
  • HMS i fokus: Vi verdsetter våre servicehelter og prioriterer HMS høyt for å sikre en trygg og god arbeidshverdag.
  • Anerkjennelse: Hver måned feirer og løfter vi servicemedarbeidere som har utmerket seg spesielt – og hvert år kårer vi en nasjonal og global vinner!
  • Utviklingsmuligheter: Har du har ambisjoner om å ta fagbrevet som renholdsoperatør, ønsker vi å legge til rette for dette. I tillegg tilbyr ISS Akademiet over 150 klasseroms- og nettkurs innen flere fagområder, som gir gode muligheter for videreutvikling og andre karrieremuligheter i ISS.

Hvem vi ser etter?

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Noe erfaring fra renhold eller servicebransjen.
  • Er serviceinnstilt, fleksibel og pålitelig.
  • Trives med selvstendig arbeid og samarbeid.
  • Har en positiv og lærevillig innstilling og jobber nøyaktig.
  • Møter kollegaer og kunder på en positiv og profesjonell måte.
  • Ønskelig med gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk eller engelsk.

 

Vi ønsker snarlig oppstart og vurderer kandidater fortløpende.  

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

 


Hos oss er det enkelt å søke – last opp din CV, svar på noen spørsmål, og du er registrert. Vi ønsker deg lykke til!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

ISS Facility Services er en del av et globalt fellesskap innen Facility Management. I Norge er vi markedsleder og en positiv pådriver for å utvikle bransjen videre. Vi hjelper kunder med renhold, restaurant- og kantinedrift, eiendomsdrift og kontorstøtte – enten som enkeltstående tjenester eller som smarte, integrerte løsninger som gjør hverdagen enklere. Hver dag jobber vi for å skape bedre steder å være – der mennesker møtes, lærer, samarbeider og får påfyll. Folkene våre er hjertet i alt vi gjør. Sammen med kunder og leverandører tar vi samfunnsansvar på alvor og bruker posisjonen vår til å gjøre en forskjell for mennesker, samfunn og miljø. Mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Med kolleger fra over 120 nasjonaliteter er ISS en inkluderende arbeidsplass og en viktig døråpner for integrering – det er vi stolte av! I dag er ISS Facility Services blant Norges største private arbeidsgivere, med over 7 000 medarbeidere og en årlig omsetning på mer enn fem milliarder kroner.

jobs.title: Health, Safety & Environmental Lead
jobs.description:
Gemkom Engineering and Machinery Filial is a newly established branch of the Turkish company Gemkom. It is a leading engineering and manufacturing company that operates in a number of areas and in various ways within the steel industry.

We will participate in a project where Stegra  (H2 Green Steel) establishes a steel mill in Norra Svartbyn in Boden, where steel will be produced through an almost fossil-free process using hydrogen gas. Our mission is, among other things, to install machines used in steel production and includes work in mechanics, electronics and plumbing.

We now want to employ a Health, Safety & Environmental Lead. The work tasks may include but are not limited to:

JOB DESCRIPTION

The HSE Lead will support the HSE Manager in the implementation and coordination of Health, Safety and Environmental requirements across the project and provide day-to-day leadership and coordination to the site HSE team.

Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate and supervise the daily activities of HSE Officers and site HSE personnel.

- Monitor site activities and ensure compliance with project HSE requirements, procedures and applicable regulations.

- Conduct and coordinate site inspections, safety walks and follow-up of identified corrective actions.

- Support the review and implementation of Risk Assessments, Method Statements (RAMS), Permit to Work (PTW) and other HSE documentation.

- Provide practical HSE guidance and support to construction management, engineers, supervisors, foremen and subcontractors.

- Monitor high-risk construction activities including lifting operations, work at height, confined space, hot work and other critical activities.

- Lead or support incident and near-miss investigations and follow up corrective and preventive actions.

- Coordinate toolbox talks, HSE inductions, awareness activities and other site safety training.

- Support HSE audits, inspections, reporting, statistics and performance monitoring.

- Participate in emergency preparedness activities and drills.

- Promote a proactive safety culture and intervene when unsafe conditions or practices are identified.

- Report significant HSE risks, observations and site issues to the HSE Manager and support continuous improvement of project HSE performance.

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- University degree in Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety or a related technical field.

- Minimum 7 years of relevant HSE experience, preferably in construction, industrial, energy, oil & gas or similar major projects.

- Previous experience in a Senior HSE, HSE Lead, HSE Chief, HSE Supervisor or HSE Management role.

- Strong practical knowledge of construction HSE, risk assessment, RAMS, PTW, incident investigation and site inspections.

- Experience supervising HSE personnel and working with subcontractors and construction teams.

- NEBOSH IGC or equivalent internationally recognized HSE qualification is preferred.

- Ability to communicate in English in a construction site environment.

- Strong site coordination, leadership and interpersonal skills.

- Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

- Experience in international and multicultural project environments is preferred.

- Knowledge of Swedish construction HSE requirements and/or BAS-P/BAS-U is considered an advantage.

- Willingness and ability to be based in Boden, Sweden for the project duration.

FRIT VALG - SVANE PLEJE ApS

Drømmer du om en hverdag der er præget af nærvær og samarbejde? Og er du en natteravn, der med sit store overblik og fødder solidt plantet på jorden kan skabe ro og tryghed for vores borgere som udekørende personale til hjemmeplejen? Så søger vi dig.

Det är bra att man gillar att laga mat och är intresserad av produkterna vi säljer.
