jobs.title: Associate Professor (100 %, three years) in snow science / snow avalanches
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

We are seeking a three-year fixed-term Associate Professor with a focus on snow science at the Department of Geosciences at The Faculty of Science and Technology, UiT the Arctic University of Norway. The position is attached to the Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards scientific group.

Tromsø is a vibrant Arctic city surrounded by dramatic mountains, fjords and accessible wilderness — an exceptional living laboratory for snow and mountain research. The region offers year-round opportunities for fieldwork, easy access to skiing and mountaineering, and outstanding nature experiences (midnight sun in summer, northern lights in winter). We value work-life balance and outdoor culture here, which many researchers find inspiring for both research and personal life.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position in Tromsø within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The department

The Department of Geosciences has currently 16 permanent scientific staff positions, 21 post-doctoral fellows and researchers, 24 PhD students and 15 technical/administrative positions. The Department includes three scientific groups: (1) Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards group, (2) Sedimentary Systems, Paleoclimates and Environments group, and (3) Geophysics, Glaciology and Oceanography group. It also hosts the Centre of Excellence iC3: Centre for ice, Cryosphere, Carbon and Climate . The Department is also a member of iEarth - Centre for Integrated Earth Science Education. We offer courses at all levels from bachelor to PhD studies and hosts approximately 150 students.

Over the last decade, the department has strategically built up expertise and research and education activities in geohazards. Geohazards is now a key focus area for the department, with established networks, ongoing projects and ambitions to further expand capabilities in snow science, avalanches and related processes. Earlier work has focused on rock slopes, slush flows, wet snow avalanches, climate adaptation and hazard/runout modelling. We would like to develop this research direction. The position benefits from active connections to the Department of Physics and Technology, Department of Technology and Safety and the Center for Avalanche Research and Education (CARE), and interdisciplinary research is encouraged to strengthen UiT’s position as a driver of Arctic knowledge, such as incorporating elements of psychology, preparedness and climate research.


The position’s field of research/field of work

The successful candidate is expected to:

  • Conduct high-quality research that strengthens UiT’s snow science portfolio within the snow science and geohazards thematic area. Research may also be interdisciplinary, and a connection with CARE and other UiT institutes is encouraged.
  • Teach undergraduate and advanced graduate courses, as well as participate in teaching of the field courses organized by the scientific group. The successful candidate will be expected to fulfil basic pedagogical competence within two years.
  • Supervise students at all levels, including MSc and PhD students.
  • Build external networks and represent the department at meetings, conferences and community outreach events.
  • Respond to media enquiries within your field.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to secure external funding and contribute to establishing permanent snow science capability at UiT.

It is expected that the participant will participate in disseminating research to a wider public. 


Contact

Further information about the position and UiT is available by contacting

Associate Professor Louise Daines-Vick, phone + 47 90 47 30 83, email: louise.m.vick@uit.no

Professor/Head of Department (interim) Anders Schomacker, phone + 47 95 52 34 64, email: anders.schomacker@uit.no


Qualifications

For this three-year fixed-term position as Associate Professor with a focus on snow science the applicants

  • must have a PhD in geosciences, physics, mathematics or a closely related field and a documented publication record in snow science and/or related geohazards. 
  • must have experience in, and a strong dedication to, field-based research and navigating snowy terrain. A track record or commitment to acquisition of external funding is desired.  The research should complement the existing research strengths within the fields of the Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards scientific group, which includes the field of geohazards. 
  • must have an ability to communicate effectively in English. 
  • documented pedagogical competence. All applicants for teaching and research positions shall document their pedagogical competence. You must have acquired basic competence for teaching and supervision at higher education level. This includes basic skills in planning, conducting, evaluating and developing teaching and guidance. Those who do not meet the requirements for pedagogical competence upon employment will be required to meet them within two years.
  • Norwegian language skills: The position requires proficiency in a Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). New employees who do not fulfill the language criteria by appointment are required, within three years, to demonstrate sufficient proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Arrangements will be made to facilitate the completion of Norwegian courses.
  • personal suitability: Our working culture is important to us. We will emphasize the applicants motivation for the position and personal suitability. We are looking for candidates who display the following:
    • Collegial team player, ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff and contribute to a good working environment.
    • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
    • Interest in strategy and strategic development of the department.
    • Good communication skills and ability to engage with academic, stakeholder and public audiences.

The applicants should have expertise in one or several aspects of snow avalanches and geohazards. Research approaches may include, for example, remote sensing, numerical and physical modelling, laboratory experiments, and field measurements on snow, slush, debris, or mixed materials. 

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Pedagogical competence

All applicants for teaching and research positions must document their educational competence in their application.

Those who do not meet the requirements for pedagogical competence upon employment will be required to meet them within two years. UiT offers courses in educational competence to employees.

You must have acquired basic competence for teaching and supervision at university and college level.This entails basic skills in planning, implementing, evaluating and developing teaching and supervision. 

See how to document educational competence: About the pedagogical portfolio - Result  (English guide at the bottom of the page)


We offer
  • A stimulating international research environment within the geohazards theme and opportunities for collaboration across UiT.
  • Support for career development, supervision of students and external funding applications
  • Access to university research infrastructure, administrative and technical support, and professional development (mentoring, courses and workshops)
  • You will join a thriving geosciences environment with active projects, a strong student cohort and close interdisciplinary collaboration. You will have access to relevant laboratory and field equipment, opportunities to participate in and lead field campaigns, and support for outreach and stakeholder engagement
  • Allocated funds to support your research, travel and equipment needs
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Good arrangements for pension, insurance and loans in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Access to the department cabin Heiahytta for a reasonable rental fee
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.


Work- and salary conditions 

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

The allocation of working hours is flexible and allocated on a case-by-case basis. In general, Associate Professors will spend an equal amount of time on teaching and research and development work after time spent on other duties has been deducted. As a norm, the time resources spent on administrative duties constitutes 5 % for academic staff. 

The remuneration for Associate Professor is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1011, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 700000,-  to 900000,- in a 100 % position. In special cases, a higher salary may be considered. 

As a state employee, you have one of the best pension schemes available. For more information see: spk.no.


Application

The application must include: 

  • Cover letter including a short description of interests and reasons for applying for the position  
  • CV containing a complete overview of education, experience and professional work 
  • Diplomas, diploma supplements and transcripts (all degrees, in original language and translated) 
  • Letter(s) of recommendation if applicable
  • Two references with contact details 
  • Documented pedagogical competence. Brief description of teaching philosophy/documentation of educational competence in the form of a pedagogical map or course certificate of completed university pedagogical basic competence such as UNIPED 100 at UiT or equivalent from other universities 
  • A list of your academic production 
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important 
  • Academic works, up to ten. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work. 
  • Documentation of English proficiency.  

Proficiency in the English language can be documented in the following ways: 

  • Diploma from a Norwegian upper secondary school with both spoken and written English (140 hours) 
  • TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) 
  • IELTS (International English Testing Service) 
  • Completed university degree in the field of English language or literature 
  • One year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or USA, for which English was the language of instructions. 

Documentation has to be in English or a Scandinavian language. The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications on the basis of the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description drawn up for the position.

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview shall among other things, aim to clarify the applicants personal suitability for the position and motivations. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment.

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility

​According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilizeour location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future.
 

UiT has approximately18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. Our largest campuses are Tromsø, Alta ,Narvik, and Harstad. UiT has seven faculties, 40 departments and centers, and leading research environments in various fields. The university offers 269 study programs and focuses on educational quality.

Academic freedom, scientific principles, and research ethics form the foundation of all UiT'sactivities. Participation, co-determination,
transparency, and sound processes will provide the basis for making wise and forward-looking decisions. Our students and staff will have the opportunity to develop their abilities and potential. Rooted in scientific integrity, we aim to be bold, engaged, and generous -closely connected to academia, people, and contemporary developments

See: UiTs strategi mot 2030

jobs.title: Montage og varemodtagelse
jobs.description:
For vores kunde i Syddjurs Kommune søger Randstad en grundig og lærelysten medarbejder til varemodtagelse, elektronikmontage og test. Du vil få en varieret hverdag, som er opdelt mellem varemodtagelsen og montage. 

Der vil være tale om et Try & Hire-forløb på 13 uger med henblik på fastansættelse efterfølgende.

¤din dagligdag: 

Halvdelen af tiden arbejder du i varemodtagelsen, hvor du modtager og udpakker varer samt udfører kvalitetssikring. Den anden halvdel af tiden hjælper du i produktionen med samling af elektronikemner (box build), påsætning af labels samt test af de samlede bokse.

I varemodtagelsen bliver du en del af et team med to engagerede kolleger, der står klar til at hjælpe dig godt i gang.

Vi forventer ikke, at du har erfaring med de specifikke opgaver i dag. Det vigtigste er din personlighed, din nysgerrighed og din lyst til at lære vores procedurer at kende.  

¤arbejdsopgaver:

  • Modtagelse, udpakning og kvalitetssikring af indkomne varer

  • Kontrol af varer 

  • Box build 

  • Påsætning af labels på produkter

  • Test af samlede bokse

¤din profil:

  • Du har gerne en baggrund fra lager

  • Du er struktureret, grundig og detaljeorienteret 

  • Du er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære nye arbejdsprocesser

jobs.title: Software PhD Position at Antaros Medical
jobs.description:
Automated Image Analysis for Advanced Metabolic Phenotyping in Obesity and Diabetes

About the Project:

You will join PREFERENCE, an international Marie Skłodowska-Curie doctoral network dedicated to advancing large axial field of view (LAFOV) PET/CT imaging. PREFERENCE brings together 12 academic institutions and several industrial partners with extensive expertise in quantitative imaging, image analysis and imaging technology.

A highly innovative system, called long axial field of view (LAFOV) PET/CT, has become available and is the ideal medical imaging modality to study diseases and molecular processes at the whole body/systems biology level with multiple radiotracers. Studying diseases and diagnosing patients using PET/CT imaging should use a whole body/systems biology approach, i.e., a comprehensive whole-body characterization of disease, and it should be longitudinal and should use multiple radiotracers. However, LAFOV PET/CT is so new that we lack the necessary tools, methodologies, imaging procedures and skilled scientists to effectively address key applications in patient care and research. With the PREFERENCE project we aim to develop innovative LAFOV PET/CT methodologies to perform and support ground-breaking new clinical research.

PREFERENCE will train the next generation of researchers specialized in LAFOV PET/CT who will capitalize on the new clinical and research opportunities of the LAFOV PET/CT system. By performing research in both academia and industrial groups, researchers within PREFERENCE receive training in a unique combination of (soft) skills across disciplines and sectors. PREFERENCE will develop new LAFOV PET/CT methodologies and perform LAFOV PET/CT clinical studies across disease areas to obtain novel biological insights. This project was selected by the EU as worthy of funding under the H2025 Marie Sklodowska Curie awards. The consortium consists of 12 academic partners with a strong expertise in quantitative (LAFOV) PET/CT imaging as well as industrial partners developing imaging equipment or providing multi-center image analysis solutions and services.

About the PhD Position:

This is a 4-year full time position as an early stage researcher (ESR) under the auspice of the MSCA DN programme. The successful candidate will have a software background and interest in medical imaging. The candidate will develop tools for accurate analysis of whole-body metabolic imaging, including insulin sensitivity and perfusion assessment and develop spatial correlation tools for visual and quantitative comparisons. The candidate will then apply this to clinical trial data to aid in understanding the multiplexed data and characterise groups with and without metabolic disease, as well as study differences in end organ involvement between sexes, disease states, and other parameters. The aim is to achieve advanced metabolic phenotyping in obesity and diabetes to improve understanding the relationship to mechanisms in relation to end organ damage.

Within the course of this project, there will be 1-month secondments to PREFERENCE partners Aarhus, Copenhagen and Vienna for subprojects and data and software exchange facilitation.

You will receive a monthly gross allowance starting at €2900 - €3100, with an annual increase throughout the programme. The allowance is based on criteria set by the PREFERENCE programme and adjusted with a country-specific correction factor. If applicable, fellows may also be eligible for an additional family allowance of €300 - €360 per month.

Requirements and Qualifications:

To meet the entry requirements for doctoral studies, you must have:

    

Successfully completed studies in Physics, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science or alike (MSc degree or equivalent)

    

Very good command of the English language

    

Good communication skills (a pre-requisite for cooperating in a multi-disciplinary environment)

    

Willingness to travel and flexibility to arrange that in predetermined time

    

Proficiency in Python for medical image analysis will be of benefit, and proficiency in C/C++ or similar for efficient management of large images will be of benefit

    

Prior experience with medical imaging, CT, PET, MRI, image analysis, and software development will be of benefit.

Note: Important strict eligibility criteria according to MARIE SKLODOWSKA CURIE programs:

    

The successful candidate must not already hold a doctoral degree.

    

The successful candidate may not have resided in Sweden for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to the recruitment date (and not have carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in the country).

    

Candidates from Russia, Belarus and occupied territories in Ukraine are not eligible.

Recruitment process:

After assessing compliance with the mobility rule and eligibility for the position based on your Europass CV, motivation letter, and answer to mandatory questions, the selection of the candidates and invitation for the interviews will be done by Antaros. The recruitment process will include online interviews with key stakeholders from Antaros Medical, an international scientific mentor from the network, and a business coach.

As part of the recruitment process, your application will be shared with the PREFERENCE project coordinator for the purpose of verifying eligibility criteria, centralized coordination, and registration of the recruitment process.

You application may also be shared with supervisors at other partner institutions and organisations to assess suitability for similar doctoral positions within the network. Such sharing will only take place in accordance with applicable data protection legislation and the candidate's consent.

Applications should be submitted online by 18 October 2026.

In case of any questions regarding the PhD project, please contact: joel.kullberg@antarosmedical.com

In case of any procedural questions, please contact the coordinator: preference@amsterdamumc.nl

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja kotihoitoon

ETSIMME OULUN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON VIIKONLOPPUIHIN

Kotihoito tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tehdä yksilöllistä ja merkityksellistä työtä, jossa asiakkaan hyvinvointi ja elämänlaatu ovat keskiössä. Etsimme nyt Oulun alueelle lähihoitajaa tai loppuvaiheen opiskelijaa kotihoitoon osa-aikaiseen työhön. Pääset aloittamaan työn heti tai sopimuksen mukaan.

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden työskennellä omalla tavallasi, asiakasta kunnioittaen

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

jobs.title: Sektionschefer till SHIS Bostäder
jobs.description:
Välkommen till oss

SHIS Bostäder är Stockholm stads bostadssociala resurs. Vårt uppdrag är att erbjuda trygga

genomgångsboenden för etablerade och nyanlända stockholmare som av sociala eller ekonomiska skäl befinner sig utanför den ordinarie bostadsmarknaden. På SHIS bor hyresgäster under en begränsad tid och vårt uppdrag är att vägleda hyresgästerna i att komma vidare till ett eget bostadskontrakt. SHIS har ca 220 engagerade medarbetare, tillsammans arbetar vi med ett 40-tal fastigheter med ca 3700 lägenheter som vi bedriver verksamhet i där vi stöttar ett stort antal hyresgäster varje år.

Motiveras du av att stötta människor på vägen till eget boende och vill vara en del av vår fortsatta utvecklingsresa? Då kan vi erbjuda en spännande utmaning i ett företag som gör skillnad! Vi söker nu dig som vill bli sektionschef på SHIS Bostäder. Välkommen att läsa mer om uppdraget.

Vi erbjuder

SHIS erbjuder ett utvecklande och fritt arbete där du har möjlighet att påverka och utveckla verksamheten i ett viktigt bostadssocialt uppdrag. Hos oss har vi en välkomnande kultur och en trevlig arbetsmiljö. Du ingår i en kompetent ledningsgrupp där vi samarbetar och utbyter erfarenheter.

Din roll

Som sektionschef har du personal-, budget – och verksamhetsansvar för din sektion. Du leder bostadsvägledare, boendestödjare, fastighetsvärdar och lokalvårdare. Som sektionschef ansvarar du för flera fastigheter på olika platser i Stockholms stad, totalt ca 15–20 medarbetare. Rollen innebär att du behöver kunna röra dig mellan och besöka/ jobba i fastigheterna inom hela sektionen.

Du arbetar nära och coachande med dina medarbetare för att ge dem förutsättningar att arbeta stöttande med sina hyresgäster. Du följer upp, skapar tydlighet i uppdraget och våra arbetsprocesser.

Vi har stort fokus på utveckling av det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet, rutiner kring våra nya verksamhetssystem och andra system som är nya för vår verksamhet. Du kommer vara en viktig del i att det arbetet fortlöper och följs upp på ett smidigt sätt.

Du arbetar också aktivt med att behålla, koordinera och vidareutveckla samarbetet med SHIS samarbetspartners. Du ingår i en ledningsgrupp tillsammans med enhetschefen och andra sektionschefer. Tillsammans arbetar ni för att verksamheten ska nå SHIS uppställda mål, där vi strävar efter en likställighet inom hela organisationen.

Din kompetens och erfarenhet

    akademisk högskolexamen inom socialt arbete, beteendevetenskap, vård och omsorg eller motsvarande utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig
    aktuell erfarenhet av arbete som chef med ekonomi-, personal- och verksamhetsansvar
    erfarenhet och kunskap om relevant lagstiftning och avtal inom socialtjänst, jordabalkarna samt personal och arbetsmiljöområde

Elevassistent till Ljungenskolan i Kävlinge kommun
jobs.description:
Om tjänsten

Som elevassistent arbetar du som resurs i samarbete med ansvariga pedagoger i klassen. Tillsammans med dina kollegor planerar, samverkar och utvecklar du skolvardagen och arbetsmetoder för ett lustfyllt lärande och en hög måluppfyllelse.

Du förväntas bidra till att skapa en trygg och god lärmiljö och vara ett stöd i klassrummet. Arbete sker både enskilt och tillsammans med ditt arbetslag.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av pedagogiskt arbete och arbete med barn med behov av särskilt stöd är meriterande.

I ditt arbete har du tydligt elevfokus, är närvarande och ser möjligheter snarare än hinder. Du tar hänsyn till enskilda elevers individuella förutsättningar och får dem att växa. Du är ansvarsfull, van vid att sätta tydliga gränser och tycker det är viktigt att ha en bra relation till barn, vårdnadshavare och kollegor. Vi ser också att du är positiv och att du har stor förmåga att samarbeta och kommunicera i tal och skrift. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Om anställningen

Anställningarna är tidsbegränsade till 2026-12-31 med start enligt överenskommelse. Vi kommer att kalla till intervju löpande, varmt välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!

Innan anställning hos oss kommer vi be dig att visa upp ett utdrag ur Polisens Belastningsregister. Utdraget vi efterfrågar är "Arbete inom skolväsendet" och du behöver själv begära ut utdraget som du hittar på polisens hemsida: Arbete inom skolväsendet | Polismyndigheten

När du fått ditt utdrag uppvisar du sedan det för rekryterande chef. Det snabbaste sättet för att få sitt utdrag är att använda e-tjänsten och beställa det online med BankId.

Du behöver även visa upp pass eller nationellt ID-kort utfärdat av polis på intervjun.

Ljungenskolan är en F-6-skola med tillhörande fritidshem i Furulund. Skolan har vackra omgivningar med närhet till skog och å och rika möjligheter till stimulerande uteverksamhet. Tillsammans med Lackalänga skola bildar vi Furulunds rektorsområde. Skolorna har ett nära samarbete och vi värdesätter det kollegiala lärandet. Tillsammans bidrar vi till att våra elever utvecklar sina förmågor i en trygg och stimulerande lärmiljö. Vi har hög legitimationstäthet och ett gemensamt driv att fortsätta utveckla våra skolor. Utvärderingar visar att våra elever trivs i mycket hög utsträckning och skolan visar varje år mycket goda resultat med hög måluppfyllelse.

Att förbättra kvalitén genom uppföljning, utvärdering och utveckling är grundläggande för oss. Det gör vi genom att kontinuerligt säkerställa det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet. Vårt arbete utgår från ett kollegialt lärande och en delakultur där vi regelbundet träffar kollegor för att säkerställa en god kvalitativ undervisning med eleven i fokus.

Vi bryr oss!

Välkommen till en arbetsplats där du får utvecklas och göra skillnad varje dag. Med stort engagemang och omtanke om varandra, gör vi allt för att skapa en bättre vardag för alla i vår kommun. Vårt fokus på utveckling och kvalitet märks hos våra många nöjda invånare.

Till Kävlinge kommun tar du dig snabbt och enkelt, oavsett var du bor. Den goda stämningen och de många utvecklingsmöjligheterna är andra anledningar till att våra medarbetare trivs så bra. Vill du bli en av oss?

Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss i Kävlinge? Gå in på jobb.kavlinge.se för att läsa vad våra medarbetare tycker om att jobba hos oss, våra förmåner och se alla våra lediga jobb.

jobs.title: Founding Growth Marketer
jobs.description:
Who we are looking for

We're looking for a Founding Growth Marketer to build Birdsview's growth engine from the ground up, the person who turns "we have a great product" into a steady flow of qualified pipeline. AI first person.

Birdsview - Prolonging the lifetime of the built world

Birdsview is a Norwegian technology company on a mission to change the way we preserve critical infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and secure future.

Infrastructure is one of society’s most important assets. It includes the buildings we live in, the bridges we cross and the power grid that provides us with electricity. These structures are aging rapidly, and solutions that help preserve and secure critical infrastructure are now needed more than ever.

Birdsview's state-of-the-art technology combines radar (GPR), lidar, and AI to visualize what’s inside structures without destructive interventions. This allows for efficient and cost-effective inspection and monitoring of our most precious infrastructures - and enables clear, user-friendly visualizations that enhance understanding, extend asset lifespan, and promote material reuse - ultimately reducing costs and CO₂ emissions.

We are 17 people, we have customers in 9 countries, and we raised NOK 40.5 million from leading Nordic VC's to scale internationally.

About the job and why it matters

Much of concrete inspection today still relies on manual methods and fragmented, ageing non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. You will help structural engineers, contractors, surveying specialists, and asset owners see clearly what is hidden inside the concrete. New critical data, faster inspections, and real cost savings are why they want our technology in their daily projects.

As a Founding Growth Marketer, you will be the engine of our international growth. The role is hands-on: you'll use AI tools to build and test campaigns across channels, turn technical value into content that resonates with engineers and asset owners, run experiments to find what actually converts, and hand qualified leads to our sales team. This is a foundational role in a newly formed marketing function, where you will have a direct impact on our strategy, processes, and success.

  • Build the engine
    You'll design and implement our full growth marketing engine, taking a foundational role in shaping our strategy.

  • Own demand generation
    Own demand generation across content, paid, and organic channels, directly impacting qualified lead flow to sales. You're measured on qualified leads reaching sales.

  • Find the message that lands
    Test positioning against our different customer segments; engineers, contractors, asset owners and find the one we can scale. Nobody has the answer yet.

  • Work the funnel with sales
    Hand qualified leads to our sales team, and use what they hear back to sharpen the next campaign.

  • Build the measurement
    Set up tracking, reporting, and analytics to measure performance, identify effective strategies, and drive continuous improvement.

  • Make the technical obvious
    Leverage AI tools to create and test innovative campaigns that translate complex technical value into resonant messages for our target audience.

What we're looking for

  • AI-first, systematic and test-driven. You run experiments, read the data, and a campaign that flops doesn't slow you down.

  • Proven ability to build and run a complete growth engine: lead generation, content, paid campaigns, organic channels.

  • Skills in setting up tracking, reporting and analytics, so performance is measured rather than asserted.

  • Experience developing, testing and refining positioning and messaging, in collaboration with sales and leadership.

  • 1–3 years of experience in B2B growth or marketing, ideally in a startup or scale-up. Hands-on and results-oriented, this is a building role.

  • Fluent English; Norwegian is an advantage.

  • Based in Bergen or Oslo, or willing to relocate.

Why this is interesting

  • Top-tier colleagues
    Work alongside leading people in a supportive and ambitious team culture, with regular social events and company trips.

  • Build it yourself
    Be a foundational member, directly shaping our international sales strategy and playbook.

  • Room to grow
    We're building the commercial team right now. What you own in a year depends on what you build in the first six months.

  • Compensation
    Competitive salary and equity - become an owner.

  • Impact
    Make a tangible impact on preserving critical infrastructure and fostering a circular economy.

  • Location
    Work in Bergen or Oslo with a fast-moving, hands-on team. Excellent working facilities at StartupLab centrally located in both cities.

View the full details for the job here.

jobs.title: Vill du skapa förändring för ungdomar? | Behandlare till Samskapa, Tollarp
jobs.description:
Om Samskapa

På Samskapa arbetar vi med ungdomar som har några av de mest komplexa behandlingsbehoven inom HVB. Det är ungdomar som kan ha en kombination av svår social problematik, NPF, trauma, ångest, relationssvårigheter och beteenden som kräver mycket av både dig och verksamheten.



Många har redan mött flera olika insatser. Du kommer därför att möta ungdomar där det inte alltid finns en enkel väg framåt och där det ibland krävs något annat än det som har prövats tidigare.



Det är också det som gör Samskapa till en plats för dig som vill utvecklas som behandlare. Här får du arbeta med situationer som kräver att du använder din kunskap, gör egna bedömningar, tänker kreativt och hela tiden funderar på vad som faktiskt kan göra skillnad för just den ungdom du möter.



Vi tror på kompetens, men vi tror inte att en utbildning eller en metod ensam löser komplexa problem. Vår modell, Professionell Integrerad Behandling, PIB, bygger på att olika insatser och kompetenser behöver samverka för att skapa verklig förändring.



Hos oss får du därför inte bara ett arbete där du hjälper ungdomar. Du får arbeta med några av de mest krävande behandlingsuppdragen och tillsammans med kollegor som vill bli bättre på det vi gör.



Om rollen

Som behandlare arbetar du nära ungdomarna i deras vardag och är en viktig del av deras behandling och utveckling. Du är med och skapar struktur, förutsägbarhet och trygghet, samtidigt som du genomför behandlande insatser utifrån ungdomens individuella behov och genomförandeplan.



Arbetet kan vara intensivt och kräva att du snabbt kan anpassa dig efter situationen. Du kan behöva hantera starka känslor, konflikter och beteenden som är svåra att förstå och ännu svårare att förändra.



Du arbetar med motivationsarbete, stödjande samtal, vardagsstruktur, aktiviteter och individuellt anpassade behandlingsinsatser. Du behöver kunna prova olika vägar, utvärdera det du gör och tänka om när något inte fungerar.



Här finns sällan en enkel manual för vad du ska göra. Det är just därför vi behöver riktigt bra behandlare.



Du samverkar med kollegor och andra viktiga personer runt ungdomen, exempelvis skola, socialtjänst och vårdnadshavare. Dokumentation är en självklar del av arbetet och hjälper oss att följa ungdomens utveckling och säkerställa kvalitet i behandlingen.



Vem tror vi att du är?

Dig som tycker om att arbeta nära ungdomar och som inte ger upp bara för att vägen framåt blir krokig. Du vill förstå vad som finns bakom ungdomens beteende och är genuint nyfiken på vad som kan hjälpa just den ungdom du möter.



Du är trygg när situationer blir intensiva och kan vara både varm och tydlig. Du förstår att gränser och relation inte är motsatser och kan behålla ditt lugn även när ungdomens känslor tar stor plats.



Du tycker om att se utveckling, även när den kommer i små steg. När något inte fungerar fastnar du inte i det, utan funderar på vad du kan göra annorlunda.



Du arbetar självständigt och tar ansvar för ditt uppdrag, men tror inte att du behöver ha alla svar själv. Du uppskattar att arbeta tillsammans med andra, dela erfarenheter och lära av dina kollegor.



Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med ungdomar som ställer höga krav på dig som behandlare och som tycker att det är just det som gör jobbet meningsfullt.



Vi söker dig som har

• Minst två års eftergymnasial utbildning inom socialt arbete, exempelvis socialpedagog eller socionom, eller inom beteendevetenskap

• Minst ett års arbetslivserfarenhet av liknande arbete

• God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift

• B körkort



Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av

• NPF, TMO, MI eller annan relevant utbildning

• Lågaffektivt bemötande samt hantering av hot och våld

• BBIC eller IBIC

• Dokumentation i journalsystem



Vi erbjuder dig

• En gedigen introduktion med inplanerade uppföljningar

• Kompetensutveckling och regelbunden handledning

• Välutbildade och erfarna ledare

• Ett team med bred kompetens och stark sammanhållning

• Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år

• Kollektivavtal, tjänstepension och goda arbetsvillkor



Praktisk information om tjänsten

Placering: Tollarp, Kristianstad

Omfattning: Cirka 85 %

Arbetstid: Dygnspass

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning

Start: Enligt överenskommelse

Antal tjänster: 3



Rekryteringsprocessen

I enlighet med Socialnämndens beslut krävs utdrag från Polismyndighetens belastnings och misstankeregister i samband med anställning. Vi rekommenderar därför att du begär utdraget redan i samband med din ansökan.



Vi kommer även att begära in underlag för att verifiera din utbildning. Du får gärna bifoga examensbevis och andra relevanta underlag direkt i din ansökan.



Urval och intervjuer genomförs löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.



Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför vänligt men bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.



https://samskapa.com/



Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Senior Business Intelligence Developer - Finance
jobs.description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

_______________________________________________________________________________

To strengthen our capabilities in analytics engineering and data visualisation, Etraveli Group is now recruiting a Senior Business Intelligence Developer with a focus on Finance to join the BI team.

The role can be located in either Uppsala or Stockholm.

About the job

You will be joining our BI team in creating and maintaining data pipelines and relevant business intelligence applications. The latter are presently created in Qlik Sense and Looker. Work is also underway to evolve our tech stack by implementing dbt and a new data platform. You will play a vital role in this journey, taking a major part in shaping how our BI team evolves its ways of working.

Your role will require both a deep understanding of the business needs and the skill set to acquire, handle and analyse the relevant data. You will have a close direct connection and collaboration with other groups and departments acting as stakeholders for the applications you develop.

Our BI team is split across the offices in Uppsala, Stockholm, Göteborg, Mumbai and Athens, and caters to the whole organisation. In total we are nineteen developers and our processes and technical setup are mature, but constantly adapting to the business and the technical landscape.

The data you will be using is mostly structured in databases maintained by the IT-department and we use several different database technologies. Less structured data will also occur frequently.

Working at Etraveli Group means working at a company with grand plans and great expectations. You will have awesome colleagues together with whom you will solve complex problems in a fast-moving business.

To summarise the job will include:

    development of business intelligence applications, focusing primarily on financial reporting and analytics
    

    analytics engineering, data modelling, and building robust data pipelines
    

    taking a senior role and contribute to define how the BI-team should adopt work in the new data platform
    

    working closely and directly with stakeholders, especially within the Finance department

Requirements

You need to be passionate about business and numbers since the job requires both a deep understanding of the business needs, as well as the ability to acquire, handle and analyse the relevant data. Personality-wise you are curious, methodical, ambitious and thorough. More formally, you have:

    a university degree in a quantitative field (economics, statistics, engineering or similar)
    

    either or both: extensive professional experience of development in some Business Intelligence tools (e.g., QlikView, Qlik Sense, Looker, Tableau, Power BI) and/or experience with analytics engineering, writing pipelines for analytical data in a data warehouse technology. Experience with dbt, Dremio and/or spark in particular are seen as big advantages
    

    demonstrated abilities in handling data with code and to produce meaningful data visualizations that can drive insights
    

    strong communication skills including excellent command of spoken and written English

Experience working with financial data, financial reporting concepts, or ERP systems is highly beneficial, as you will be working closely with our Finance department.

Benefits

Working at Etraveli Group means working at a fast-growing company with high ambitions in becoming the number one Online travel agency worldwide. The culture at the company embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company.

We offer:

    A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid model where you can choose to work two days from home and two weeks per year from a remote location.
    

    Central office locations – We are located on Regeringsgatan in Stockholm and Dragarbrunnsgatan in Uppsala, a stone's throw from public transport and lunch restaurants.
    

    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
    

    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.

As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

Welcome to Etraveli Group!

Diversity disclaimer

At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. jobs.title: Cater/Kok/Madøre - barselsvikar
jobs.description:
Er du knivskarp i et køkken? Brænder du for gastronomi, den gode smag og arbejdet med ordentlige råvarer? Har du blik for at reducere madspild? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter til kantinen hos HK Østjylland.

Du gør en forskel
Din glæde for at lave god mad smitter af – både på dine kollegaer i køkkenet og på de mange medarbejdere og gæster, der hver dag spiser i vores kantine i Aarhus. Du bliver en del af et fast team med kantineleder, køkkenassistent og 3 rengøringsassistenter, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen i en professionel hverdag med en god og sjov tone. Vi sætter en stor ære i vores råvarer og bruger de bedste produkter. Hos os handler det ikke om masseproduktion, men om kvalitet, smag og ordentlighed i alle led.

En dygtig håndværker med faglig stolthed
Vi søger en faglært kok/cater eller en med anden relevant baggrund og solid erfaring fra køkken. Du har styr på de grundlæggende teknikker, arbejder struktureret og har stoltheden med i dit håndværk. Måske har du erfaring fra kantine, storkøkken eller restauration – det vigtigste er, at du kan dit fag og trives i en hverdag med faste rammer og højt tempo omkring frokost.

Sammen med dine kolleger deltager du i alle køkkenets opgaver, herunder:

  • Produktion af kolde og varme frokostretter

  • Mødeforplejning

  • Anretning og præsentation

  • Egenkontrol, rengøring, varemodtagelse og opvask

  • Menuplanlægning i samarbejde med kantineleder

Din arbejdsdag
Din primære arbejdsplads er kantinen hos HK Østjylland i Brabrand. Stillingen er på 30 timer ugentligt inkl. betalte pauser og med fast arbejdstid mandag til fredag kl. 08.00–14.00. Der kan i perioder forekomme arrangementer, hvor fleksibilitet og lidt overarbejde må forventes.

Du vil opleve succes i jobbet, når du:

  • Har lyst til løbende at udvikle din faglighed

  • Har fokus på smag, kvalitet og gode råvarer

  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og som en del af et team

  • Tager ansvar og bidrager aktivt til den daglige drift

  • Trives i et køkken med tempo og samarbejde

 

Vi har gode løn- og ansættelsesvilkår og ansættelsen sker efter lokal overenskomst med 3F med blandt andet feriefridage, fritvalgskonto, særligt ferietillæg og en god pensionsordning.

 

Vil du med på holdet?
Kan du se dig selv i ovenstående stilling, og har du lyst til at blive en del af en kantine med høj faglighed, ordentlighed og et stærkt fællesskab, så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Tiltrædelse: den 4. januar 2027
Der er tale om et barselsvikariat af ca. 1 års varighed.

Ansøgning
Ansøgningsfristen er den 22. oktober 2026
Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler den 29. oktober

Kandidater til stillingen skal være indstillet på at gennemføre en persontest forud for samtalen.

 Alle kvalificerede og interesserede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Søg stillingen via HK’s hjemmeside her

Cater/Kok/Madøre - barselsvikar - HK

 

Yderligere oplysninger
Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte kantineleder Kristoffer Korshøj på tlf.: 28561509

jobs.title: Associate professor of Equine Sports Medicine
jobs.description:
Associate professor of Equine Sports Medicine

Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences

Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences

University of Copenhagen



The University seeks to appoint an associate professor within Equine Sports Medicine to the Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences to commence 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Information on the Department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/ and www.ikv.ku.dk/english.

About us

The Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences covers strong and internationally recognized research areas in clinical veterinary sciences. A relatively large part of our research is fertilised and inspired from clinical challenges, identified in the hospital, in our ambulatory field practice or from our external collaborators. Based on these, we want to set a new standard for cross-disciplinary research, education and innovation within animal health and disease.

The Section for Medicine, Surgery and Reproduction for Large animals holds research and clinical teaching, in a modern 24-hour open university veterinary teaching hospital and ambulatory field practice service for all large animals with horses as the primary species consulted. We also have the cross departmental, University of Copenhagen Centre for Veterinary Simulation, which is open 24/7 for veterinary students to practice clinical skills. Our research is focused on diseases of clinical relevance for horses and cattle thereby having a direct application for veterinarians and animal owners. Also, translational research bridging basic science to companion animal as well as human medicine is a strength of the section.

We have a strong educational and scientific focus on the athletic horse collaborating with internationally recognised research groups within cardiovascular, airway and orthopaedic research with a high impact translational research profile. To fully exploit the scientific and clinical potentials, the muscular development and disease understanding in sports and rehabilitation medicine both in horses and companion animals and is a strategic research area in the department, why collaboration with the companion animal sections of the department is expected in the position. The announced associate professorship is crucial to enhancing and strengthening this area to fully obtain the synergy of the other research areas mentioned above.

Equine medicine is a core discipline in the fourth and fifth years of the veterinary medical education in Denmark. Therefore the position is highly involved in research based teaching of veterinary students within equine sports medicine and the candidate is expected to take a leadership role in conducting clinical relevant research, teaching and examining undergraduate students, as well as assist and promote the development of both pre-and postgraduate teaching as well as research strategies within the field of equine sports medicine.

The culture of the department is typical Scandinavian: a flat structure with a tradition for close collaboration where all employees are expecting openness, mutual respect, and sharing of ideas, resources and competences.

Job description

In considering applications for the associate professorship, the main emphasis will be on the following aspects:

  • The applicant's ability to document a high level of original scientific production at an international level within the area of equine sports medicine and preferably with a strong translational profile.
  • The applicant’s practical experience within equine general medicine in both a hospital and in research setting.
  • The applicants experience with development of clinical research-based teaching of veterinary students.
The associate professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • Research, including publication/academic dissemination
  • Research-based pre-and postgraduate teaching, including clinical teaching and service, associated examination and course responsibilities
  • Strengthen, developing and integrating muscular research in research-based teaching of veterinary students
  • Research leadership, including guidance and supervision of researchers and veterinary students as well as securing external funding.
  • Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society, including participation in public debate and engagement in topics of relevance for horse owners
  • Organizational contribution to the section, department and university incl. e.g. participation in department committees and course leadership.
  • Academic assessments
Required qualifications

To be qualified for an associate professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership.

Find information about each criterion.

The successful applicant should:

  • Hold a DVM with license to practice in Denmark or be willing to apply for such within 6 months.
  • Hold a PhD degree or similar qualifications.
  • Diplomat degree within ECEIM, ACVIM or ECVSMR is an advantage.
  • Document a high degree of research experience and scientific publications within the field of equine internal medicine and sports medicine at an international level, including considerable contributions to the development of the academic discipline.
  • Have experience with research management and other management functions, including attraction of external funding and group leadership.
  • Document pre-and postgraduate clinical teaching experience within the field of the position and documented pedagogical training at university level.
  • Perform research-based teaching.
  • Perform quality patient care and service management in an equine hospital and ambulatory field practice within equine general medicine.
  • Possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.
  • If Danish is not the first language, the applicant is expected to obtain sufficient Danish skills within 1-2 years.
Diversity and International Applicants

The University of Copenhagen is committed to fostering diversity and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.

Useful resources:

  • www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility)
  • www.workingconditions.ku.dk.
Terms of employment

The position is a permanent position.

The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

Employment is as associate professor according to the collective agreement or job structure under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package for up to 2,500,000 DKK that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers here

Questions

For further information, please contact group leader Tina Holberg Pihl thpi@sund.ku.dk.

Application

The application must be submitted in English, by clicking on "Apply online" below, and must include the following:

  • Application, including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)
  • Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Diplomas - (Master’s, PhD, and other relevant certificates)
  • Upload a list of maximum 5 publications to be assessed
  • Research plan (3-5 pages)
  • Teaching plan
  • Teaching portfolio (Guidelines)
The further process
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's job portal.

Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Please submit the application with the required attachments.

The closing date for applications is 29 October 2026 23.59 p.m. CET.

Employer: Department of Veterinary Clinical and Animal Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. Homepage: http://ikvh.ku.dk/english/

The University of Copenhagen actively influences current and future generations through excellent research, education and co-operation. UCPH is one of the highest ranked universities in Europe and is Denmark´s oldest university, founded in 1479. Today, the University has 37,000 students and

9,000 employees affiliated across six faculties: humanities, law, natural sciences, social sciences, health sciences and theology www.ku.dk/english.

jobs.title: Apulaispäällikkö, S-market Tammisaari / Biträdande enhetschef, S-market Ekenäs
jobs.description:
Primary location:
RAASEPORI

APULAISPÄÄLLIKKÖ, S-MARKET TAMMISAARI, 37,5H, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme S-market Tammisaareen kokoaikaista apulaispäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tämä työ sopii sinulle, joka nautit vaihtelevasta arjesta, pidät ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja haluat olla mukana tekemässä isosta ja monipuolisesta myymälästä paikkaa, jossa on kiva asioida ja tehdä töitä. S-market Tammisaaren arki tarjoaa paljon erilaisia toimintoja, tilanteita ja mahdollisuuksia onnistua yhdessä tiimin kanssa.
Apulaispäällikkönä, eli tuttavallisemmin apparina, olet toimipaikkapäällikön tärkein työpari ja mukana varmistamassa, että myymälän arki rullaa sujuvasti aamusta iltaan. Isossa yksikössä pääset näkemään kaupan arkea laajasti ja saat kivasti vastuuta sekä hyvän mahdollisuuden kasvaa esihenkilönä konkreettisen tekemisen kautta.

Tässä tehtävässä:
- Vastaat yhdessä toimipaikkapäällikön kanssa asiakastyytyväisyydestä, palvelusta, prosesseista, henkilökunnan työnohjauksesta ja myymälän operatiivisesta tuloksesta.
- Johdat toimintaa omalla esimerkilläsi ja olet arjessa mukana niin hyllytyksessä, kassalla kuin asiakaspalvelussa.
- Sparraat toimipaikkapäällikköä ja tuet henkilökuntaa, sillä tiimityö on avain kaikkeen, mitä teemme.
- Työskentelet vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa, jotta myymälä on parhaassa mahdollisessa kunnossa kaikkina aukioloaikoina.
- Hyppäät vastuuseen itsenäisesti toimipaikkapäällikön lomien aikana.
Onnistuaksesi tehtävässä:
- Olet oma-aloitteinen, järjestelmällinen ja tykkäät siitä, että työpäivässä tapahtuu.
- Sinulla on jo kokemusta kaupan alalta – mielellään myös vastuutehtävistä.
- Osaat toimia paineisissakin tilanteissa hymyssä suin.
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Valmentava ote ja hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ovat osa sinua.
- On tärkeää, että kykenet asiakaspalveluun vähintään suomeksi tai ruotsiksi.
Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua jatkuvasti, esimerkiksi erilaisten koulutusten sekä ammatillisen tutkinnon tai sen osan suorittamisen kautta.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.
Palkkaus
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta (13,33 €/h – 15,26 €/h), johon vaikuttavat kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
- Apulaispäälliköille maksetaan lisäksi tehtävän vaativuuden mukaista vastuulisää.
- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden tulospalkkioon, joka on jopa 1,70 euroa lisää jokaiselta työtunnilta, jos ja kun saavutamme vuosittaiset tavoitteemme.

Jos ihan tavallinen (mutta sopivasti haastava) työ kiinnostaa, laita hakemus tulemaan.
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 11.10.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa toimipaikkapäällikkö Malin Fransman (puh. 010762 6029, malin.fransman@sok.fi ). Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

-------------

BITRÄDANDE ENHETSCHEF, S-MARKET EKENÄS, 37,5H, TILLSVIDAREANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en biträdande enhetschef på heltid till S-market Ekenäs för en tillsvidareanställning. Det här jobbet passar dig som trivs med en omväxlande vardag, gillar att möta människor och vill vara med och skapa en stor och mångsidig butik där det är trevligt att både handla och arbeta. S-market Ekenäs är en enhet där vardagen bjuder på många olika funktioner, situationer och möjligheter att lyckas tillsammans med teamet.
Som biträdande enhetschef, eller tvåa som vi brukar säga, är du enhetschefens viktigaste arbetspar och med och säkerställer att vardagen i butiken flyter på smidigt från morgon till kväll. I en stor enhet får du se handelns vardag brett, ta lagom mycket ansvar och få en fin möjlighet att växa som chef genom konkret arbete.

I den här rollen:
-Tillsammans med enhetschefen ansvarar du för kundnöjdhet, service, processer, arbetsledning och operativt resultat.
-Du leder verksamheten med ditt eget exempel och deltar i det dagliga arbetet, både i varuplock, i kassan och i kundservice.
-Du sparrar enhetschefen och stöder personalen, eftersom teamarbete är nyckeln till allt vi gör.
-Du jobbar i varierande skift, för vi vill att butiken ska vara i bästa möjliga skick under alla öppettider.
-Du tar självständigt ansvar under chefens semestrar.
Vad vi önskar av dig:
-Du är initiativtagande, strukturerad och gillar när det händer saker under arbetsdagen.
-Du har redan skaffat erfarenhet från handeln - gärna också från ansvarspositioner.
-Du kan hantera stressiga situationer med ett leende på läpparna.
-Du möter kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe. <3
-Du behöver god samarbetsförmåga och ett coachande arbetssätt.
- det är viktigt att du kan ge kundservice på åtminstone finska eller svenska.
Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
-Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
-Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
-Möjlighet att utvecklas och utbilda dig kontinuerligt, till exempel genom olika utbildningar samt möjlighet att avlägga en yrkesexamen eller en del av den.
-Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, smink, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.
-Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmån
Lön
- Lön enligt handelns kollektivavtal (13,33 €/h - 15,26 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Därtill får biträdande enhetschefen ett ansvarstillägg som motsvarar arbetsuppgiftens kravnivå.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 procent om du kan betjäna kunder på åtminstone finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till en resultatpremie på upp till 1,70 euro extra för varje arbetad timme om och när vi når våra årliga mål.

Om du är intresserad av ett helt vanligt (men lagom utmanande) jobb, skicka in din ansökan. Vi framskrider med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så fort som möjligt men senast söndag 11.10.2026. För mer information om uppgiften, vänligen kontakta enhetschef Malin Fransman (puh. 010762 6029, malin.fransman@sok.fi ). Anställningen börjar enligt avtal.

jobs.title: Mine Geologist for Kiruna Underground Mine
jobs.description:
Are you interested in developing the ore model accuracy in a world-class underground iron ore mine?

The sustainable transformation begins with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.

Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?

Your role

Our Kiruna Mine Geology department is looking for a Mine Geologist focused on 3D modelling, block modelling, and cross-departmental collaborations. In this role, you will work closely with our mine planning, rock engineering, and survey crews, as well as production operations, external drilling contractors and commercial laboratories. This is an environment where collaboration, reliability, and automated innovations are highly valued.

Responsibilities include providing updated production block models, as well as 3D geological models, based on face mappings, core logging, and assay data to ensure high-confidence ore body alignment with stope designs and mining plans. You will deliver accurate grade control data to mine planners and engineers for blasting and dilution management. Additionally, you will handle and validate large datasets, support ore tracking and grade control processes, perform reconciliation analyses between geological models and mining outcomes, and collaborate closely with mine planners, engineers and production teams to continuously improve model accuracy and data quality.

What you bring

If you have an analytical mindset, work well both independently and collaboratively, and like handling and interacting with large datasets, you will likely thrive in this role in a supportive team environment. You are communicative, proactive, and enjoy collaborating across functions to improve workflows and achieve shared goals. A responsible, flexible, and solution-oriented approach will be important in your daily work.

To be eligible for the role, you need to have: 

    Preferably M.Sc. and minimum B.Sc. in Geology, Geological Engineering, Earth Sciences, or equivalent
    Proficiency in 3D modelling softwares (like Leapfrog Geo & Edge or Datamine)
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken; proficiency in Swedish is highly desirable.
    A valid driver’s license (equivalent to Swedish B driver's license for manual transmission vehicles)

It is advantageous if you have:

    Proficiency in the Deswik software
    Experience of resource estimation
    Previous experience of geological mapping, core logging, and/or managing assay QA/QC databases
    Previous experience from underground mining operations
    Experience from leadership roles, such as in exploration/infill drilling programs

Additional information

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to submit your application.

Start: According to agreement

Location: Kiruna

Type of Employment: Permanent, full-time, daytime

Contact: For more information about the position, please contact the hiring manager Viola Friberg (viola.friberg@lkab.com +46703249337).

Union representatives Kiruna/ Svappavaara:

    Sakari Alanko, Unionen, 0980-725 08
    Ledarna Norra, ledarna.norra@lkab.com
    Peter Johansson, Akademikerföreningen, 0980-718 79

LKAB är en internationell gruv- och mineralkoncern med norra Sverige som bas och hela världen som arbetsplats. Vileder vägen mot koldioxidfri produktion och vi gör det tillsammans – i en öppen, varm och säker arbetsmiljö medteknologi och utveckling i fokus. Vi välkomnar utmaningar, innovativa idéer och initiativförmåga, alltid medjämställdhet och mångfald i fokus.

jobs.title: AI Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

Job Purpose

Etraveli Group has ~3,000 employees and uses market-leading agentic tools and production autonomous agents to drive productivity across all functions, including bespoke use cases.

This role owns rollout, standards, training, and support for our agentic toolkit, alongside leading the Tech/Legal cross-functional governance forum.

A hands-on position focused on configuring platforms, creating guides/assets, running user sessions, and scaling adoption within Data & AI.

The role can be based in Stockholm or Uppsala.

Duties and Responsibilities

Rollout and Adoption

    Own business-side rollout, functional onboarding, and train-the-trainer initiatives.
    

    Partner with IT on licensing and backend configuration (e.g., connectors/MCPs) to drive adoption.
    

    Secure management alignment across departments and continuously optimize tooling rollout routines.
    

    Track model spend against usage to optimize cost vs. value.

Standards and Reusable Assets

    Establish practical AI standards, project structures, and output verification protocols.
    

    Provide plain-language guidance on tool selection and data classification compliance.
    

    Build and curate a shared library of prompts, skills, workflows, and evaluate new stack tools everything from memory to managed agents

Training and Support

    Design/deliver training programs with HR (onboarding, functional tracks, power-user deep dives).
    

    Lead a champions network and run senior sponsor education programs.
    

    Educate users on efficient, cost-effective tool usage and context structuring.
    

    Support users hands-on to help them solve their business problems with the help of AI

Governance Operations and Support

    Manage the AI governance forum intake/agenda, structuring cases for Tech and Legal review.
    

    Act as the primary contact for teams proposing new personal AI tools / connectivity, screening for technical and practical feasibility.
    

    Communicate responsible use standards (data guardrails and mandatory verification) across the organization

Measurement and Opportunities

    Own adoption KPIs (tracking weekly active usage and AI maturity per function).
    

    Identify and resolve cultural, practical, or technical adoption blockers with leadership.
    

    Manage the promotion path for proven self-serve workflows to transition into centrally built engineering projects.

Qualifications / Personal Characteristics

Must Have

    Proven track record of rolling out internal tools/platforms (access, onboarding waves, support).
    

    Daily power user of LLMs with experience building prompts, projects, Gems, skills, or workflows.
    

    Experience designing and delivering non-technical training and clear documentation.
    

    Solid technical understanding of LLMs, agents, tool use, and retrieval mechanisms.
    

    Ability to define adoption metrics and present structured business cases to senior leadership, Legal, and Tech partners.

Nice to Have

    Hands-on experience administering Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot or a comparable enterprise AI platform.
    

    Experience driving adoption of more than one overlapping tool at once.
    

    Python or similar at prototyping level.
    

    Background in L&D or training design.
    

    Experience in a multi-country organisation with a large operational workforce.

Benefits

The culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company.

With us you can enjoy:

    A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location
    

    Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner.
    

    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
    

    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.
    

    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.
