jobs.title: (Senior) Data Engineer (Snowflake) – Building and Technical Trade, K Group
jobs.description:
Snowflake is becoming the foundation of Building and Technical Trade's future data ecosystem. As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you'll help define how data is modelled, built and utilized across analytics, AI and business development. Rather than joining a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to influence the development practices, data models and technical standards that will shape our future data platform. We are open to candidates from experienced Data Engineer to Senior Data Engineer level. The exact scope and level of responsibility can be shaped based on your background and expertise.

You will work as part of Kesko's Central Data & Analytics Platforms team while collaborating closely with Building and Technical Trade's Data, AI and ESG team. Together with BI analysts, analytics engineers, data experts and business stakeholders, you'll turn business needs into scalable and reliable data solutions that support both daily decision-making and future growth. We are working in a hybrid workplace model where we combine office days at K Kampus in Kalasatama and remote work to best suit both the role and the team. Come and join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K Group!

What is the role about?

As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you will be a key data expert helping BTT build a modern Snowflake-based data foundation for analytics, AI and business development. This is a hands-on senior role with strong architectural influence: you will help shape how Snowflake development is done in BTT, while working closely with the BTT Data, AI and ESG team and Keskos central data platform experts. In addition to building solutions, you will help grow the teams Snowflake capabilities through collaboration, mentoring and practical examples.

Your key responsibilities include:
- Technical ownership: owning the technical direction of BTTs Snowflake solutions and ensuring that solutions are reliable, maintainable and aligned with agreed platform principles - Best practices and architecture: defining BTTs Snowflake development practices, including modelling approach, warehouse strategy, documentation, quality and maintainability, while contributing to the broader data architecture and innovation - Mentoring and collaborating: coaching BTT data team members towards stronger Snowflake competence, collaborating with BI analysts, analytics engineers and business stakeholders, and translating business needs into practical data solutions - Building solutions: designing, building and optimizing scalable dbt-based data pipelines, transformations and logical and physical data models



Who are we looking for?

We are looking for an experienced data engineer who enjoys hands-on building but also thinks about the bigger picture, and who genuinely wants to help others grow.

We are not looking for unicorns, but the more of below capabilities are found the better youd fit to the ideal candidate profile:
- Snowflake, dbt and SQL: strong hands-on experience in data engineering with Snowflake, proficiency with dbt for transformations, efficient SQL skills and solid data modelling capability. (This one is actually mandatory) - Modern engineering practices: experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines and a DevOps mindset in a data context; what we develop, we also support. - Background in data warehousing/ETL: You have designed or maintained data pipelines with different technologies. Experience with SAP BW data models and transformations is beneficial, as it helps in understanding our legacy environment. - Data management mindset: Familiarity with data cataloging, lineage tools, semantic views, or overall data governance frameworks. You care about documentation and data quality. - Big picture view: the ability to make sound technical choices across source data, data modelling, transformations and reporting needs, not just build individual pipelines. - Mentoring ability: experience and motivation in sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and contributing to the development of data engineering practices - AI mindset: interest in leveraging AI to speed up and improve development and maintenance processes - Communication: excellent teamwork and communication skills, and the ability to explain complex data topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Fluency in English is required (our working language). Finnish or other Nordic language skills are beneficial but not necessary. - Self-driven and proactive attitude: You take initiative to improve things and arent afraid to suggest new ideas. You are solution-oriented and able to work independently when needed, but also know when to ask for help or input. - Relevant experience with SAP, Aspect4 or web-based business application data as well as familiarity with chain-operated wholesale and/or merchant-led retail business models, especially in the building and technical trade sector










Please note that the role is in Finland and you will need the existing right to work here. Kesko is unable to sponsor work permits or visas.

Why join us?

We offer you the chance to work in a key role, building a modern data platform in a large and diverse organization. Rather than stepping into a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to help define the development standards, modelling principles and engineering practices that will shape how BTT utilizes Keskos Snowflake platform.

With us you get:
- a genuinely impactful, hands-on role in building our Snowflake data platform from the ground up - a supportive community of expert colleagues in both BTT and Keskos central data teams - the opportunity to influence the technical direction, best practices and ways of working of our future data platform - modern work tools and numerous opportunities to learn, develop and grow your career in a large, international organization - extensive K Group employee benefits, including a mobile-phone benefit, culture, well-being and sports benefit (ePassi Flex), staff discounts in K Group stores, own occupational health care, leisure-time accident insurance, and a car benefit according to our company policy. - partner benefits related to optical stores, accommodation and travel, as well as sports and wellbeing services - a flexible hybrid working model with at least one office day per week

jobs.title: Industrielektriker søges til stærkt team i Vestjylland
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med installationsopgaver hos nogle af Danmarks største industrivirksomheder? Og sætter du en ære i at levere solidt håndværk, hvor kvalitet og samarbejde er i fokus? Så kan du blive en del af vores voksende industriafdeling hos Viftrup Jespersen A/S.

Et arbejde med mening og ansvar

Vi har travlt og udvider derfor teamet i vores industriafdeling. Her arbejder vi tæt sammen med store fødevareproducenter og leverer tekniske løsninger, der holder produktionen i gang. Det kræver faglighed og ansvarlighed – og det er netop dét, vi leder efter.

Du får din daglige base i Videbæk og bliver en del af et stærkt hold, hvor samarbejde, ordentlighed og godt håndværk går hånd i hånd. Dine opgaver vil primært være hos én af vores største industrikunder.

”Hos os får du mere indflydelse på dine opgaver og en tættere relation til både kolleger og ledelse, end du finder mange andre steder.”
– Anders Elkjær, ejer

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som en del af industriafdelingen vil du arbejde med:

  • Installation og montage af el-tekniske løsninger

  • Opsætning af føringsveje og kabelføring

  • Automationsopgaver og mindre styretavlearbejde

  • Servicering og vedligehold af installationer

  • Deltagelse i både projekter og løbende drift

Du vil samarbejde med både vores egne teknikere og kundens projektledere. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring og introduktion til opgaver og arbejdsgange.

Faglig udvikling og et stærkt fællesskab

Hos os er der plads til at udvikle sig. Vi starter dig op med mindre opgaver og bygger gradvist på, i takt med at du bliver fortrolig med arbejdsgangene. Har du ambitioner, støtter vi gerne op med relevante kurser og efteruddannelse.

Vi er et team, der hjælper hinanden – både fagligt og socialt. Vores personaleforening arrangerer jævnligt aktiviteter, og vi prioriterer et arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle trives.

Hvad vi forventer af dig

Vi leder efter en kollega, som:

  • er fagligt stærk og arbejder med kvalitet og struktur

  • er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • har lyst til at samarbejde og tage ejerskab i opgaverne

Du har sandsynligvis en baggrund som elektriker, industrielektriker eller automatiktekniker – og gerne erfaring med industriinstallationer.

Det får du hos os

Udover spændende opgaver og et godt fællesskab tilbyder vi:

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Fastansættelse i en stabil virksomhed

  • Overenskomst, pension og sundhedsforsikring

  • Lokale goder som fx rabat på fitness og svømmehal

  • Mulighed for efteruddannelse

 

Interesseret?

Er du klar til at tage ansvar for, at vi lever op til vores kunders høje forventninger? Så send CV og ansøgning til Jette på jcl@viftrup.dk Vi vurderer kandidater og indkalder til samtaler løbende. Vi ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vil du vide mere om dit nye job, så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på jcl@viftrup.dk eller 51200268.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

In this role, you own the engagement outcome. You will lead our most complex, multi-workstream engagements in Korea, decide when Forward Deployed Engineers are needed for code-intensive work, and coach others to raise the bar across our Services practice.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead Notion’s most complex, multi-workstream customer engagements in Korea end to end, from scoping and discovery through launch, adoption and handoff, often where the future state and success measures are not yet defined.

 - Shape Services scope, effort estimates and implementation strategy with account teams during pre-sales, then deliver against the agreed scope, timeline and outcomes, recovering engagements that go off track.

 - Drive executive alignment on ambiguous, high-stakes decisions: facilitate discovery and architecture workshops, frame tradeoffs clearly and deliver hard messages directly.

 - Decide where Notion should own, complement or connect to existing systems, and design scalable architectures and AI-native workflows to a production quality bar, including permission design, AI evaluation, human-in-the-loop controls and operational ownership.

 - Orchestrate Forward Deployed Engineers, partners and internal teams: define when deeper engineering is required and set clear scope, ownership and handoffs.

 - Lead change management and adoption through stakeholder alignment, champion programs, phased rollouts and enablement, so customer teams sustain usage and realize measurable value.

 - Coach other architects and partners, and scale the Korea Services practice through reusable reference architectures, packaged solutions and localized enablement.

 - Turn field patterns into evidence-backed product signals (customer pain, business impact, expected outcome and frequency) that influence Notion’s roadmap.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Proven track record of designing and deploying AI-powered workflows or agents in production for customers.

 - Hands-on technical depth in data modeling and permission design, API and integration patterns, agent design and evaluation, enterprise security and governance, and data validation with SQL or scripts. You do not need to write production code.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Experience scoping Services work, estimating effort and delivering within agreed commercial boundaries.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Experience coaching consultants or architects, and building methods, reference architectures or packaged services that others adopt.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

 - Professional fluency in Korean and English.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience delivering for large Korean enterprises and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder decision processes.

 - Experience enabling or co-delivering with implementation partners.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Site Engineering and Reliability Lead

jobs.title: AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA
jobs.description:
**AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA**

Ekodrive Oy etsii **itsenäistä ja vastuullista automekaanikkoa** pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Keravalle.

Työvoiman tarve on arviolta **loka–marraskuussa 2026**, mutta etsimme sopivaa henkilöä jo nyt. Jos olet tällä hetkellä töissä mutta harkitset työpaikan vaihtoa myöhemmin syksyllä, voit myös ottaa yhteyttä.

Etsimme mekaanikkoa, joka pystyy hoitamaan tavallisia korjaamotöitä itsenäisesti, tekee työnsä loppuun sovitussa ajassa ja **kantaa vastuun työnsä lopputuloksesta**.

Työhön kuuluu mm.

- määräaikaishuollot ja öljynvaihdot

- jarrujen huolto ja korjaus

- alustan ja ohjauksen korjaukset

- katsastuskorjaukset

- moottori- ja vaihteistoöljyjen vaihdot

- jakohihnojen ja jakopään osien vaihdot

- vikojen etsintä ja perusdiagnostiikka

- rengastyöt

- ilmastointihuollot

- muut tavalliset henkilöautojen korjaamotyöt


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea, mutta **tavalliset korjaamotyöt pitää pystyä tekemään itsenäisesti**.

Arvostamme mekaanikkoa, joka osaa ajatella käytännöllisesti: vika tutkitaan, korjataan järkevällä tavalla ja työ saatetaan loppuun ilman tarpeetonta asioiden monimutkaistamista.

Odotamme sinulta

- B-luokan ajokorttia

- vastuullisuutta ja luotettavuutta

- oma-aloitteista työotetta

- kykyä tehdä päätöksiä oman työn yhteydessä

- kiinnostusta autoihin ja korjaamiseen

- halua kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa

- kykyä työskennellä normaalisti osana pientä työporukkaa


**Autosähkön, diagnostiikan ja hitsauksen osaaminen on selvä etu.**

Aikaisempi työkokemus autokorjaamolta ja suomen kielen taito ovat plussaa. Työpaikalla voidaan kommunikoida **suomeksi tai venäjäksi**.

Meillä arvostetaan hyvää työilmapiiriä, keskinäistä kunnioitusta ja sitä, että jokainen hoitaa oman työnsä kunnolla.

Meille asiakkaan auto on tärkeä riippumatta sen merkistä, iästä tai arvosta. **Jokainen auto on asiakkaalle tärkeä ja meille työtä.**

Tarjoamme

- vakituisen työn sopivalle henkilölle

- työajan **37,5 h/vko**

- ma–pe **klo 8.00–16.00**

- 6 kuukauden koeajan

- pienen ja kehittyvän työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden saada enemmän vastuuta ja kehittyä yrityksen kasvaessa

- palkka: **kerro palkkatoiveesi**


Myös **oppilaitoksen kautta tuleva työharjoittelu tai virallinen työkokeilu** voi olla mahdollinen, jos hakijalla on hyvä tekninen perusta, oikea asenne ja realistinen mahdollisuus jatkaa myöhemmin työntekijänä.

HAKEMINEN – VAIN SÄHKÖPOSTITSE

Puhelinhakemuksia emme käsittele.

Pitkää hakemusta ei tarvita. Lähetä lyhyt sähköposti **suomeksi tai venäjäksi** ja vastaa seuraaviin kysymyksiin:

1. Kuinka paljon sinulla on kokemusta automekaanikon työstä?

2. Mitkä korjaukset pystyt tekemään täysin itsenäisesti?

3. Oletko tehnyt jakohihnan/jakopään vaihtoja itsenäisesti?

4. Millainen kokemus sinulla on diagnostiikasta ja autosähköstä?

5. Onko sinulla kokemusta rengastöistä ja ilmastointihuolloista?

6. Onko sinulla voimassa oleva B-ajokortti?

7. Mikä on palkkatoiveesi?

8. Milloin voisit aloittaa?

9. Miksi etsit uutta työpaikkaa ja millaista työpaikkaa etsit pidemmällä aikavälillä?


**Hakemukset ja yhteydenotot ainoastaan sähköpostitse ekodrivepro@gmail.com**

**Ekodrive Oy Kerava**

jobs.title: Senior Accountant Central Europe
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Accountant Central Europe for a company in Gothenburg. Start is ASAP, 8 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Assignment description and main responsibilities

    

Manage and oversee - together with Group Accounting and SSC team - all accounting operations, including billing, accounts receivable/payable, general ledger, and inventory accounting.

    

Lead Shared service team (SSC) with the SSC Team leads, review and oversee all activities related to the month-end, half-year and year-end close processes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness in coordination with internal teams (group accounting, tax.).

    

Secure implementation of accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls in liaison with HQ Finance teams and Group Accounting.

    

Safeguard company assets and ensure SOX compliance. SoX controls performed by SSC team.

    

Prepare and present financial statements with SSC, EY, Auditors.

    

Review reconciliations, prepare reports, and analyses to senior leadership. (SSC team performing the monthly reconciliations)

    

Ensure compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations, and all relevant legal requirements in liaison with HQ Group Accounting, Tax and Technical Accounting.

    

Manage partnerships with external auditors, tax/regulatory authorities.

    

Drive process improvements requests and leverage technology to increase efficiency and accuracy.

    

Provide leadership and oversight across a shared service accounting function, ensuring alignment with company standards, service level agreements, and seamless integration with internal operation

﻿

Collaborate with:

    

Group Accounting, Tax, Internal Control & SSC team* to ensure monthly closing, compliance with Local legal/Group policies and Statutory filing on time.

    

Cross functional teams across the PSUs and Regions Governance and Control – secure execution and improvement of internal controls set by our global internal control team.

    

Liaise with external and internal auditors and ensure compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley controls.

﻿

*SSC responsible for performing R2R, AP/AR, Cash & Bank activities

﻿

Deliveries

The Senior Accounting Manager for Central Europe will play an important role in managing the core accounting and financial report functions and operational efficiencies in the region. You will lead our accounting and financial report operations through strategic guidance, deep understanding of accounting principles and regulatory compliance. You will play a pivotal role in shaping our financial future, ensuring compliance, and supporting our mission to deliver exceptional value to our customers and stakeholders. This role will be a key member of our finance community, ensuring consistent alignment across our business units and seamless integration of accounting operations in Central Europe, which today consists of a group of legal entities located in Austria, Germany and Switzerland. This role reports to the Regional CFO.

﻿

Competence requirements

    

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field required.

    

Master’s Degree in a related field, MBA and/or CPA Certification preferred.

    

5-10 years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.

    

Proven experience managing and collaborating across shared service accounting teams, ensuring high-quality performance and effective partnership.

    

Experience in the automotive industry or a related sector is strongly preferred.

    

Deep knowledge of GAAP/IFRS, financial reporting, and compliance requirements for the markets within the region.

    

Proven abilities working for a U.S. listed company environment with strong understanding of Sarbanes-Oxley Act and other regulatory requirements.

    

Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.

    

Proficient in accounting software and ERP systems; experience with dealership management systems a plus.

    

Skilled at identifying process gaps and driving optimization initiatives across various functions.

    

Thrives in a fast-paced environment with a passion for innovation and teamwork.

﻿

Other requirements

    

Fluent in English. German, Italian and French a plus.

    

Ability to navigate complexity in matrixed organizations

    

Strong prioritization abilities both in your own scope, your team, and deliverables to best support business objectives

﻿

This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 8 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a position as PhD Research Fellow in bioinformatics and computational biology available at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen), Campus Ahus, University of Oslo.

 

The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.

 

The fellowship period is three years and is free of any teaching obligations. No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

 

The position is based at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen; https://epigenahuscom.wordpress.com/) at the University of Oslo, Ahus Campus, Lørenskog. EpiGen is a joint research unit established by the University of Oslo (UiO) and Akershus University Hospital (Ahus). It is actively involved in several major national research initiatives and provides an outstanding research environment with state-of-the-art laboratories and dedicated research facilities. The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway.

 

 

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary team of molecular biologists, bioinformaticians, physicists, and pathologists to develop a biophysically interpretable machine learning model that integrates diverse biological data—including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenetic features, and three-dimensional (3D) genome organization—to identify functional long-range gene regulatory interactions in cancer. The candidate will work with researchers at UiO, Ahus, and Oslo University Hospital (OUS), as well as by international collaborators in the United States. The research conducted during the appointment is expected to culminate in a PhD thesis submitted to the University of Oslo.

 

We seek a highly motivated candidate with a strong background in molecular biology, human genetics/genomics, data mining, machine learning, and computational programming. The ideal candidate will hold a Master's degree in bioinformatics or computational biology. Applicants with an MSc in physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or statistics are also encouraged to apply, provided they can demonstrate a strong interest and aptitude for learning molecular biology and human genetics.


More about the position

The project aims to develop novel computational methods and tools for predicting functional non-coding mutations in the cancer genome. These methods will integrate diverse sources of information, including the biophysical principles of protein–DNA interactions, the genetic and epigenetic features of DNA sequences, and the three-dimensional (3D) organization of the genome and its regulatory landscape. A particular focus will be on integrating multi-omics data generated from single-cell experiments to improve both predictive accuracy and biological interpretability.

 

The PhD research fellow will primarily focus on developing data mining methods such as network analysis in 3D genome regulation that integrate diverse biological information, including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenetic features, and 3D genome organization, to identify functional non-coding mutations and their targets in long-distance regions. Subsequently, the predictions will be validated in cancer by using both in vivo and in vitro experimental data.

 

Depending on the candidate's qualifications and the progress of the project, there may be an opportunity to undertake a 3–6-month research visit to the laboratory of one of our international collaborators in the United States. This visit will provide advanced training in computational approaches for studying single-cell 3D genome regulation and further strengthen the international collaboration.


What skills are important in this role?

Candidates for the PhD fellowships will be expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

 

Required qualifications:

  • To be admitted to the PhDprogramme at the University ofOslo, an applicant musthave a five-year master'sdegree or equivalent studiesthat the faculty have recognised as forminga sufficient basisfor admission.
  • The facultiesmay stipulate additional admission requirements.
  • To be employed as aPhD ResearchFellow, admission toa doctoral program is required,or a binding agreementfor admission must be in place. Normally, one must apply foradmission to a Ph.D. program within3 months after thestart of the research project leading tothe Ph.D. degree.
  • Good written and oral Englishproficiency.
  • Master's degree in bioinformatics or computational biology. Applicants with an MSc in physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or statistics are also encouraged to apply, provided they can demonstrate a strong interest and aptitude for learning molecular biology and the human genome.
  • Documented knowledge of statistical theory and methods, data mining, and machine learning methods.
  • Documented shell script, R, Python, and C programming skills. 
  • Documented experience in big data analysis.
  • Documented experience in high-throughput sequencing data analysis.

 

Language requirement:

  • Good written and oral English proficiency.
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
  • https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

 

Grade requirements:

  • The average grade point for the course in the Bachelor's degree must be C or better (Norwegian educational system)
  • The average grade point for the course in the Master's degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master's thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

 

 

 

Personal qualities 

  • Academic and personal ability to finish tasks on time
  • Ability to work either independently or collaboratively in an interdisciplinary team
  • Self-motivated to learn, easily adapted to new tasks, and interested in solving challenging scientific problems.
  • Good communication skills and openness to new perspectives

 

Desired qualifications

  • Experience with ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq/scATAC-seq, RNA-seq/scRNA-seq, WGS, WGBS, or Hi-C data analysis.
  • Experience in computational genome studies (e.g., TF-DNA interactions, gene networks, DNA mutations, and histone modifications). 
  • Experience with integrated multi-omics data analysis.aaa

 

Employment in the position is basedon a comprehensive assessment of allqualification requirements applicable tothe position, including 

personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningfultasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing toknowledge development, education, andenlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, andknowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. A pleasantand stimulatingwork environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5hours a week of exercise during working hours. A workplace with good development and careeropportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes,with beneficialmortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in the position as DoctoralResearch Fellow, position code1017 in the salary range of NOK 550 800 -600 000, depending oncompetence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent isdeducted in statutory contributions to theState Pension Fund.
  • Read more about the benefitsof working in thepublic sector at Employer Portal.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Application cover letter (statement of motivation and research interests) 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • A copy of the Master's thesis, a list of publications and academic works (maximum 5) that you wish to be considered by the committee
  • Certified copies of the original Bachelor and Master's degree diploma and the transcripts of records
  • Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
  • Contact information for at least 3 references (name, relation to the candidate, institutional email address and telephone number)

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


Contact information 

For further information, please contact:

  • Junbai Wang, junbai.wang@medisin.uio.no

 

For questions regarding Jobbnorge, please

  • Maren Retterstøl Olaisen, HR advisor, m.r.olaisen@medisin.uio.no

Place of service:

Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen)

University of Oslo, Ahus campus

1748 Lørenskog


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

    The ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high service quality.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience

It is a strong advantage if you have experience with:

    Zendesk

    Centra
    Technical troubleshooting within e-commerce
    Automation, AI-supported customer service tools or similar technologies
    Additional languages – German is particularly meritorious, as well as French or Dutch

How to Apply

Please send your CV and personal letter to madelene@stronger.se

In your application, we would especially like you to highlight if you have experience in any of the systems, technical areas or additional languages listed above, including your level of proficiency.

Please use “Customer Service Representative – Maternity Cover” as the subject line.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen), Campus Ahus, University of Oslo.
The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.
The appointment is for a period of three years. In accordance with University of Oslo regulations, no individual may be appointed to more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship period at the University.


The position is based at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen) at the University of Oslo, Campus Ahus, Lørenskog. EpiGen is a joint research unit established by the University of Oslo (UiO) and Akershus University Hospital (Ahus). The department is actively involved in several major national research initiatives and offers an outstanding research environment with state-of-the-art laboratories, advanced computational infrastructure, and dedicated research facilities. The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway.
The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary research team comprising molecular biologists, bioinformaticians, physicists, and pathologists. The project aims to develop a biophysically interpretable machine learning framework that integrates diverse biological data—including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenomic features, and three-dimensional (3D) genome organization—to identify functional long-range gene regulatory interactions in cancer. The postdoctoral researcher will collaborate closely with students, PhD candidates, researchers, and national and international partners. The work is expected to result in high-quality scientific publications as well as broadly applicable computational resources, such as open-source software and bioinformatics tools.

 

We seek a highly motivated and ambitious researcher with a strong background in molecular biology, human genetics/genomics, bioinformatics, machine learning, data mining, and computational programming, including software or package development. The ideal candidate will hold a PhD in bioinformatics or computational biology. Applicants with a PhD in related disciplines, such as computer science, physics, applied mathematics, statistics, or a closely related quantitative field, are also encouraged to apply, provided they demonstrate a strong interest in and commitment to applying computational methods to molecular biology and human genetics/genomics.


More about the position

The project aims to develop novel computational methods and tools for predicting functional non-coding mutations in the cancer genome. These methods will integrate diverse sources of biological information, including the biophysical principles governing protein–DNA interactions, the genetic and epigenetic features of DNA sequences, and the three-dimensional (3D) organization of the genome and its regulatory landscape. A particular emphasis will be placed on integrating multi-omics data generated from single-cell experiments to enhance both predictive accuracy and biological interpretability.


The Postdoctoral Research Fellow will primarily focus on developing a biophysically interpretable machine learning framework that integrates multiple layers of biological information, including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenetic features, and 3D genome organization, to identify functional long-range gene regulatory interactions from in vivo data. The candidate will also be involved in the validation of predictions from cancer genomes.
 

Throughout the fellowship, the Postdoctoral Research Fellow will be supported by a structured career development plan. This may include opportunities to teach and supervise bioinformatics students, present research at international conferences, and undertake research visits to leading international laboratories. The fellowship is designed to equip the candidate with the scientific expertise, professional skills, and international research experience needed to pursue a competitive research career within or beyond academia. The University of Oslo (UiO) is committed to supporting the Fellow's career development by providing ongoing mentoring and access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral appointment.


About the position

You must have
To be appointed as a postdoctoral fellow, a doctoral degree is required.

  • Good written and oral English proficiency.
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, or other relevant research fields to the project. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eligible for appointment.
  • Personal suitability and motivation for the project.
  • Documented knowledge of statistical theory and methods, data mining, and machine learning methods.
  • Documented shell script, R, Python, and C programming skills.
  • Documented experience in big data analysis and computational tool/package development.
  • Documented experience in high-throughput sequencing data analysis or computational genome regulation.
     

Personal qualities
 

  • Academic and personal ability to finish tasks on time
  • Ability to work either independently or collaboratively in an interdisciplinary team
  • Self-motivated to learn, easily adapted to new tasks, and interested in solving challenging scientific problems.

  • Good communication skills and openness to new perspectives

     

Desired qualifications
Experience with ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq/scATAC-seq, RNA-seq/scRNA-seq, WGS, WGBS, or Hi-C data analysis
Experience in computational genome studies (e.g., TF-DNA interactions, gene networks, DNA mutations, and histone modifications).
Experience with integrated multi-omics data analysis and software/package tool development

 

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.
 


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours. A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in the position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352, in a salary range from NOK 595000 to 679000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Application cover letter (statement of motivation and research interests)
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - a complete of scientific publications)
  • A complete list of publications and academic works (maximum 5; pdf files) that you wish to be considered by the committee
  • Certified copies of the original Master's and PhD diplomas and the transcripts of records
  • Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
  • Contact information for at least 3 references (name, relation to the candidate, institutional email address and telephone number)

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Additional information

junbai.wang@medisin.uio.no

contact HR Adviser:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

Vil du bidra til at flere barn, unge og voksne får oppleve gleden av aktivitet og friluftsliv – helt gratis?
Drammen kommune søker engasjerte og selvstendige tilkallingsvikarer til våre BUA-utstyrssentraler i Mjøndalen, på Fjell og ved vår nye BUA på Åssiden. 
Vi ser spesielt etter deg som har interesse for ski, friluftsliv og aktivitet, og som trives med å møte mennesker i alle aldre.

Om BUA
BUA er en gratis utlånsordning for sports- og fritidsutstyr som alle kan benytte akkurat som et bibliotek. Gjennom BUA ønsker Drammen kommune å bidra til:
- bedre folkehelse
- mindre sosiale forskjeller
- mer bærekraftig forbruk
- hele familien ut på tur

Hos oss kan alle låne utstyr til aktivitet og friluftsliv, uavhengig av økonomi.
BUA skal være et inkluderende møtested og et naturlig utgangspunkt.

Om stillingen
Som servicemedarbeider i BUA er du ansiktet utad for både BUA og Drammen kommune. Du møter mennesker med ulike behov og bidrar til gode opplevelser, enten det er en familie som skal på tur eller ungdom som ønsker å prøve skiutstyr for første gang.
Arbeidet foregår hovedsakelig på ettermiddag og kveld. I enkelte perioder, særlig i vintersesongen, må det påregnes høy aktivitet og stor pågang.
Det forventes at du kan jobbe på alle BUA-utstyrssentralene i Drammen. Dette vil si Mjøndalen, Svelvik, Fjell og Åssiden.

NB: Til denne stillingen ønsker vi ikke søknadsbrev, men heller at du svarer på konkrete spørsmål vi har laget. Svarene på spørsmålene sammen med CV vil bli brukt til vurdering av hvilke søkere som innehar de kvalifikasjoner vi er på utkikk etter og hvem blant disse som blir innkalt til intervju.

Søknader vurderes fortløpende. Aktuelle kandidater kan bli invitert til intervju før søknadsfristens utløp, så vi oppfordrer interesserte til å søke så snart som mulig.

  • Sørge for orden, system og god oversikt i utlånssystemet
  • Vedlikeholde, rengjøre og utføre enklere reparasjoner av utstyr
  • Følge opp utlån og purringer

  • Registrere og administrere utlån i digitale systemer
  • Bidra på arrangementer og aktivitetsdager gjennom året

Krav

  • Du har gode muntlige norskkunnskaper

Ønskelige kvalifikasjoner

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • er serviceinnstilt og liker å jobbe med mennesker
  • har interesse for friluftsliv og aktivitet
  • arbeider selvstendig og tar ansvar
  • trives i et arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo

  • er fleksibel og løsningsorientert

Personlige egenskaper vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

About the Role

As Technical Package Manager - Special Foundations, you will take technical ownership of all special foundation works within the project. The role requires a highly experienced specialist with extensive knowledge of both the design and construction of special foundation systems.

You will be responsible for reviewing and challenging engineering designs produced by external designers and consultants, ensuring that proposed solutions are technically sound, buildable, compliant, and suitable for construction. You will act as the key technical authority for foundation-related matters throughout the project lifecycle.



Key Responsibilities

·        Lead the technical management of the Special Foundations package throughout the project lifecycle.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the interaction between information systems and machine learning
jobs.employer: OSLO UNIVERSITETSSYKEHUS HF BEDRIFTSHELSETJENESTE OSLO UNIVERSITETSSYKEHUS
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in action-oriented modeling for trustworthy AI, available at the Department of Informatics, University of Oslo.

The starting date is no later than 01.03.2027 and as soon as possible after the appointment.

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years.

The fellowship is funded in full by TRUST for the whole period. No teaching, supervision, or research-assistance duties are required in the position, and the fellowship period can therefore not be extended to four years on that basis.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Informatics at the University of Oslo. The successful candidate will be part of the daily research and social life of TRUST – the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, and of the information systems research group.


Project description

The position is funded by TRUST, the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, which is a research centre dedicated to developing trustworthy AI systems that are accurate, fair, transparent, safe, and well-governed. The centre brings together researchers from computational and data science, law, social sciences, and philosophy to develop new AI technologies and study their societal impact in areas such as healthcare, industry, governance, security, and climate. TRUST is led by University of Oslo, SINTEF, and Norwegian Computing Center. With a consortium of over 70 partners from academia, industry, government, and civil society in Norway and internationally, TRUST’s research is theoretical, methodological, legal, and empirical in nature.

The postdoc will conduct the research project Action-Oriented Modeling for Trustworthy AI in Practice. The project addresses a persistent problem in applied AI: statistically accurate models routinely fail when they meet the organizations and ecosystems meant to use them. Models are misaligned with local procedures and decision processes, too rigid for resource-constrained operational systems, and opaque to the decision-makers who must act based on them. We treat this as a methodological problem rather than a technical one.

The primary deliverable of this position is a theoretical and methodological template that we call Action-Oriented Modeling. Rather than delivering finished algorithms, the template specifies how to build deliberately context-agnostic model architectures that expose methodological choices as parameters, and how local actors then configure, tune, and operate them. Its novelty lies in integrating three dimensions normally treated separately: configurable architectures that let domain experts shape model behavior without machine learning expertise; iterative field validation inside operational workflows; and governance mechanisms that transfer model ownership to local users.

The successful candidate will lead the development of this template into a generic, transferable, and theoretically grounded contribution. Your main tasks are to:

  • Develop, formalize, and publish the Action-Oriented Modeling template. This is the central output
  • Validate the template empirically through an action research design approach supplemented by participatory design methods
  • Define governance principles for model ownership that let stakeholders revise models as operational contexts change
  • Coordinate collaboration between the core development team, implementation partners, and local stakeholders, and act as a competence hub for action-oriented AI across TRUST

Two contrasting cases provide the empirical ground. The primary case is climate-sensitive disease prediction supporting public health decisions in low- and middle-income countries, built on DHIS2 and the action research network of the Health Information Systems Programme (HISP), with national health teams in ten countries. The complementary case is KoSy, the DHIS2-based municipal surveillance platform run by the Norwegian Institute of Public Health. We seek a candidate motivated by the methodological contribution to these and other empirical settings.

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in information systems, informatics, computer science, science and technology studies, or another relevant field. The applicant must document that the degree corresponds to the requirement. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eventually eligible for appointment
  • Documented experience with engaged, qualitative research methods in organizational settings, such as action research, design science research, or participatory design
  • Documented ability to publish conceptual, theoretical, or methodological contributions in high-ranking peer-reviewed journals or conferences
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience conducting sociotechnical research on information systems, examining how technology, people, and organizational contexts interact
  • Understanding of machine learning and predictive modeling sufficient to engage critically and constructively with data scientists, for example on data quality and model assumptions
  • Technical skills sufficient to deploy and test models

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

In terms of personal skills:

  • You are motivated by methodological questions, enjoy qualitative fieldwork, and are excited about the academic challenge of turning messy empirical data into clear theoretical contributions
  • You work well both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team, and you communicate across the boundary between technical and institutional expertise
  • You collaborate respectfully and effectively with practitioners and decision-makers who are not researchers
  • You work in a professional and structured manner and adapt quickly to new tasks
  • You are dependable and high-performing, also in hectic periods
  • You prefer being present at work and contribute actively to the professional and social environment you are part of

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • A position at the centre of a national research effort on trustworthy AI, with access to the TRUST network and to operational partners in ten countries
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter, stating your motivation, summarizing your scientific work, and describing your research interests. The cover letter should not be written with the help of AI
  • A research statement of no more than three pages, setting out how you would approach the development and validation of the Action-Oriented Modeling template. The statement must connect clearly to the development of the template, and it is the main basis on which the evaluation committee will assess your fit for the position
  • CV summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activity
  • Copies of educational certificates and academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that you wish to be considered by the evaluation committee. Please link these 5 publications, do not send them, except if they are still in manuscript format
  • Names and contact details of 2 to 3 references, with name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and telephone number

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Oslo.

If an applicant has applied for and been granted funding for a fulltime research stay abroad while being employed as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, the employment will be prolonged with the equivalent time as the research stay, but for no longer than of twelve months ( thus extending the employment to a maximum of four years).

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít.
