jobs.title: Client Advisor
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptalâs value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptalâs full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the clientâs concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
  • Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the clientâs needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the clientâs broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.
  • Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptalâs service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptalâs model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the clientâs need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
  • Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
  • Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
  • Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.
  • Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 2â3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).
  • Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
  • Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
  • Exposure to a named sales methodology â MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch.
  • Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk â and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a clientâs thinking when their stated request isnât the best path to their goal.
  • Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isnât the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.

jobs.description:
Murersvend søges til Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS i Bagsværd.

Vil du have frihed under ansvar, firmabil og fleksible arbejdstider? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig!

Om stillingen

Hos Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS søger vi en dygtig og kvalitetsbevidst murersvend til alsidigt og varieret murerarbejde.

Du får stor frihed i hverdagen, arbejder selvstændigt og får mulighed for selv at planlægge og tilrettelægge dine opgaver. Afhængigt af opgaven arbejder du enten alene, sammen med en kollega eller som en del af et større hold.

Du bliver en del af en stabil virksomhed med ca. 20 engagerede kollegaer, hvor vi lægger vægt på ordnede forhold, godt samarbejde og frihed under ansvar.

Vi tilbyder

  • Firmabil, som kan tages med hjem (jf. gældende regler)

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at planlægge din arbejdsdag

  • Fleksible arbejdstider

  • God lønpakke efter kvalifikationer

  • Fast fuldtidsansættelse

  • Ordnede arbejdsforhold

  • Stabilt arbejde og en god ordrebeholdning

  • Alsidige opgaver – både mindre serviceopgaver og større byggesager

  • Gode kollegaer og korte beslutningsveje

  • En fast og tryg arbejdsplads i en solid virksomhed

Dine opgaver kan bl.a. være

  • Renovering og reparation af eksisterende bygninger

  • Opmuring i mursten, Leca og porebeton

  • Reparation og pudsning af vægge, lofter og facader

  • Facaderenovering, netpuds og forskellige pudssystemer

  • Efterisolering og facadeisolering

  • Reparation af murværk og fuger

  • Tagarbejde, herunder tegl, rygninger og grater

  • Flisearbejde, badeværelser, gulve og vægge

  • Mindre ombygninger og renoveringsopgaver

  • Spjæld- og servicearbejde hos private, erhverv og offentlige kunder

  • Større byggesager, hvor du arbejder sammen med vores øvrige håndværkere

Det er ikke et krav, at du kan eller ønsker at udføre alle typer murerarbejde. Hvis du eksempelvis ikke arbejder med fliser, tagarbejde eller spjæld/service, er det ikke nødvendigvis et problem. Vi har forskellige typer opgaver og forsøger at bruge vores medarbejdere dér, hvor deres erfaring og kompetencer passer bedst.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet murer og har erfaring fra faget

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Kan planlægge og gennemføre dine egne opgaver

  • Sætter en ære i godt håndværk og kvalitet

  • Har en god omgangstone over for kunder og kollegaer

  • Er stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har kørekort B

  • Har lyst til en arbejdsplads med stor frihed og ansvar

Om os

Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS er en solid entreprenørvirksomhed med base i Bagsværd og ca. 20 medarbejdere.

Vi udfører bygge- og renoveringsopgaver for private, erhverv, boligforeninger og offentlige bygherrer. Vi arbejder med både murer- og tømrerarbejde samt fag- og hovedentrepriser.

Hos os lægger vi vægt på kvalitet, ordentlighed, godt samarbejde og frihed under ansvar. Vi ønsker, at vores medarbejdere har plads til selv at tilrettelægge deres arbejde og tage ansvar for deres egne opgaver.

Ansøgning

Stillingen er fast og på fuld tid, og vi ønsker tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til:

Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS
Att.: Johnni Regnarsson
E-mail: johnni@gladsaxebyg.dk

jobs.title: Head of Medium Gas Turbine Controls in Engineering
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

You start your day collaborating with engineering leaders, project teams and regional stakeholders to align priorities, resources and customer needs. Throughout the day, you guide strategic initiatives, support project execution, review organizational capabilities and drive continuous improvement activities. You work closely with product management, project execution and regional organizations to strengthen collaboration, develop talent and ensure high-quality controls solutions. By balancing people leadership, operational excellence and business objectives, you help position the Medium Gas Turbine Controls organization for sustainable growth and long-term success.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Strategic leadership and development of the global Medium Gas Turbine Controls engineering organization, fostering collaboration, accountability, continuous learning and high performance
    Alignment of organizational capabilities, competencies and workforce planning with business growth objectives, future market demands and long-term strategy
    Implementation of the Medium Gas Turbine Controls Service growth plan in close collaboration with regional organizations
    Delivery of high-quality, efficient and reliable engineering execution with a strong focus on customer value, project performance and business results
    Harmonization and continuous improvement of engineering processes, methodologies, standards and digital solutions to increase efficiency, quality and scalability
    Strengthening of cross-functional collaboration, talent development, succession planning and operational excellence across engineering, project execution, product management and regional teams

What You Bring

    Engineering degree or comparable technical background with experience in controls, automation, electrical engineering or related disciplines
    Solid professional experience in Medium Gas Turbines and/or turbine control systems
    Proven leadership experience with a strong commitment to developing people, building high-performing teams and creating an inclusive work environment
    Strong customer orientation and ability to translate business requirements into sustainable and effective engineering solutions
    Strategic mindset, curiosity and passion for innovation, continuous improvement, digitalization and positive organizational change
    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international environment, fluent English language skills, Swedish language proficiency as an advantage and willingness to travel as required

About the Team

The Medium Gas Turbine (MGT) Controls organization, part of Controls, Digitalization & Nuclear Controls (CD&NUC), is responsible for developing, selling, and delivering innovative and reliable control solutions for the global MGT fleet. Our solutions enable efficient, sustainable, and reliable power generation worldwide.
As a key contributor to a growing business, we combine deep technical expertise with a strong customer focus and a commitment to operational excellence. Our team of approximately 50 professionals, organized across six specialized sub-teams, drives the full spectrum of MGT controls activities, including sales enablement and bid managment, research and development, project execution, and service.

Covering all phases of the control system lifecycle, we play a critical role in shaping the future of MGT controls technology while supporting our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of their assets.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

jobs.title: Directeur d'hôtel (H/F)
jobs.description:
La bonne compétence, au bon endroit, au bon moment.

Chez Potentiel Humain, ce n'est pas qu'un slogan, c'est une façon de travailler.

Cabinet de conseil en compétences, nous accompagnons les entreprises de Montpellier, Nîmes, Béziers et Perpignan dans leurs enjeux humains et stratégiques.

Nos expertises :

- Recrutement CDI / CDD / Intérim
- Management de transition / Temps partagé / Freelancing
- Formation sur mesure

Nous recrutons pour notre client, un hôtel situé au cœur du village naturiste du Cap d'Agde, un Directeur d'Hôtel H/F.

Caractéristiques :

- Type de contrat : CDD saisonnier
- Durée : de mars à fin octobre 2027
- Lieu de mission : Cap d'Agde
- Démarrage : mars 2027
- Base horaire : 6 jours sur 7, de 9h à 19h lorsque l'hôtel est ouvert ; 5 jours sur 7 lorsque l'hôtel est fermé
- Rémunération proposée : 3 846 € brut mensuel
- Statut : Cadre

Dans le cadre de ce poste, vous aurez la responsabilité du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement et de la qualité de l'expérience proposée aux clients.

Vous aurez pour principales missions :

- Piloter l'ouverture et la fermeture saisonnières de l'hôtel : préparation des chambres, anticipation des besoins, gestion des stocks et coordination des opérations nécessaires au démarrage et à la fin de saison.
- Superviser l'exploitation quotidienne : contrôle de la qualité et de la propreté des chambres, suivi du linge, des consommables, du bar, du snacking et des produits d'entretien.
- Assurer le suivi administratif et financier courant : contrôle des facturations, clôtures journalières dans le logiciel hôtelier, vérification de la caisse et des tickets, traitement des remboursements si nécessaire et suivi des fournisseurs.
- Organiser l'activité et manager les équipes : optimisation du planning et de l'occupation des chambres, recrutement et suivi de l'équipe de ménage, coordination des différents intervenants et renfort opérationnel lors des pics d'activité.
- Garantir une expérience client de qualité : superviser l'accueil et le service, être attentif aux attentes de la clientèle et personnaliser la relation avec les clients fidèles.
- Coordonner les prestataires et préparer les saisons suivantes : suivi des interventions et travaux, gestion des services complémentaires en haute saison, suivi des réservations, des mails et du courrier hors période d'ouverture.

Polyvalent(e) et présent(e) sur le terrain, vous pourrez également renforcer ponctuellement les équipes, notamment à la réception, au bar ou sur l'activité snacking, lorsque l'activité le nécessite.

Comment notre client vous imagine ?

Vous justifiez d'une expérience de 5 à 10 ans minimum sur un poste similaire dans l'hôtellerie et maîtrisez les différents enjeux liés au fonctionnement quotidien d'un établissement.

Votre anglais vous permet d'échanger avec aisance avec une clientèle internationale, aussi bien à l'oral que dans les échanges professionnels courants.

Manager de terrain, vous savez organiser l'activité, encadrer une équipe et prendre des décisions tout en restant disponible pour intervenir opérationnellement lorsque la situation le demande.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre sens du service, votre organisation, votre fiabilité et votre réactivité. À l'aise dans la relation client, vous savez vous adapter à une clientèle exigeante et instaurer une relation professionnelle et personnalisée.

Votre polyvalence constitue un véritable atout : gestion administrative, suivi des prestataires, organisation des équipes, contrôle des chambres ou soutien aux différents services font partie d'un quotidien que vous appréciez.

Enfin, vous disposez d'un réel sens commercial et savez identifier les attentes des clients afin de leur proposer un service adapté.

Inspired by Andalusian hospitality we bring people together, bold flavours, lively energy and urban surroundings to create unforgettable dining experiences.

Part of Urban Italian Group

Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.

The Role

As a Waiter, you will be at the heart of the guest experience. You will welcome guests, guide them through the menu, take orders, serve food and drinks, and help create the great service Lola Maria is known for.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys people, works well in a busy restaurant and takes pride in making guests feel looked after from start to finish.

What you'll be doing

    

Welcoming guests with warmth, confidence and positive energy.

    

Delivering attentive service throughout the guest experience.

    

Taking orders accurately and sharing menu recommendations.

    

Serving food and drinks with care, pace and attention to detail.

Working closely with the team to support smooth, high-energy shifts.

You'll thrive in this role if you

We’re looking for someone with great personality, positive attitude and a genuine love for hospitality.

    

Previous restaurant or hospitality experience.

    

A warm, friendly and confident way with guests.

    

Good communication skills and a team-first mindset.

    

Ability to stay calm and organised during busy service.

    

Interest in food, drinks and creating great guest experiences.

    

Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and busy periods.

    

Willingness to learn, help and be hands-on.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Entrepreneurship, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

What do we offer?

    

Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

    

Build your career across multiple brands and countries.

    

Work alongside talented people who genuinely love hospitality.

    

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

    

Shared accommodation (where applicable).

    

Friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

jobs.title: Ingénieur de production DEVOPS (H/F)
jobs.employer: UCC EXPERTS UNIFIED COMMUNICATION AND CO
jobs.description:
Ingénieur DevOps Cloud / Kubernetes (H/F)
1. Contexte du Poste & Enjeux à Toulouse
Expérience requise : 9 ans minimum (profil Senior / Expert).
Localisation : Toulouse et agglomération (Blagnac, Labège, etc.).

Contexte local :
Missions Principales
Architecture & Design de Plateformes Cloud : Concevoir, bâtir et faire évoluer les architectures Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP ou Cloud Souverain) et on-premise hautement disponibles, scalables et sécurisées.
Stratégie Kubernetes & Containerisation : Définir la stratégie de conteneurisation globale de l'entreprise, industrialiser le déploiement des clusters Kubernetes à grande échelle et garantir leur résilience.
Industrialisation & Automatisation (CI/CD) : Concevoir les pipelines d'intégration et de déploiement continus (CI/CD) les plus optimisés possibles pour automatiser le cycle de vie applicatif du code à la production.
FinOps & Performance : Optimiser les coûts d'infrastructure Cloud (démarche FinOps) et veiller aux performances globales des environnements.

Leadership Technique & Culture DevOps : Porter la culture DevOps/DevSecOps au sein des équipes, évangéliser les bonnes pratiques, rédiger les standards d'architecture et mentorer les ingénieurs juniors/seniors.

3. Compétences Techniques Détaillées (Hard Skills)
A. Containerisation & Écosystème Kubernetes (Expertise Majeure)
Orchestration : Maîtrise approfondie de Kubernetes (architecture des control planes, etcd, kube-proxy, CNI, CSI). Expérience sur les managed clusters (EKS, AKS, GKE) et on-premise (Rancher, OpenShift, k3s).

Networking & Service Mesh : Configuration des CNI (Calico, Cilium, Flannel), gestion des Ingress Controllers (NGINX, Traefik) et mise en place de Service Mesh (Istio, Linkerd) pour la gestion du trafic inter-services.

Stockage & Stateful : Gestion des volumes persistant (CSI, StorageClasses, Rook/Ceph, NFS).

Package Management : Maîtrise de Helm pour le templating et le packaging d'applications.

B. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Providers
Cloud Publics : Maîtrise avancée d'au moins un grand Cloud provider (AWS ou Azure / GCP), ou des environnements OpenStack / VMware pour les contextes on-premise/privés.

IaC & Provisioning : Maîtrise absolue de Terraform / OpenTofu (gestion d'état, modules, remote state) et Ansible pour la configuration.

Immutable Infrastructure : Utilisation d'outils comme Packer pour la génération d'images de VM/conteneurs.

C. CI/CD & Automatisation du Software Delivery
Pipelines CI/CD : Conception de chaînes d'intégration complexes avec GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Argo CD ou Jenkins.

GitOps : Implémentation de paradigmes GitOps avec ArgoCD ou FluxCD pour synchroniser l'état des clusters Kubernetes avec les repositories Git.

D. Observabilité, Monitoring & SRE
Supervision & Métriques : Déploiement et administration de Prometheus, Thanos, Cortex, et design de dashboards sur Grafana.

Centralisation des Logs & Tracing : Maîtrise des stacks d'observabilité (ELK / EFK, Grafana Loki, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry).

Fiabilité (SRE) : Définition des SLO, SLA et SLI, gestion des alertes et automatisation de la remédiation (incident response).

E. Sécurité (DevSecOps) & Compliance
Software Supply Chain Security : Analyse de vulnérabilités des images (Trivy, Clair), signature d'images (Cosign), SBOM (Software Bill of Materials).

jobs.title: Senior Experience Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.

Our remote-first, global team develops open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

About the Team

This role sits in our Acceleration department, home to the people who drive ecosystem growth by building tools, integrations, and partnerships across the Polkadot network.

Reporting into our Polkadot Research Lead, you’ll be joining the Polkadot Research Engineering team. We shape the Polkadot research vision and roadmap, translating ecosystem needs into tools and experiences that accelerate platform adoption.

About the Role

As a Senior Experience Engineer , you will lead the end-to-end delivery of features, from initial problem discovery to production deployment. This role is designed for a self-directed builder who prioritizes "what" to build as much as "how" to build it. You will leverage an AI-native workflow to iterate rapidly and deliver high-impact solutions to complex user problems.

What you’ll do

  • Full-Lifecycle Ownership: Lead feature development through scoping, architecture, deployment, and iteration based on live user data.

  • AI-Augmented Development: Integrate AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, Claude) into your daily workflow to accelerate velocity and maximize output.

  • Autonomous Decision-Making: Navigate ambiguity by exercising sound judgment, filling requirement gaps without waiting for exhaustive specifications.

  • Rapid Iteration: Deploy MVPs quickly to gather real-world feedback, avoiding over-engineering in favor of momentum and validated learning.

  • Direct Collaboration: Partner with stakeholders and users to deeply understand pain points and translate them into functional, scalable software.

  • Cross-Functional Execution: Work proactively across the organization to remove blockers and maintain a high shipping cadence.

Your Skills

  • Proven experience developing and maintaining production-grade web applications (ideally with TypeScript, React, or similar frameworks).

  • Strong understanding of frontend architecture, component-driven development, and modern build pipelines.

  • Possess a good understanding of system design and an ability to work with complex systems.

  • Strong product intuition for applying AI to solve real user problems and ship features that deliver genuine value.

About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome

Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles.

jobs.title: Total Rewards Manager
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL

You? A rewards expert with a sharp analytical mind, proven project management skills, and a passion for using technology and AI to drive strategic impact in a fast-paced environment.

Role? Total Rewards Manager joining Vend’s Rewards team to drive our multi-year rewards strategy, lead high-impact projects and roadmaps and mentor our growing team.

Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.

Why us? This is your chance to shape the evolution of rewards in a listed company environment, lead high-impact projects end-to-end, drive the strategic implementation and communication of our multi-year rewards roadmap, and translate complex structures into clear narratives – aligning key stakeholders and acting as a vital mentor to our growing team in a supportive and forward-thinking environment.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

    You have 4+ years of experience in Rewards, with a solid grasp of the Nordic compensation landscape, benefits, and compliance frameworks. Experience with navigating collective agreements and labour union relationships is an advantage.
    You have experience driving end-to-end reward processes and steering compensation frameworks to successfully embed a pay-for-performance culture.
    You possess strong project management skills – a background in management consulting or fast-paced corporate environments is an advantage.
    You are commercially sharp and analytical, able to transform complex data into clear narratives and strategic recommendations.
    You have a genuine enthusiasm for technology, with an eagerness to experiment with AI and are comfortable leveraging HRIS modules to audit data, build automated workflows and optimise reward processes.
    You have strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate a cross-border organisation and guide the organisation through structural changes.
    You bring an approachable, empathetic presence to our data-driven discipline, allowing you to engage different audiences effectively and establish credibility.

WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?

Day-to-day work & projects cooking As a Total Rewards Manager, your mission is to be a key player in delivering Vend's reward strategy. Your work will span the full spectrum of rewards – driving the strategic implementation and continuous evolution of our multi-year roadmap, while acting as a vital partner in shaping future rewards.

You will lead key projects end-to-end, drive reward core cycles (compensation reviews, bonus cycles), and ensure governance is coordinated across HR, Finance, and our cross-border business verticals. The role ranges from developing competitive compensation frameworks to support in preparation of the Board’s Compensation Committee meetings.

A core part of your role will be "working smarter" — you will critically review existing processes to identify opportunities for automation and digitization using AI and data analytics.

The challenge to turn into an opportunity!

You will operate in a fast-paced environment where multiple high-impact priorities run concurrently. This challenge is your opportunity to take ownership from day one, influence strategic compensation decisions at the highest level, and directly impact Vend's long-term performance culture and growth.

A few words from Quttab Aslam, Director of Total Rewards

Hi, I'm Quttab — Director of Total Rewards! Our team is collaborative, curious, and genuinely passionate about making rewards work better. We value ownership, continuous improvement, and the use of technology to work smarter. We operate at pace across a wide range of topics – from executive compensation and Board reporting to process design and analytics – and we're at our best when everyone brings their perspective to the table. Ultimately, I am looking for a true strategic sparring partner who can help design our future initiatives while actively mentoring and growing our team. If you're someone who takes initiative, thrives with autonomy, and wants to do meaningful work in a listed company environment, we'd love to hear from you.

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!

The latest date to apply is the 21st of October. Please apply and tell us why this challenge speaks to you!

QUESTIONS?

José Carlos Reis, Talent Acquisition, is happy to provide information together with Quttab Aslam, Director of Total Rewards, about the daily work and answer any questions you may have!

Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!

At Vend, our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy.

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.

At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

jobs.title: Spesialfysioterapeut / Fysioterapeut
jobs.description:
Seksjon for fysioterapi har flere vikariater ledig! 
Flere av våre dyktige ansatte har frikjøpt tid til forskning og utvikling, i tillegg har vi fire som skal ha foreldrepermisjon. Vi har derfor flere vikariater ledig med ulik stillingsprosent. 

  • Vikariat 1: 100% 06.10.26-22.08.27 (kombinert vikariat og sommervikariat)
  • Vikariat 2: 100% 06.01-10.9.27
  • Vikariat 3: 100%: 06.01-27.09.27
  • Vikariat 4: 100% 06.01-01.10
  • Vikariat 5: 100% 06.01-22.08 (kombinert vikariat og sommervikariat)
  • Vikariat 6: 40-100% 06.01-30.6 

I vår fysioterapiseksjon er vi i overkant av 20 svært kompetente og driftige fysioterapeuter.
Seksjonens fysioterapeuter jobber til daglig i hovedsak med inneliggende pasienter. Vi behandler en rekke ulike pasientkategorier på intensivavdelingene, sengeposter og i treningssal. Hovedvekten av våre pasienter er:

  • Hjerte: hjerte-/karkirurgi, hjertetransplantasjon og kardiologiske pasienter
  • Lunge: lungetransplantasjon og lungeoperasjoner
  • ØNH: voksne pasienter operert for cancer
  • Gastro/transplantasjon: gastrokirurgi, gastromedisin, nyretransplanterte, levertransplanterte
  • Pasienter på sengepost for Blodsykdommer og Infeksjon

Hverdagen vår er varierende, størstedelen av våre behandlinger er på sengepost, men vi har også noe poliklinisk drift i intensiv- og bløderpoliklinikk. Vi er svært opptatt av faglig utvikling og setter fokus på evidensbasert tilgang gjennom kontinuerlig forbedringsarbeid. Vi er stolte av å ha et åpent og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø, som gjør at vi arbeider godt sammen, både internt og ut mot sengepostene.

Vi søker deg som ønsker å jobbe med våre pasientgrupper, og som har erfaring fra spesialisthelsetjenesten. Det er ønskelig at du har erfaring med intensivfysioterapi og er godt kjent med lungefysioterapi til ulike pasientgrupper.

 

Det er mulighet for forlengelse i enkelte vikariater. Ved intern ansettelse kan vikariater at ulik varighet og stillingsprosent bli ledig.

Intervjuer gjennomføres fortløpende.


Oslo universitetssykehus er en arbeidsplass med stort mangfold. Vi mener dette er avgjørende for å løse våre oppgaver på best mulig måte. Vi ønsker at dette mangfoldet skal gjenspeiles blant søkerne til våre stillinger, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater, uavhengig bakgrunn, til å søke!
Arbeidsoppgaver

Hvordan ser en arbeidshverdag ut? 

  • Pasientbehandling på sengeposter, intensivposter og i treningssal
  • Fortløpende elektronisk dokumentering.
  • Deltakelse i utviklingsprosjekter av større eller mindre grad.
  • Mulighet for turnusarbeid med helg/kveldsarbeid hver 5. helg.
Kvalifikasjoner

For å trives med arbeidsoppgaver hos oss, ser vi etter deg som har følgende kvalifikasjoner:

  • Autorisert fysioterapeut
  • Relevant sykehuserfaring etter autorisasjon
  • Interesse for intensivfysioterapi, lungefysioterapi og kirurgiske pasienter
  • Erfaring med kunnskapsbasert praksis
  • Gode skriftlige og muntlige norskkunnskaper
Vi ber om at relevant dokumentasjon legges ved søknaden.

 

Personlige egenskaper
  • har evnen til å samarbeide internt i team og på tvers av ulike fagmiljøer

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization) based in Switzerland.

You will work at the intersection of AI research, systems engineering, and high-performance model inference.
Your focus will be on developing and optimizing model-serving architectures for advanced AI systems across a range of hardware environments.
You will tackle challenges involving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and scalability, including deployment on resource-constrained mobile and edge devices.
The role combines hands-on research with low-level engineering, giving you the opportunity to develop novel inference strategies and GPU kernels.
You will work with complex architectures spanning text, image, audio, diffusion models, and vision transformers.
Your work will involve rigorous benchmarking, production testing, and iterative optimization to translate research into measurable performance improvements.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in a highly technical, remote environment focused on pushing the boundaries of efficient AI systems.


Accountabilities
  • Design and deploy advanced model-serving architectures optimized for high throughput, low latency, and efficient memory utilization.
  • Develop inference pipelines capable of operating effectively across diverse environments, including resource-constrained mobile devices and edge platforms.
  • Establish clear performance targets covering response latency, token generation speed, throughput, memory footprint, and reliability.
  • Build and execute controlled inference benchmarks in simulated and production environments, tracking latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates.
  • Create and maintain representative datasets and simulation scenarios for evaluating model performance under real-world and resource-constrained conditions.
  • Identify computational and memory bottlenecks across inference pipelines and implement solutions involving batching, networking, memory management, and other system-level optimizations.
  • Develop custom GPU kernels and compute shaders for mobile hardware, including solutions written in Metal Shading Language (MSL).
  • Apply advanced inference optimization techniques such as pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV caching, and speculative decoding.
  • Design and optimize distributed inference systems using approaches such as tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU workloads.
  • Work with cross-functional engineering and research teams to integrate optimized inference frameworks into production and edge-device applications.
  • Define evaluation methodologies, document experimental results, compare performance against established benchmarks, and continuously refine optimization strategies.
  • Monitor production performance and use empirical research to identify opportunities for further improvements in scalability, efficiency, and reliability.

    • Requirements:

    • Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; a PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related discipline is highly relevant, particularly with a strong AI research track record and publications at leading conferences.
    • Proven expertise in Metal Shading Language (MSL), including the ability to write custom compute shaders from scratch.
    • Demonstrated experience with low-level kernel optimization and inference optimization on mobile or other resource-constrained devices.
    • Track record of delivering measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications.
    • Deep understanding of modern model-serving architectures, inference engines, and optimization techniques for high-performance AI deployment.
    • Strong experience writing GPU kernels for mobile devices such as smartphones.
    • Practical experience developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from model optimization through production integration on constrained hardware.
    • Strong ability to apply empirical research and systematic experimentation to solve latency, computational, and memory challenges.
    • Experience designing robust evaluation and benchmarking frameworks for inference systems.
    • Knowledge of distributed inference techniques, including tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU clusters.
    • Deep understanding of the mathematical foundations and architecture of diffusion models and Vision Transformers.
    • Familiarity with modern inference optimization techniques including pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV Cache optimization, and speculative decoding such as EAGLE.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with an ability to investigate complex system bottlenecks and turn research findings into practical engineering solutions.
    • Excellent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, cross-functional technical teams.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on advanced AI systems spanning model serving, inference optimization, mobile computing, edge deployment, and large-scale distributed inference.
      • Remote-first working environment with an international team.
      • Exposure to cutting-edge AI research and practical systems engineering challenges.
      • Opportunity to contribute to performance-critical infrastructure where improvements can have a measurable impact on real-world AI applications.
      • Collaborative environment combining research-driven experimentation with hands-on engineering.
      • Opportunity to work with advanced model architectures including diffusion models, Vision Transformers, and multimodal systems.
      • Access to challenging technical problems involving GPU kernels, inference engines, memory optimization, and distributed computing.

jobs.title: Researcher in artificial intelligence for future healthcare solutions
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

An exciting position as Researcher is available in the Department of Computer Science within the TRUSTING project (https://trusting-project.eu/). The project is funded by the EU until 31st December 2028. The position is for one year initially. The research focuses on voice and language-based AI for psychosis relapse detection and will be conducted within a thriving research group that has recently received grants of excellence.

The goal is to contribute broadly to research on applications of AI in medicine, specifically to the development and validation of novel computational language models, algorithms, and tools for spoken language-based detection of schizophrenia relapse in 6 different languages.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. Ideally, you can start as soon as possible but must be able to start in the position in Tromsø within a reasonable time after receiving the offer. 


The project

TRUSTING is a research project where an international interdisciplinary team are developing a machine learning based monitoring system that leverages spoken language processing (SLP) and natural language processing (NLP) of speech recorded at home to calculate relapse risk. The developed monitoring system will be used in a forthcoming randomized clinical trial where the goal is to validate the clinical outcomes of those affected by schizophrenia. Within this project, we are seeking a researcher with a strong computer science background to take an active role in developing novel machine learning based systems and tools on the path towards clinical use and implementation of AI for the treatment and care of patients. The candidate will contribute broadly to the project to enable the development of new algorithms for clinical AI based on patient data from heterogeneous sources notably language/speech-based sources. The activity will focus on the development of a prototype implementation of early warning- and other AI-based decision support systems to study the effectiveness and safety of a novel clinical decision tool that is based on SLP/NLP and utilizes large language models. The monitoring system has three main parts, namely a secure backend for recording sounds from mobile phones, a platform for data cleaning and machine learning model development, and a front-end app used by the patients. Therefore, an interest in working with state-of-the-art MLOps technology is an advantage. The project will focus on interaction with clinicians, with a goal of closing the gap between foundational research in machine learning and the clinical use of machine learning methods for the benefit of patients from a healthcare point of view. Hence, the work will be conducted in a highly interdisciplinary research environment and the candidates will collaborate with an international team consisting of clinicians, researchers in science and technology, health, industry partners, as well as personnel responsible for ICT, data security, privacy concerns and more. 

The UiT team will collaborate with the other research teams within the TRUSTING consortium. 


Contact

Further information about the position and UiT is available by contacting: 

  • Professor Brita Elvevåg: phone +47 91993063; email: brita.elvevag@uit.no 
  • Professor Lars Ailo Bongo: phone +47 92015508; email: lars.ailo.bongo@uit.no 
  • Associate Prof. Sandra Just, phone +49 1771966546; email: sandra.a.just@uit.no

General and administrative questions: 

  • Head of administration Martin Fjellvang Osima, phone +47 77 64 62 44; email: martin.osima@uit.no 

Qualification requirements

We are looking for applicants with a strong background, interest and expertise in computer science research with a focus on machine learning methods for the health domain, with strong coding skills and familiarity with state-of-the-art machine learning frameworks. We would like an interested, active and highly motivated candidate who likes to explore new technologies, and who is an independent thinker but also a team player who will enjoy collaborating with other researchers and clinicians. 

The position requires 

  • a PhD degree in computer science or a related field (e.g., computational behavioral science) 
  • a publication record that document solid expertise in computer science
  • strong technical skills 
  • since the position is part of an interdisciplinary project, close interaction with other project participants will be required.
  • good communication skills in English are necessary and documented fluency in English is required.
  • personal suitability: Our working culture is important to us. We will emphasize the applicants motivation for the position and personal suitability. We are looking for candidates who display the following:
    • Collegial team player, ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff and contribute to a good working
      environment.
    • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
    • Interest in strategy and strategic development of the department.
    • Good communication skills and ability to engage with academic, stakeholder and public audiences.

 

An advantage:  

  • previous experience in natural language processing, sound-based machine learning, development and deployment of health technology software is considered a benefit. 
  • experience with explainable and interpretable AI methods applied within medical contexts, notably in clinical decision systems, would be an advantage. 
  • previous experience in systems development, data management, networking, and applied machine learning is also considered an advantage. 
  • it is also beneficial if the applicant has an interest and previous experience with inter-disciplinary or industry collaboration. 
  • candidates with research experience and relevant publications in conferences and journals will be considered with higher priority

For a permanent position as researcher it requires proficiency in a Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). New employees who do not fulfill the language criteria by appointment are required, within three years, to demonstrate sufficient proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Arrangements will be made to facilitate the completion of Norwegian courses.

During this assessment process, emphasis will be placed on your potential for research as evidenced by a thesis and any other academic works. In addition, we may consider work experience or other activities of significance. The assessment will emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position.

 At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA). 

UiT wishes to increase the proportion of females in academic positions. In cases where two or more applicants are found to be approximately equally qualified, female applicants will be given priority. 


Application

We will evaluate you based only on the documentation that you submit with the application. 

The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no and must contain:

  • Letter of application – this should include a short description of your background and its relevance to the advertised position, as well as a summary of your motivation for applying for this position. Please make it clear why you consider yourself qualified for this position and describe how you will strengthen the research activity in the research team (e.g., a vision statement).
  • CV with complete overview of education, supervised professional training, professional experience, and list of scientific publications.
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important and of relevance to this position. A brief description of the other listed works should also be included to demonstrate breadth of production. These descriptions shall be an attachment to the application. 
  • Description of your academic and software production and links to any open-source code.
  • Up to five academic works. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work. 
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all academic degrees) 
  • Contact information to 2-3 references 
  • Documentation of English proficiency 

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. We only accept applications and documentation sent via Jobbnorge within the application deadline. The applicant will be assessed by an expert committee. 


We offer
  • Participation in an excellent and thriving research group that has recently received a prestigious ERC Synergy grant (https://erc.europa.eu/news-events/news/synergy-grants-2023-examples-projects) 
  • A productive, collaborative, and stimulating environment with researchers working on cutting-edge medical applications of artificial intelligence and speech technologies
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement 
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • The possibility to balance professional development with a location to experience the liberating arctic nature: ski under the northern lights, hike and bike along the fjords 
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services. 
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details
    regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

 

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


Generel information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for
applicants.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment.
 

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.
 

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility
 

The remuneration for the position is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1109, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 670000 to 730000 (in a 100% position)  (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.)


A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. As a state employee, you will have one of the best pension schemes available. For more information see: spk.no

Employees who have been temporarily employed at UiT continuously for more than three years shall be deemed to be permanently employed, cf. the Civil Service Act § 9 (3).


According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence.

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

Pension scheme

5 weeks of vacation

Flexible benefits account

Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. We will agree on the schedule together, and working night shifts only is also an option.

The expected start date is 1 November 2026.

The first interview can be held online if needed. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the bakery before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications as they arrive, so please apply as soon as possible.

Send your application and CV to rekruttering@lolland.dk with "Baker - Maribo" in the subject line.

If you have questions, contact Martin Hansen, Business Consultant and EURES Adviser at Lolland Municipality, on +45 21 47 73 43 or maha@lolland.dk.

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and relocation support

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.

jobs.title: Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to build computer-vision technology that helps autonomous drones understand and navigate the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, edge computing, software, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer to take a leading technical role in developing and improving the perception capabilities behind our drone platform.You will work on challenging real-world problems where robust vision, accurate localisation and reliable performance matter. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys going beyond algorithms and prototypes to build computer-vision solutions that perform reliably in demanding real-world environments.

The role:
You will join a highly technical engineering team working on autonomy for drones and unmanned systems.You will take significant ownership of computer-vision capabilities supporting object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry and other perception-related challenges.You will work closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics colleagues to turn computer-vision concepts into robust, deployable solutions.As a senior engineer, you will also contribute to architecture and technical decisions, help strengthen engineering practices and share your experience with other engineers across the team.

What you will do:
- Design, develop, test and improve advanced computer-vision algorithms for Robotto's drone and autonomy platform.
- Take technical ownership of computer-vision problems from exploration and prototyping through implementation, evaluation and deployment.
- Work with object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM and related perception challenges.
- Build robust solutions that can perform under changing environmental and operational conditions.
- Optimise computer-vision solutions for deployment on edge and resource-constrained computing platforms.
- Define appropriate datasets, test scenarios, evaluation methods and performance metrics.
- Contribute to architecture and technical-design decisions across the perception stack.
- Collaborate closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics engineers to integrate perception capabilities into the wider platform.
- Investigate complex technical issues, validate results and drive practical improvements.
- Contribute to code quality, testing, documentation and engineering practices.
- Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to other engineers where relevant.

What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:
- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's autonomy platform, architecture and computer-vision priorities.
- You have taken ownership of one or more important perception challenges and are driving them towards robust solutions.
- You have contributed meaningful improvements to areas such as object detection, tracking, localisation or visual-inertial odometry.
- Your solutions are being evaluated against real-world data and operational scenarios.
- You are contributing to architecture and technical decisions across the computer-vision stack.
- You are collaborating effectively across computer vision, software, control and flight testing.
- You have become a trusted senior technical contributor within the engineering team.

What we are looking for:
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong computer-vision foundation and a track record of turning complex technical ideas into practical, working systems.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience preferred, with significant hands-on expertise in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, autonomy or a closely related field.
- Strong practical knowledge of computer vision, with experience in areas such as object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM or related perception methods.
- Strong C++ programming skills, with Python experience for algorithm development, experimentation, testing and prototyping.
- Experience taking computer-vision or machine-learning solutions beyond research and prototyping into real products or deployed systems.
- Experience designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for computer-vision applications.
- Experience deploying and optimising models or computer-vision algorithms on edge or resource-constrained computing platforms is highly relevant.
- Strong understanding of algorithm evaluation, datasets, testing methodologies and measurable performance criteria.
- Experience contributing to architecture or technical-design decisions within complex software or perception systems.
- A good understanding of how vision systems interact with cameras, sensors, software, compute platforms and real-world environments.
- Experience with drones, robotics, autonomous systems or embedded-adjacent software is a strong advantage.
- Experience mentoring, supporting or sharing technical knowledge with other engineers is an advantage.
- Professional fluency in English.
- A degree in computer vision, robotics, computer science, engineering or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent industry or research experience is equally welcome.

Who you are:
You are technically curious, analytical and comfortable taking ownership when the answer is not immediately obvious.You enjoy going deep into difficult technical problems, while keeping sight of the goal: building technology that works reliably in the real world.
- You take ownership of technical problems and drive them towards practical solutions.
- You are comfortable making technical decisions and explaining the trade-offs behind them.
- You challenge assumptions constructively and are willing to explore new approaches.
- You care about robustness, testing and measurable performance.
- You collaborate naturally across computer vision, software, control, electronics and flight testing.
- You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others solve difficult technical problems.
- You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as the company and technology develop.

More information and application:
https://careers.robotto.ai/jobs/8259919-senior-computer-vision-ai-engineer

Tässä tehtävässä työpäiväsi ovat monipuolisia, ja pääset oppimaan uutta sekä kehittämään osaamistasi käytännön tekemisen kautta. jobs.title: Senior Marketing & Growth Specialist
jobs.description:
Vire Advisors kasvaa, ja etsimme uutta osaajaa tiimiin. Keskeinen ajatuksemme **Vaikuttava HR ei ole käsityötä** ohjaa tekemistämme. Sinun tehtäväsi on auttaa tekemään siitä ajatus, jonka markkina tuntee, muistaa ja mielellään myös jakaa eteenpäin.

Autamme yrityksiä modernisoimaan johtamista ja HR-tekemistä teknologian, automaatioiden ja tekoälyn avulla. Samalla rakennamme omia teknologiaratkaisujamme, ja SaaS-alustamme **Arviro©** on nyt siinä vaiheessa, että se tarvitsee työbestiksen, jolla on markkinoinnin seniori-osaamista, vauhtia ja joka osaa vahvistaa SaaS tuotteistamisen kaupallista ajattelua.

Etsimme siis kokenutta **Senior Marketing & Growth Specialistia** vahvistamaan brändiämme, kasvattamaan näkyvyyttämme ja rakentamaan markkinointia, joka näkyy myös liiketoiminnan tuloksissa.

Roolissa yhdistyvät sisältömarkkinointi, sosiaalinen media, tapahtumat, digitaalinen näkyvyys ja kasvun rakentaminen. Etsimme ihmistä, joka osaa rakentaa suunnan mutta ei kavahda käytännön tekemistä.

**Mitä työssäsi teet?**

Vastaat Vire Advisors sisältömarkkinoinnin, sosiaalisen median ja kasvua tukevan markkinoinnin suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta yhdessä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- sisältökalenterin ja uusien sisältökonseptien rakentaminen

- LinkedIn- ja Instagram-sisältöjen suunnittelu ja toteutus

- blogien, uutiskirjeiden, asiakastarinoiden ja verkkosisältöjen kirjoittaminen

- asiantuntijoiden ajatusten jalostaminen sisällöiksi, joita muutkin kuin asiantuntijat haluavat lukea

- kampanjoiden, webinaarien, messujen ja asiakastilaisuuksien suunnittelu ja toteutus

- verkkosivujen, SEO:n ja AI-haun kehittäminen

- markkinointimateriaalien ja landing pagejen rakentaminen

- analytiikan, liidien ja eri kanavien tulosten seuranta

- markkinoinnin työkalujen ja tekoälyn aktiivinen hyödyntäminen.


Hyvä sisältö ei ole meille itseisarvo. Sen pitää rakentaa tunnettavuuutta, herättää kiinnostusta, vahvistaa asiantuntijabrändiä, synnyttää liidejä ja tukea myyntiä.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Etsimme kokenutta B2B-markkinoijaa, jolla on jo näyttöjä siitä, mitä on omalla osaamisellaan saavuttanut.

Toivomme sinulta:

- vahvaa kokemusta B2B-markkinoinnista

- vahvaa sisältömarkkinoinnin ja kirjoittamisen osaamista

- erittäin hyvää LinkedIn- ja Instagram-osaamista

- kokemusta tapahtumista, webinaareista ja kampanjoista

- ymmärrystä SEO:sta, verkkosivuista, analytiikasta ja liidien muodostumisesta

- hyvää visuaalista silmää

- vahvaa markkinoinnin työkalujen tuntemusta

- kykyä hyödyntää tekoälyä tehokkaasti omassa työssäsi

- erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen osaamista. Aiemmin kokemus kansainvälisiltä markkinoilta on vahva etu.


**Aikaisempi kokemus kasvuyrityksestä sekä SaaS-, teknologia-, asiantuntija- tai ratkaisumyynnin markkinoinnista on meille erittäin tärkeää.** Ja jos tiedät ja osaat selkeästi perustella, että markkinoinnin onnistuminen näkyy muuallakin kuin seuraajamäärässä, saat meiltä monta tykkäystä.

**Millainen henkilö menestyy meillä?**

Menestyt tässä roolissa, jos olet samaan aikaan luova, kaupallinen ja systemaattinen. Tartut asioihin itsenäisesti, viet ideat käytäntöön ja osaat muuttaa suuntaa nopeasti, jos data kertoo, ettei jokin toimi.

Pidät ihmisistä, tapahtumista ja keskusteluista ja saat mielellään asiantuntijasta irti ajatuksen, jota hän ei itse edes tajunnut olevan julkaisemisen arvoinen (big ask, we know ). Uskallat myös haastaa tiiminjäseniä! Huonot ideat nostetaan rohkeasti pöytään ja tehdään niistä yhdessä parempia.

Kasvuyrityksessä kaikki ei ole valmiiksi pureskeltua. Jos tarvitset täydellisen tehtävänannon, kolmen viikon hyväksyntäkierroksen ja kuusi allekirjoitusta ennen julkaisua, emme ehkä ole täydellinen match.

Jos taas nautit siitä, että pääset rakentamaan, kokeilemaan ja näkemään oman kädenjälkesi nopeasti, hae meille!

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Saat laajan roolin kasvuyrityksessä, jossa markkinointi on yksi kasvun tärkeimmistä moottoreista.

Pääset työskentelemään suoraan omistajien, asiantuntijoiden, myynnin ja teknologiatiimin kanssa sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä Vire Advisors ja Arviro näyttävät ja kuulostavat seuraavassa kasvuvaiheessaan.

Saat vastuuta, vapautta ja tilaa tehdä asioita paremmin kuin me olemme niitä tähän asti tehneet. Itse asiassa sitä me sinulta odotammekin.

**Työpaikka:** Vire Advisors

**Tehtävänimike:** Senior Marketing & Growth Specialist

**Työsuhde:** Vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, se voi myös olla osa-aikainen ja/tai toiminimiyrittäjä. Olemme avoimia monenlaisille työsuhdemuodoille, kunhan osaaminen ja omistautuneisuus ovat kohdallaan.

**Sijainti / hybridityö:** Vire Advisors on tällä hetkellä 100% remote. Ainakin toistaiseksi. Ehdotuksia otetaan vastaan.

**Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian, mutta sovittavissa. Meidän monilahjakas markkinoinnin assistentti Sanna päättää määräaikaisuutensa 16.10.2026.

**Hakuaika:** Än, yy, tee, nyt! Hakuaika alkaa nyt, ja päättyy viimeistään 23.10.2026

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä meille CV ja kerro erityisesti siitä, mistä olet oman osaamisesi suhteen ylpeä, mitä onnistumisia haluat tuoda esiin. Voit mielellään näyttää meille sisältöjä, kampanjoita, tapahtumia tai muita kokonaisuuksia, joista olet ylpeä ja jotka mielestäsi tukevat hakemustasi.

**Meitä kiinnostaa vähemmän se, mistä olet ollut vastuussa. Meitä kiinnostaa enemmän se, mitä sinun ansiostasi tapahtui.**

jobs.title: Facilities Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Facilities Manager Location: Dublin 7, Ireland Salary: €50,000 plus Sodexo benefits Contract: Full-time, Permanent About the Role Sodexo is looking for an experienced Facilities Manager to join our team in Grangegorman. This is a hands-on, client-facing role responsible for the day-to-day management of the on-site hard and soft services team, ensuring excellent service delivery, strong operational performance and compliance with contractual requirements. You’ll play a key role in managing the site team, contractors, maintenance programmes, lifecycle works and reactive client requirements, while driving continuous improvement across the contract. What You’ll Be Doing Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft FM services. Lead, support and develop the on-site service delivery team. Manage planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and lifecycle programmes. Coordinate reactive works and ensure client requirements are delivered effectively. Scope and verify minor works. Manage the SSOW permitting system and promote safe working practices. Lead Toolbox Talks, Safety Walks and Near Miss reporting. Manage contractor engagement and site inductions. Act as the key operational point of contact for on-site issues. Manage materials ordering and maintain accurate contract and project records. Deliver allocated projects on time, within budget and to specification. Monitor remedial works, budgets and expenditure. Support continuous improvement, innovation and cost-reduction initiatives. Build strong relationships with clients, visitors, contractors and internal stakeholders. Prepare reports and monitor operational deadlines and performance. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for an experienced Facilities professional who combines strong people leadership with commercial awareness and excellent customer service. You’ll ideally have: Previous FM management or coordination experience. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience in a client-facing role. Good understanding of FM technical services. Experience working with contracts and commercial requirements. Strong financial and budget management skills. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills. The ability to analyse information, make decisions and provide practical solutions. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel. A customer-focused and solutions-oriented approach. The ability to work at pace while maintaining accuracy.

jobs.title: Contract Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Location: TU Grangegorman, Dublin 7 Salary: €65,000 - €75,000 per annum, plus bonus and benefits Contract: Full-time, Permanent Sodexo is seeking an experienced and commercially focused PPP Contract Manager to lead the operational delivery of facilities management services across a strategic PPP contract. This is an exceptional opportunity to lead the delivery of integrated Hard FM, Soft FM, Energy, Lifecycle and Compliance services across two landmark higher-education buildings within a flagship Dublin PPP contract, managing a team of approximately 50 colleagues and specialist service partners. Reporting to the Contract Director, you will be accountable for operational performance, financial delivery, contractual compliance, client satisfaction and long-term asset stewardship. The role requires a strong blend of facilities management expertise, commercial acumen, stakeholder management and contractual knowledge within a complex performance-based environment. What you will be doing Lead the safe and effective delivery of all integrated facilities management services across the contract. Provide leadership to a multidisciplinary team of managers, supervisors, technicians, helpdesk personnel and service partners. Lead the contract’s compliance arrangements and ensure that appropriate controls, assurance processes and corrective actions are maintained across contractual, statutory and service requirements. Act as the primary operational interface with the client, representatives, consultants and key stakeholders. Lead monthly performance reviews, client governance meetings and operational reporting processes. Manage contract budgets, forecasts, expenditure controls and commercial performance. Drive continuous improvement initiatives and identify opportunities for efficiency, innovation and service enhancement. Oversee lifecycle replacement programmes and asset management activities to ensure long-term asset performance and contract compliance. Lead incident management, emergency response and business continuity planning. Manage contractor performance and ensure the effective delivery of specialist subcontracted services. Ensure robust controls are maintained to minimise performance and service failures and contractual risk. Support audit, assurance, quality and compliance programmes across all service lines. Maintain a strong focus on customer experience and stakeholder satisfaction. Promote a culture of safety, accountability, collaboration and operational excellence. What we are looking for Essential Significant experience managing large-scale Facilities Management contracts. Strong operational knowledge of both Hard FM and Soft FM services. Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and outsourced service providers. Demonstrable experience managing budgets, commercial performance and contractual KPIs. Strong understanding of building services, including but not limited to: HVAC, Mechanical & Electrical Systems, Fire Safety Systems, BMS / Smart
