- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtunti tulospalkkioon yrityksen tuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittareiden perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 11.10.2026. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa toimipaikkapäälliköt Sari Pulli ja Janica Venäläinen (sara.pulli@sok.fi / janica.l.venalainen@sok.fi ). Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

--------------------



FÖRSÄLJARE, SALE LUNDI OCH SALE GAMMELBACKA, 30 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en försäljare till Sale Lundi och Sale Gammelbacka för en fast anställning på 30 timmar i veckan. Som försäljare arbetar du mångsidigt med butikens olika uppgifter: du betjänar kunder i kassan, plockar upp varor, sköter produktpresentationer och datumkontroller samt ser till att butikerna är rena och trivsamma och att varorna finns tillgängliga. Efter introduktionen känner du till våra produkter och tjänster samt frågor som gäller ägarkundskap och kan berätta om dem för kunderna utifrån deras behov.

Vi på Sale Lundi och Sale Gammelbacka brukar säga att vi har helt vanliga jobb. Det betyder ändå inte att arbetet är tråkigt – tvärtom! Vi erbjuder ett varierande arbete inom kundservice och ett team där vi ställer upp för varandra.

Vi önskar att du:
- Bemöter kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätta stället <3
- Har ett energiskt och kundorienterat förhållningssätt samt arbetar initiativrikt och ansvarsfullt.
- Vill lära dig nytt och har förmåga att ta till dig olika system.
- Är beredd att arbeta alla skift under butikernas samtliga öppettider, även veckoslut och helgdagar.
- Har kunskaper i finska; kunskaper i svenska ses som meriter.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- En arbetsplats där det är trevligt att komma till jobbet och trevligt att gå hem efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där ingen lämnas ensam och där cheferna deltar i det dagliga arbetet.
- Möjligheter att utvecklas och utbilda sig.
- Rabatter på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster – mat, dryck, kosmetik, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat.
- Kultur-, välmående- och motionsförmåner.

Lön
- Lön enligt kollektivavtalet för handelsbranschen (10,89 €/h–14,57 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 % om du kan betjäna kunder på åtminstone finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till en gemensam resultatbonus för hela personalen på upp till 1,70 € per arbetad timme, utifrån företagets resultat och branschspecifika mätare.

Intresserad?
Vi går vidare med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast söndagen den 11.10.2026. Närmare information om uppgiften ger enhetscheferna Sari Pulli och Janica Venäläinen (sara.pulli@sok.fi / janica.l.venalainen@sok.fi ). Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse.

jobs.title: Erfaren mødebooker? Bliv vores nye kollega hos Callmark!
jobs.description:
Vil du have stor frihed, arbejde med kvalitet i et stærkt, modent team?

Hos Callmark ApS har vi forrygende travlt, og vi søger derfor en ny kollega til telemarketing og mødebooking. Vi leder efter dig, der allerede ved, hvad det kræver at løfte røret, og som motiveres af den gode, professionelle dialog.

Om dig: Du kender gamet og mestrer kold canvas

Vi leder ikke nødvendigvis efter mange års erfaring, men det er et krav du har dokumenteret erfaring med kold canvas over telefonen og forstå dynamikken i en opsøgende dialog. Din baggrund kan være fra telesalg, mødebooking, annoncesalg eller lignende.

  • Du har telefon-erfaring: Du har prøvet at arbejde med kold canvas, kundedialog eller dataindsamling før.

  • Du skaber tillid: Du formår hurtigt at opbygge en god relation over telefonen og booke kvalitetsmøder.

  • Det er en fordel (men ikke et krav), hvis: Du tidligere har booket møder inden for HR, IT, marketing, forsikring eller pension.

  • Du er selvkørende: Du trives med frihed under ansvar.

Jobbet: Stor frihedsgrad og professionelle projekter

Som vores nye kollega bliver du tilknyttet 2-4 faste kundeprojekter. Vi booker det indledende, strategiske salgsmøde for vores kunder, og vi indhenter markedsinformation af høj kvalitet.

Vi stoler på vores medarbejdere. Derfor tilbyder vi en yderst fleksibel arbejdsuge, hvor du som udgangspunkt arbejder 2-3 dage på vores kontor i Greve og 2-3 dage hjemmefra. Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring i vores produkter og processer, så du får de bedste forudsætninger for at lykkedes.

Hvem er Callmark ApS?

Vi er et veletableret mødebookingbureau med mere end 20 års erfaring i branchen. Vi er i dag 10 dedikerede medarbejdere. Her møder du et voksent, dygtigt og humoristisk team, hvor fagligheden er høj, og hvor vi sparrer med hinanden på tværs.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Matcher du profilen, så tøv ikke med at sende os din ansøgning og dit CV med det samme. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

jobs.title: Commercial Director - Bern (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Intro

Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 480 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet.

Dich begeistert ein Mix aus strategischem Gestaltungsspielraum und operativ-kommerzieller Optimierung und Du willst Deine wirtschaftliche Expertise bei einem dynamisch wachsenden Player der Augenheilkunde unter Beweis stellen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

In dieser Rolle wirst Du zur Führung und Optimierung der kaufmännischen Aktivitäten mehrerer Augenzentren in Bern die kaufmännische Geschäftsführung übernehmen. Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die strategische Überwachung, das Leistungsmanagement, die Teamführung und die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Dein Engagement für hervorragende Leistungen wird dazu beitragen, die Geschäftsziele zu erreichen, die Patientenzufriedenheit zu erhöhen und das Wachstum der Präsenz von Sanoptis in der Region zu fördern.


In dieser Rolle wirst Du

  • Unsere Augenzentren kaufmännisch leiten: Du wirst den Betrieb mehrerer Zentren wirtschaftlich leiten und dabei die Einhaltung der Sanoptis-Standards in den Einrichtungen sicherstellen.
  • Betriebsergebnisse und Geschäftsziele verantworten: Die betrieblichen Leistungskennzahlen zu Patientenzufriedenheit, Finanzindikatoren, Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Rentabilität wirst Du überwachen. Ferner wirst Du mit den Finanz- und Buchhaltungsteams bei der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Budgets, Finanzprognosen und Kostenkontrollmaßnahmen zusammenarbeiten.
  • Leistungsziele definieren: Du wirst Leistungsbewertungen durchführen und Ziele definieren. Es ist Dir ein wesentliches Anliegen, für Deine Mitarbeiter und Teams ein positives Arbeitsumfeld zu gewährleisten, das Leistung durch effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit fördert.
  • Die regionale Strategie planen: Die Formulierung regionaler, strategischer Pläne im Einklang mit unseren übergeordneten Geschäftszielen erarbeitest Du. Hierfür wirst Du eng mit dem Head of Operations sowie Ärzten und Fachkräften vor Ort arbeiten und netzwerken.
  • Wachstum durch Standortentwicklung vorantreiben: Du siehst Wachstumschancen in Deiner Region und erkennst sie frühzeitig, um sie gewinnbringend zu nutzen. Du wirst durch effektive Marketing- und Werbestrategien zur Steigerung des Patientenaufkommens in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketingteam beitragen. Dein Ziel ist es, einen Ausbau des Marktanteils zu erreichen.


Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit

  • Einem starken Operationsteam, bestehend aus vielen Ex-Beratern (Bain, BCG, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman).
  • Leitenden Angestellten und Führungskräften bei Sanoptis, darunter der Head of Operations und das Führungsteam, das für klinische Innovation und hervorragende Dienstleistungen verantwortlich ist.
  • Renommierten Spezialisten und führenden Experten auf dem Gebiet der Augenheilkunde.
  • Einem engagierten und qualifizierten Team von medizinischen Fachkräften und Assistenzärzten.
  • Interdisziplinären Teams in unserem gesamten Netzwerk, einschließlich Technologieexperten, die an den neuesten Fortschritten in der augenmedizinischen Behandlung und digitalen Gesundheitslösungen arbeiten.


Dein Profil überzeugt durch

  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, z. B. in der Strategieberatung (McKinsey, Bain, BCG o.Ä.) oder in ähnlich schnelllebigen Unternehmen.
  • Die nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Geschäfts- und Finanzanalysen auf Führungsebene zu erstellen und zu kommunizieren. Du erstellst Analysen akribisch und detailorientiert.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken mit der Fähigkeit, große Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Problemlösungen unabhängig voranzutreiben. Eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit wenig Anleitung ist essenziell.
  • Nachgewiesene Erfolge im Umgang mit Interessensgruppen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, ohne formale Autorität Einfluss zu nehmen und Dir eine wichtige Rolle bei der Entscheidungsfindung zu sichern. Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, auch in schwierigen Situationen Konflikte konstruktiv zu lösen und Durchsetzungsstärke zu behalten.
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Bereich Organisation und Prozessmanagement.
  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau), Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil sowie Englischkenntnisse.
  • Die Bereitschaft, Ergebnisse zu erzielen und Dich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit hoher Verantwortung zu entfalten.


Sanoptis bietet Dir

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung: Ein äußerst attraktives Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen, leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Leistungsziele gebunden ist.
  • Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, Dich zu beweisen, indem Du selbstständig arbeitest und eigene, innovative Ideen umfassend einbringst als Führungspersönlichkeit.
  • Berufliche Entwicklung: Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Wachstum und Karrierechancen bei guter Leistung, unterstützt durch Schulungen, Online-Akademien, Workshops und Branchenkonferenzen.
  • Inklusive Kultur: Arbeiten in einem ambitionierten Team mit regelmäßigem Austausch und Teamveranstaltungen.
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits.
  • Körperliches Wohlbefinden: Eine subventionierte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellpass, die Deine körperliche Gesundheit unterstützt.


Gleiche Chancen

Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle.


Kontakt

Wenn Du bereit bist, die digitale Zukunft der Augenheilkunde mitzugestalten, möchten wir von Dir hören! Bewirb Dich jetzt, um unserem dynamischen Team beizutreten und einen bedeutenden Einfluss auf das Leben der Menschen zu haben. jobs.title: Chefs/ Souschefs - Job opportunities at LOCA – Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Join LOCA – gastronomy, hospitality and sustainability

LOCA Group is looking for talented and passionate Chefs and Sous Chefs to join our restaurants in Copenhagen.
At LOCA, we work with something we believe is one of the most important things in the world: the meal. We believe gastronomy can help create a better future, and every day we work to combine high gastronomic standards, genuine hospitality and concrete sustainable choices.
For us, sustainability starts with the ingredient. We work with seasonal produce, high levels of organic ingredients, local producers and reducing food waste.
We want to raise the bar for how sustainability is approached in gastronomy – without compromising flavour or the guest experience.

We are looking for Chefs and Sous ChefsWe are looking for both experienced Chefs and Sous Chefs who want to become part of our different kitchens.We are looking for people who:

  • Are trained Chefs or have equivalent relevant experience

  • Have experience from professional kitchens with high gastronomic standards.

  • Work in a structured way and remain calm and focused during service.

  • Have strong culinary skills and a genuine passion for gastronomy.

  • Enjoy teamwork and contribute positively to the kitchen environment.

  • Are curious and motivated to develop both professionally and personally.

  • Have an interest in sustainability, organic ingredients, seasonal produce and local producers.

  • For Sous Chef positions, you should also have experience with leadership, planning, ordering, food safety and the daily operation of a professional kitchen.


We value respect, collaboration, responsibility and the desire to keep improving.

Our restaurants

As part of LOCA, you will have the opportunity to work in different gastronomic environments:

Amélie – The Opera House
A modern Danish brasserie where classic French techniques meet Danish ingredients and the unique atmosphere of the Opera House. The kitchen works across à la carte, opera service and larger events
.PAULA – Carlsberg Byen
A modern French-Japanese kitchen focusing on deep umami, precision, seasonal ingredients and a minimum of 60% organic produce. A small, focused team with high gastronomic ambitions.
DOLORES – Carlsberg Byen
A vibrant restaurant inspired by San Francisco’s Mission District, serving creative sharing-style dishes with seasonal ingredients in a relaxed atmosphere.
Restaurant RADIO – Frederiksberg
A modern Nordic restaurant with more than 15 years of history. The restaurant focuses on organic and seasonal ingredients, local producers, vegetables and fish from Nordic waters.LOCA also operates
Kilden i Haven in Tivoli and several canteens.

What we offer

  • A workplace with high gastronomic ambitions.

  • An international and diverse working environment.

  • Passionate and dedicated colleagues.

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development.

  • Responsibility and influence in your daily work.

  • Opportunities for further training and development within LOCA.

  • Salary and employment conditions based on qualifications.

  • The opportunity to become part of a company actively working to shape the future of sustainable gastronomy.


Why LOCA?We believe the best restaurants are created by people who want to succeed together.At LOCA, you are not simply joining a kitchen. You become part of a community where we share knowledge, support each other and work together to create great meals and great workplaces.We believe Every Meal Matters – and that the choices we make today help create a better world tomorrow.Practical information

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Employment: Full-time

Positions: Chef / Sous Chef

Start: By agreement / as soon as possible

Salary: Based on qualifications

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
If you would like to join LOCA, please send your CV and application telling us a little about yourself, your experience and why you would like to work with us.Send your resume to job@locarestauranter.dk

E se o seu próximo trabalho fosse ajudar pessoas a concretizar alguns dos projetos mais importantes das suas vidas?

Estamos a reforçar a nossa equipa de Intermediação de Crédito em Portimão e procuramos alguém que goste de pessoas, de números e, sobretudo, de encontrar soluções.

Mais do que um Gestor de Crédito, procuramos uma pessoa curiosa, determinada e com vontade de fazer a diferença. Alguém capaz de ouvir um cliente, compreender a sua realidade e acompanhá-lo na procura de uma solução de financiamento adequada, competitiva e responsável.

No dia a dia, irá analisar necessidades e perfis financeiros, preparar e acompanhar processos de crédito, contactar entidades financeiras, comparar propostas e estar ao lado do cliente desde o primeiro contacto até à conclusão do processo.

Experiência na banca, crédito, seguros ou área financeira será valorizada, e muito. Mas não é o único caminho para chegar até nós. Se tem perfil comercial, facilidade de comunicação, capacidade de organização e vontade genuína de aprender, queremos conhecê-lo(a).

Procuramos alguém com energia, empatia, responsabilidade, capacidade de negociação e gosto por objetivos. Acima de tudo, alguém que perceba que por detrás de cada processo existem pessoas, famílias e projetos de vida.

Da nossa parte, encontrará formação, acompanhamento, ferramentas de trabalho e uma equipa disponível para ajudar. Queremos que cresça profissionalmente, desenvolva competências e encontre espaço para construir o seu próprio percurso connosco.

Se procura apenas mais um trabalho, talvez não sejamos o projeto certo. Se procura uma oportunidade para aprender, crescer e sentir que o seu trabalho tem impacto real na vida das pessoas, queremos falar consigo.

jobs.title: AGENTE IMOBILIÁRIO E GESTOR DE PROPRIEDADES
jobs.description:
E se o seu próximo desafio profissional não tivesse dias todos iguais?

Estamos a reforçar a nossa equipa imobiliária em Portimão e procuramos pessoas com energia, iniciativa e vontade de construir uma carreira onde o contacto humano, a autonomia e os resultados fazem parte do dia a dia.

Não procuramos apenas alguém para vender imóveis. Procuramos alguém que goste de pessoas, que tenha curiosidade pelo mercado e que queira tornar-se um verdadeiro profissional de confiança para quem precisa de comprar ou vender uma casa.

O dia a dia passa por conhecer e trabalhar uma determinada zona, identificar oportunidades, contactar proprietários, angariar e promover imóveis, acompanhar compradores e vendedores, realizar visitas, negociar propostas e estar presente em todas as etapas até à concretização do negócio.

Já tem experiência no imobiliário ou na área comercial? Excelente. Nunca trabalhou no setor? Isso não é necessariamente um problema. Procuramos sobretudo atitude, capacidade de comunicação, resiliência e vontade de aprender. O conhecimento e as ferramentas podem ser adquiridos; a vontade de fazer acontecer tem de partir de si.

Valorizamos pessoas positivas, responsáveis, organizadas e com espírito empreendedor. Pessoas que saibam ouvir, criar relações de confiança e que não tenham receio de sair da zona de conforto para alcançar objetivos.

Da nossa parte, encontrará formação, acompanhamento próximo, apoio comercial, jurídico e de marketing, CRM e ferramentas para desenvolver a sua atividade, integrando uma equipa onde a entreajuda faz parte da forma de trabalhar.

Não prometemos que todos os dias serão fáceis. Prometemos que serão diferentes.

Se procura uma profissão onde possa conhecer pessoas, desenvolver-se, superar-se e sentir que o seu trabalho é realmente seu, talvez esteja na altura de nos conhecermos.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality
jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

  • Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

  • Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

  • Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

  • Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

  • Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development.

  • Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended.

  • Hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks: prompt and context design, tool use, handling non-determinism, and evaluating output quality. This is the differentiator for the role.

  • Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing.

  • The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLM systems.

  • Open-source contribution experience.

  • Java, TypeScript or Python; Kubernetes and Helm.

  • Background in developer tooling or platform engineering.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AG1 #LI-Remote #USEAST

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00

United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00

Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00

Canada: C$152,700.00 to C$251,200.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Requisition ID 124840 - Luxembourg - Experienced Professionals

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

As a key contributor to the Group's strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

We are seeking a DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer to strengthen the reliability and performance of the bank's strategic application processes through an advanced monitoring and observability framework across both on-premises and cloud environments. Monitoring is designed and implemented in close cooperation with software engineering teams in order to track end-to-end application chains. Industrialize application and business process deployments by designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure production releases and a stable IT production environment.. • Provide support to operations teams. Lead post-incident reviews, including Root Cause Analysis and post-mortems. Define and track preventive action plans.
• Collaborate with business and technical teams to align system reliability with operational needs and produce clear operational documentation.
• Industrialize and standardize the deployment of applications and business processes through automated CI/CD pipelines.
• Design, implement and maintain monitoring and observability solutions for business processes, including dashboards, reliability indicators, alerting and end-to-end flow traceability, with advanced use of the Grafana Observability Stack across on-premises systems and cloud services.
• Analyze business-process performance and recommend improvements.
• Integrate new processing tasks into the production schedule and/or optimize existing ones.
• Configure and implement data transfers with external partners, ensuring reliability, traceability and end-to-end monitoring.
• Contribute to the cloud strategy, including deployments, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

• Fluent in french and english

• Strong expertise in monitoring and observability tools, as well as distributed tracing concepts (Grafana, Dynatrace, Jaeger).

jobs.title: Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO

Purpose of the Job

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve. We are a bank headquartered in Luxembourg with branches in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands, as well as a subsidary in the UK. Supervised by the CSSF we have the ambition to stay true to our purpose to be the most trusted fiduciary of family wealth.

When you join us you are joining a company that values diversity of background, equal access to opportunities, career development, collaboration and inclusiveness. We want our employees to feel proud of being part of a company that is committed to do the right thing. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while developing personally and professionally through various resources and programmes.

The Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & MLRO has primary responsibility for implementation, oversight and monitoring of the Group's financial crime compliance framework (across money laundering & terrorist financing, sanctions, bribery & corruption, external fraud risks), ensuring robust risk management, full regulatory compliance, and effective detection and reporting of financial crime, thereby safeguarding the integrity, reputation, and resilience of the organisation. The role holder acts as the central point of contact with competent authorities and the FIU on financial crime (including specifically AML/CFT ) matters.

Key Accountabilities

Group AML/CFT Framework Leadership:

• Define, implement and maintain a consistent and effective Group-wide FCC framework aligned with applicable regulations and group risk appetite  across all entities.
• Ensure policies, procedures and control expectations are defined, implemented and maintained.    

Group Financial Crime Risk Stewardship:

• Oversee the effectiveness of the financial crime risk control framework .  
• Provide advice,  guidance and challenge to the 1LoD risk and control ownership.  
• Coordinate and maintain the group-wide financial crime risk assessment.

Client Due Diligence Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of client due diligence and client acceptance processes.
• Ensure higher risk clients are subject to enhanced due diligence.
• Monitor compliance with client onboarding and periodic review requirements.            
                        
Suspicious Activity Reporting Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of transaction monitoring and client/transaction screening arrangements including systems/toolings.
• Act as ultimate escalation point for suspicious activity, investigate complex cases and ensure timely and compliant reporting to FIUs.                                    

Regulatory Engagement & Representation:

• Serve as primary contact for regulators, leading inspections, managing regulatory interactions, overseeing regulatory reporting and ensuring remediation of findings for financial crime matters.                                    

Group MLRO Network & Local Oversight:

• Lead and coordinate local MLROs, ensuring consistent governance, escalation, independence and oversight across jurisdictions.
Governance, Board Reporting & Advisory:
• Provide regular FCC reporting to senior management and the Board, advising on risk exposure, control effectiveness and mitigation strategies.
• Ensure escalation of major financial crime risk events, breaches or control issues, ensuring appropriate reporting, documentation and remediation.

Culture, Training & Awareness:

• Promote a strong compliance culture throughout the organisation by designing and delivering effective AML/CFT training and awareness across all levels of the organisation

Knowledge and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CAMS, CFE) preferred.
• Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in financial crime compliance within the financial services industry (Larger bank / big four preferred), with a focus on AML, ABC, sanctions, and policy framework.
• In-depth knowledge of European and UK regulatory requirements related to financial crime compliance, including AML directives, sanctions regimes, and bribery/corruption laws.                          
• Proven experience in developing and implementing FCC policies, procedures, and controls across multiple jurisdictions.
• Strong leadership and management skills with the ability to effectively oversee a team and drive results in a dynamic and complex environment.  

Attributes and Qualities

• Leadership & People Management                                
• Collaborative Teamwork                                
• Critical Thinking & Problem Solving                                
• Communication (Verbal & Written)                                
• Conflict Resolution & Negotiation

Technical Skills

• MS Office proficiency

Languages Skills

• English: Fluent
• Any other Quintet language is considered an asset

• Formation de niveau BAC+3 à BAC+5 en assurances, gestion, finance ou domaine équivalent.

Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. Nous considérons l'ère numérique comme une opportunité et aspirons à ce que notre offre de demain soit encore plus durable, plus innovante et plus orientée client. Vous voulez y participer ?

Nous vous donnons la liberté de poursuivre vos idées... Investissez-vous ! Remettez-nous en question ! Continuez à évoluer et à nous faire évoluer !  Tout ceci est possible grâce à notre culture de l'apprentissage et de l'erreur ainsi qu'à une communication d'égal à égal. Parce que ce n'est qu'ensemble que nous pourrons aller de l'avant.

jobs.title: Lower School Learner Support Teacher - 1 year contract (m/f)
jobs.description:
Want to help every learner access, participate and thrive?

At the International School of Luxembourg (ISL), we believe that learner diversity enriches our community. We are looking for a Lower School Learner Support Services (LSS) Teacher who is passionate about creating inclusive learning environments where children feel known, valued and empowered to grow.
Working within our learning community, you will support students with language acquisition and/or diverse learning needs, partnering closely with classroom teachers, families and colleagues across Learner Support Services. Through responsive teaching, targeted intervention and inclusive practice, you will help remove barriers to learning and enable students to develop confidence, agency and independence.
Why does this Role matter?
You will be an important advocate for learners and a resource for our whole learning community. Your expertise will help teachers respond to learner variability, help families understand and support their child's development, and—most importantly—help students recognise themselves as capable, active and successful learners. At ISL, learner support is not simply about helping students overcome challenges. It is about creating the conditions in which every child can participate, develop agency, experience success and reach their potential.

Why ISL?
At ISL, you will join a diverse, caring, and forward-thinking community where:
● Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection
● Educators are supported to grow, reflect, and innovate
● Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future
At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for teachers who see teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What will You do?
● Support learners individually, in small groups and within the classroom through inclusive, evidence-informed language and learning interventions.
● Co-teach and collaborate with classroom teachers to differentiate learning experiences and ensure meaningful access to the IB Primary Years Programme curriculum.
● Build learner agency by involving students in understanding their strengths, setting learning goals and reflecting on their progress.
● Use assessment purposefully to identify learning needs, monitor growth and adapt interventions and support.
● Develop and monitor Individual Learning Plans, accommodations and targeted learning goals for students requiring additional support.
● Case-manage students receiving language or learning support, maintaining clear records and coordinating communication between students, families, teachers and relevant specialists.
● Partner with families, building trusting and respectful relationships around each child's learning, development and wellbeing.
● Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, including classroom teachers, counsellors, school leaders and external specialists.
● Strengthen inclusive practice by sharing expertise, resources and strategies with teachers and teaching assistants.
● Contribute actively to the wider Learner Support Services Team and our collaborative professional learning culture.
● Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
● Engaging in personal professional growth and bring fresh ideas into the classroom.
● Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
You will thrive here if you …
● Build positive, trusting relationships with children and creates a strong sense of belonging and psychological safety.
● See learner variability through a strengths-based and inclusive lens.
● Differentiate learning thoughtfully and creatively to reduce barriers and increase participation.
● Collaborate effectively and sees co-teaching as a shared professional practice.
● Communicate sensitively and clearly with students, families, colleagues and external specialists.
● Use evidence, observation and assessment to make informed decisions about learning.
● Are organised and dependable when managing individual learning plans, referrals, documentation and confidential information.
● Reflect on your practice, seeks feedback and remains curious about developments in language acquisition and inclusive education.
● Demonstrate cultural responsiveness, empathy and respect within a diverse international community.

Who are You?
● Strong knowledge of inclusive education, learning differences and/or English language acquisition.
● An understanding of multi-tiered systems of support (“MTSS”) and the use of targeted, evidence-informed interventions.
● Experience with co-teaching, differentiation and inclusive classroom practice.
● Able to use assessment information to identify needs, establish goals and monitor student progress.
● Hold a current teaching qualification/certification and a Bachelor's degree or equivalent; a Master's degree in Special/Inclusive Education, Learning Support, Learning Differences or Language Acquisition is highly valued.
● Preferably two years of recent successful experience working with preschool or primary-aged learners with language and/or learning support needs.
● Experience supporting multilingual learners and recognising multilingualism as an asset.
● Experience interpreting psychoeducational assessments and translating recommendations into classroom practice would be an advantage.
● Experience in an international school and/or IB PYP environment is highly valued.
● Near-native fluency in English and confidence using digital tools to support learning, collaboration and documentation.

We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.
We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.
Recruitment timeline:
• If you are shortlisted, you will receive a notification email to book your interview.
• If you have not been contacted after the deadline, your application is potentially unsuccessful but, in any case, you will receive an official answer.

Technology Strategy Architect - Consulting Manager
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Job description
Requisition ID:  1746391

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The Opportunity

As a Technology Strategy Architect within EY Luxembourg's Technology Consulting practice, you will help clients shape and execute their technology transformation agendas. You will work closely with C-level executives, business leaders, and technology teams to define technology strategies, target operating models, enterprise architectures, and transformation roadmaps that enable sustainable business growth.
You will play a key role in bridging business objectives with technology capabilities, helping organizations make strategic decisions around digital transformation, cloud adoption, enterprise platforms, data, AI, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Advise clients on technology strategy, digital transformation, and enterprise architecture initiatives.
• Assess current-state technology landscapes and identify opportunities for modernization and optimization.
• Define target-state architectures aligned with business objectives and strategic priorities.
• Develop technology roadmaps, investment plans, and implementation strategies.
• Support CIOs and executive leadership teams in technology decision-making and governance.
• Evaluate technology platforms, vendors, and emerging solutions to support business transformation.
• Lead architecture reviews, technology assessments, and operating model design initiatives.
• Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to ensure alignment between strategy and execution.
• Support cloud transformation, application modernization, data, AI, and cybersecurity programs.
• Build business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and value realization frameworks for strategic initiatives.
• Contribute to business development activities, proposals, and thought leadership within the Technology Consulting practice.
• Coach and mentor consultants and support the development of the wider technology consulting team.

Skills and Attributes for Success

• Strong strategic and analytical mindset with the ability to translate business objectives into technology solutions.
• Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
• Experience leading large-scale transformation programs and enterprise architecture engagements.
• Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical implementation considerations.
• Strong presentation, facilitation, and workshop leadership capabilities.
• Commercial awareness and experience supporting business development activities.
• 7+ years of experience in Technology Consulting, Enterprise Architecture, IT Strategy, Digital Transformation, or a related field.
• Experience advising senior executives, including CIOs, CTOs, and business leaders.
• Proven experience designing enterprise architecture frameworks and technology roadmaps.
• Strong understanding of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud), enterprise applications, data platforms, and emerging technologies.
• Experience with technology governance, operating models, and portfolio management.
• Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
• Fluent English is required. French and/or German would be considered an asset.

Ideally, You'll Also Have

• Experience within the Financial Services, Public Sector, Telecommunications, Retail, or Industrial sectors.
• Knowledge of AI, data strategy, cybersecurity, cloud transformation, and enterprise integration architectures.
• Experience with architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF, Zachman, ArchiMate, or SAFe.
• Experience delivering technology strategy engagements in a consulting environment.

Valued Certifications

• TOGAF Certified
• Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
• AWS Certified Solutions Architect
• Google Professional Cloud Architect
• ITIL Foundation or Managing Professional
• SAFe Agilist
• PMP or Prince2 Practitioner
• COBIT Foundation

What we offer

• Hands-on experience on concrete business transformation topics.
• Close collaboration with experienced team members and regular feedback.
• Exposure to cross-functional stakeholders and a broad range of organisational topics.
• The opportunity to develop practical skills in analysis, PMO, process improvement and AI-enabled ways of working.
• A supportive environment in which you can learn, contribute and progressively take ownership.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Our offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and pre-screening requirements. The candidate acknowledges that all information provided must be accurate.

jobs.title: Junior Project Coordinator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Luxinnovation, Luxembourg's national innovation agency, is seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Project Coordinator to join our Interreg team. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in coordinating an initiative that drives the development and deployment of Interreg projects across various sectors. This role requires a proactive individual with a passion for innovation and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced, evolving environment.


RESPONSIBILITIES
Your key responsibilities will include:

• Project management: Understand the contractual requirements of conventions and Interreg projects. Oversee the planning, execution, and completion of the project, ensuring they align with the objectives of the associated contract and are delivered on time and within budget. Track progress against KPIs and propose adjustments to activities as needed to stay on schedule and within scope. Oversee the preparation of financial reports and ensure quality control on technical deliverables. Ensure traceability of project documentation.

• Stakeholder collaboration: Work closely with internal teams and consortium partners to facilitate effective communication and collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.

• Resource allocation: Monitor and guide optimal utilisation of resources for each project and associated work packages.

• Risk management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure project success.

• Internal and external reporting: Prepare detailed reports and presentations on project progress, outcomes, and insights for stakeholders and senior management.
  

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• Master's degree in project management, innovation management, business administration, law or related field. Relevant certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) is a plus. Previous experience in project coordination or management, preferably within the technology or innovation sectors, is a plus.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and German are required; French is a plus.

• Structured, organisational, and coordination abilities with a keen attention to detail.

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural and interdisciplinary team environment.

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a dynamic environment.

• Self-starter attitude with the initiative to identify opportunities and propose solutions.

• Capacity to navigate challenges and maintain composure under pressure.


WHY CHOOSE THIS POSITION?
Joining our team means contributing to Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem and supporting projects that help companies and research centres grow and collaborate in new ways.


If you're eager to learn, ready to contribute, and want to help drive innovation forward, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your application online in English (including a CV).  

AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey could take us!

Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

jobs.title: HR Specialist, Research, Strategy & Solutions, Employee Experience & Outcomes (EXO) m/f
jobs.description:
HR Specialist, Research, Strategy & Solutions, Employee Experience & Outcomes (EXO)
Job ID: 10553049 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

Amazon's Employee Experience & Outcomes (EXO) organization exists to earn, drive, deliver and protect the trust between Amazon and its 1.5M+ workforce. Within EXO, the Research, Strategy & Solutions Team is EXO's center of excellence for employee relations research, intelligence, proactive strategies/consulting and solutions. We are seeking a HR Specialist to join our team as an individual contributor reporting to the Research, Strategy and Solutions Leader.

In this role, you will assess data, workplace dynamics, behaviors, external trends, and relationships to identify risks and gaps in the work environment, and translate those insights into sustainable, scalable initiatives, mechanisms, and programs that drive long-lasting change at all levels. You will influence leaders to gain alignment and support, and work cross-functionally and globally to design and execute large-scale proactive strategies.

This is a research-forward role: the emphasis is on data-driven analysis, strategic foresight, and forward-looking trend intelligence rather than reactive ER issues management or investigations. Success requires deep employee and labor relations expertise, strong analytical and research skills, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively.

Key job responsibilities

Research & Trend Intelligence

• Design and maintain ongoing workforce research and trend-monitoring frameworks that detect emerging labor market shifts, geopolitical signals, and employee sentiment patterns
• Conduct competitive benchmarking to identify best practices and emerging risks
• Develop predictive risk models to anticipate ER challenges before they escalate
• Produce research outputs that inform strategic decision-making

Risk Detection and Mitigation

• Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends and challenges, predict and mitigate risk, and develop and execute solution-focused strategies and programs
• Synthesize workforce data, labor-market intelligence, and employee sentiment to surface emerging risks and opportunities

Data Analysis & Strategic Insights

• Exercise strong analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations
• Define and measure success of programs through clear KPIs and research-backed evaluation frameworks

Cross-Functional Leadership & Partnership

• Partner with cross-functional teams including Internal Communications, Public Policy, Public Relations, Legal, Human Resources, and Operations to develop and implement comprehensive strategies that align with organizational priorities
• Lead research initiatives that inform policy decisions and public-facing communications

Program & Project Delivery at Scale

• Independently design, own, and lead successfully large-scale, network-wide projects that improve frontline employee experience
• Translate research findings into scalable mechanisms and programs for entire networks
• Lead the design and implementation with cross functional partners (e.g., Ops Tech) of tech solutions aiming at managing employee relations

Communication & Executive Influence

• Rapidly produce high-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and move solutions from concept to execution
• Present research findings and strategic recommendations to senior leadership with clarity and impact
• Build constructive relationships with critical stakeholders and peers to share information, influence change, and leverage resources to deliver results

Problem-Solving & Ambiguity Management

- Work independently with minimal supervision in ambiguous situations and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions
• Challenge current practices and industry status quo to generate creative mechanisms that bring about large-scale solutions

A day in the life

We are open to hiring this role out of a corporate location from the following countries: Luxembourg, UK/IE, France, Germany, Italy, Spain.

About the team

Our team is committed to building an inclusive workplace where every employee can do their best work. We partner closely with business leaders to deliver people programs that support Amazon's long-term goals, and we pride ourselves on tackling tough problems with creativity and rigor. As we continue to grow, we are focused on scaling our processes and raising the bar on the employee experience. If you want to be part of a collaborative group that values trust, candid feedback, and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in employee relations, labor relations, human relations or labor/employment law
- Experience as an HR specialist, HR generalist (e.g., HR Business Partner or HR Partner), HR manager, or in HR program roles
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience producing executive-level written materials and presenting to executive audiences
- Experience creating and implementing large-scale organizational programs
- Experience analyzing HR data and translating metrics into actionable workforce strategies
- Experience supporting large hourly workforces
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- Experience delivering complex, data-driven recommendations to senior leaders
- Knowledge of general AI tools

jobs.description:
Head of After-Market Services Returns & Remedies, EU FBA
Job ID: 10544483 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Over the past 20 years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of consumers and become one of the world's largest internet retailers, with more than 152 million active customer accounts, over 2 million active seller accounts, and $500 billion in global revenue. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) delivered more than seven billion units on behalf of sellers in 2024, with sellers from over 130 countries fulfilling orders to customers in 185 countries.

The Opportunity:

Customer Returns sit at the intersection of customer satisfaction, seller profitability, and FBA growth. In 2025, 581 million FBA units were returned worldwide, incurring significant cost to Amazon and sellers. Beyond the financial impact, unnecessary returns generate significant waste; preventing them is one of the most tangible ways to improve sustainability outcomes while strengthening seller economics.

The Role:

As Head of After-Market Services Returns & Remedies, EU FBA, you will lead a team of Product Management managers to build and execute the strategic EU FBA After-Market-Service Customer Returns that prevent returns that do not need to happen, enhancing the customer experience in any purchase at Amazon and the seller experience in any sales at Amazon — at EU and worldwide scale.

Location: Flexible within EU FBA footprint. Preferably Luxembourg, Paris.

Key job responsibilities

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for one or more Return Prevention products, from BRD (Business Requirements Document) through spec through launch, working hand-in-hand with engineering and worldwide product and tech teams to build scalable solutions
- Envision, Influence and Drive the future of Customer Experience and Seller Experience on Returns & Remedies with AI-native solutions across EU marketplaces
- Drive adoption at scale by partnering across Go-to-Market, Account Management, and Seller Experience to convert proven products into default seller behaviors
- Operate across VP-level organizations - including WW Returns & Recommerce, WW FBA, Operations & Reverse Logistics, Finance, and Customer Experience - gaining broad exposure to Amazon's post-purchase ecosystem
- Influence globally - several products carry worldwide scope, giving you direct impact beyond EU.

As the portfolio matures, this role offers a natural path toward expanded product, technical, and geographical scope.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in product marketing, program management, or business development
- Experience hiring and leading a high-performance team

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree or above in business, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or related field

jobs.title: Program Manager, Instore Experience (ISX), Reverse Logistic Services (RLS) (m/f)
jobs.description:
Program Manager, Instore Experience (ISX), Reverse Logistic Services (RLS)
Job ID: 10541583 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) exists to make returns effortless and reliable for every Amazon customer — no matter which store or partner they walk into. In France, we deliver that experience across more than 15,000 partner and carrier locations, through convenience-led options such as Label-Free, Box-Free (LFBF) drop-off and every other way a customer can return an item in-store.

The ISX Regional Program Manager, France owns the quality and consistency of that experience across the whole French network. Because returns run through thousands of independent partner sites, the experience can vary widely from one location to the next and the core of this role is closing that gap. You will get into the field, see how returns actually happen at partner locations, coach partners and their teams to the standard customers expect, and use data to focus your time on the sites that need help most. Your mission is holistic: improving in-store returns execution across all return types, so a customer's experience is just as good at the busiest location as it is at the smallest.

This is not only a field-execution role. It carries a strategic remit that reflects its level. Beyond coaching individual sites, you will help design and deploy the network-wide improvements that lift the entire France network at once: in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment mechanisms, associate support and training, and the tools partners rely on to process returns. You will translate what you learn in the field into scalable programs, work across internal teams to launch them in France, and help shape how the broader EU standards themselves are built, turning local, on-the-ground insight into lasting structural improvement.

This is also a founding, build-from-scratch role. You'll be the first ISX Program Manager for France and one of the earliest members of the EU field team, reporting directly to the EU ISX Senior Manager. There's no established playbook yet, you'll help create it. We're looking for someone with real ambition, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to focus relentlessly on the initiatives that matter most while the team, tools, and standards are still taking shape.

Key job responsibilities

• Own the in-store returns experience in France across ~17,000 partner and carrier locations, ensuring returns are fast, easy, and reliable for customers across all return types.
• Get into the field and coach. Visit partner locations, observe how returns are handled, and coach partner teams to Amazon's standards for speed, accuracy, and customer experience.
• Use data to prioritize. You can't be everywhere. Use performance data to identify the locations and partners falling furthest behind and concentrate your effort where it improves the customer experience most.
• Drive measurable improvement on the metrics that define a great returns experience: how fast customers are served, how reliably returns are processed, customer satisfaction, and site readiness.
• Deploy network-wide improvements. Lead the rollout of scalable programs that raise the standard across the entire Italian network, including in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and returns-processing tools , using your field insight to prioritize and adapt them for the market.
• Shape strategy from the field. Turn on-the-ground observations into recommendations that influence how EU-wide returns standards, mechanisms, and programs are designed, ensuring the field perspective is built in from the start.
• Manage performance to resolution. Follow a structured coaching and follow-up cycle for underperforming sites, and partner with the right internal teams (Business Partnerships for retail partners, the Transportation team for carriers) when issues need to be escalated to a partner's leadership.
• Build the foundation. As a founding team member, help shape how the EU field team audits, coaches, and reports, adapting proven practices from the North America team to the French market and feed your field insights into the monthly ISX reporting that informs strategy.

A day in the life

You start the week by reviewing performance data for France and identifying the partner locations and carriers falling furthest behind on the customer experience. You spend time in the field visiting a risk-weighted set of those sites, watching real customers complete returns, checking that the process is running smoothly, and coaching partner teams on the spot. Back at your desk, you're also driving the French rollout of a new signage standard and a store-supplies replenishment mechanism, using what you saw in the field to shape how they're deployed. You log your findings, build improvement plans for the sites that need them, escalate the bigger systemic issues to the right internal team, and close the week by capturing insights for the monthly ISX report and re-planning around wherever the customer experience needs you most.

About the team

Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) owns the returns journey end-to-end for Amazon, everything that happens after a customer decides to send something back until delivery at our FC. Our purpose is simple but hard: make returns effortless and reliable for every customer, while running one of the largest, most complex reverse-logistics networks in retail.

Within RLS, the In-Store Experience (ISX) team focuses on where returns meet the real world, the thousands of partner and carrier locations customers walk into to drop off an item. We turn a single promise into a consistent reality across every one of them: fast, easy, dependable returns, no matter which door a customer chooses. Working from the field, we close the gap between the best and worst locations, coach partners to a standard customers can count on, and build the mechanisms that lift the whole network at once.

Our culture is hands-on, data-driven, and high-ownership. We obsess over the customer, thrive in ambiguity, dive deep into the details on the ground, and think big about how to scale what works - because the best decisions about in-store returns are made by people who've seen them happen firsthand.

jobs.title: New Product Lead, Amazon Robotics Supply Chain (m/f)
jobs.employer: Amazon External Fulfillment Services Europe SARL
jobs.description:
New Product Lead, Amazon Robotics Supply Chain
Job ID: 10538609 | Amazon External Fulfillment Services Europe SARL

Description

Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply the latest advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers' experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and guidance you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.

Our diverse teams come from all over the world to design, test and build our dynamic fleet of robots, mechatronic systems and pack automation solutions. Having our offices, labs, test floors and factories all co-located means that we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build and watch it all come to life. This allows us to innovate quickly and on limitless ideas. Current advancements are underway in autonomous movement and mobility, artificial intelligence and machine learning, manipulation, simulation, robotic management software, predictive analytics, and much more.

We are seeking Robotics Supply Chain New Product Lead - Tech tackle to most critical, technologically advanced products at Amazon. The Lead will be responsible for a small portfolio of robotic products and accountable for supplier and supply chain strategies, product cost roadmaps, enabling rapid NPI builds, and ensuring a successful ramp to mass production. They manage their products from concept, through development, to scaled deployment. They work with senior product and engineering leaders to drive appropriate trade-offs between commercial vs. technical constraints, risks and goals. Within the robotic product they lead, they must be able to drive the multiple advanced technologies and commodities, driving a clear path to production.

Essential to the role is a level of technical subject matter expertise to work effectively with the technical teams developing these robotic products. While it varies by group, this expertise includes an understanding of the technologies and architectures of the robotic products and key commodities that make up the robotic products, including the technology's development and integration strategy and trajectory, both within Amazon and its wider position in the business and industry. This role will contribute to technical strategies and decisions, with contributions that balance technical and business requirements, to help drive engineering teams toward scalable products that achieve Amazon's cost targets.

Alternate Job location - ANR10 (Hamme) can be considered for this role

Key job responsibilities

The RSC New Product Lead - Tech is a trusted subject matter expert, consulted by teams above and below. They clearly communicate with direct and indirect stakeholders, advocating for commercial opportunities at the Director level and above. They contribute to strategic documents for aligning goals with cross-functional teams, own reporting on forecasting and planning the business impact of each opportunity, and regularly report on the status and impact of their contributions. Their impact is measurable via quantifiable metrics, and they have the ability to deeply influence measurable business outcomes.

- Lead Product Development Process working cross-functional supply chain team dedicated to the supplier, supply chain design, sourcing, logistics decisions, and supply chain execution for robotics products from concept, through development, to scaled deployment.
- Act as single point of contact for program resources (leadership and working teams) to communicate Supply Chain decisions and progress, provide feedback on supply chain implications of program decisions and changes, and support financial planning and capital approvals for the program.
- Work with Robotics leadership to ensure partnership between Robotics Supply Chain, hardware engineering, operations and program teams on commodity and supplier selection, cost performance tradeoff analysis, cost road map development and execution, and enabling rapid product development stages, and delivering an effective path to scaled deployment.
- Responsible for definition and approval of the Product level Supply Chain Strategy documents, including identification of critical components and suppliers, product cost roadmap to meet payback targets, definition of capacity plan and associated sourcing and tooling requirements, supply chain risk assessment & mitigation plans.
- Work with sourcing in developing negotiation strategies for categories which impacts the product to deliver against business objectives and achieve sustainable relationships with strategic suppliers pertaining to Amazon Robotics products supporting the priority programs as driven by the Operating Plan (OP)
- Work with GCMs on managing overall supplier relationships including supplier performance, capability development, capacity planning, contracting, risk mitigation, and cost and quality improvements.
- Develop roadmap to achieving total cost targets (TCO), including make vs. buy analysis and value engineering opportunities
- Ensure non-cost goals (Sustainability, Supplier Development, Cost Savings) are met and supported by the product specific supply chain strategy.
- Travel internationally across Europe for around 20-25% of the time.

A day in the life

The NPI STL orchestrates new product introduction across Amazon Robotics' supply chain.
A typical day involves leading PDP gate reviews, aligning DfX requirements with engineering teams, and driving supply chain readiness for hardware programs. Internal stakeholders include mechanical/electrical engineers, sourcing managers, manufacturing partners, and program managers. Customers are the robotics product lines launching new systems. The role solves problems at the intersection of design and supply — ensuring parts are sourceable, manufacturable, and available on time. Expect cross-functional stand-ups, supplier escalations, regionalization strategy sessions, and risk reviews tracking critical path components to production milestones.

About the team

The Amazon Robotics Supply Chain team provides strategic sourcing for a portfolio of robotic technologies and is responsible for delivering new products by enabling the right suppliers and technologies, and getting the right materials at the right cost to the right place at the right time to support our network of global fulfillment and transportation solutions. It is a fast-paced operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon and is driven by data and metrics.

The NPI Supply Chain Product Management team develops supply chain strategies for new Fulfillment Tech and Robotics products from concept to general availability. As the central integration point between technical, commercial, and operational teams, we drive PDP adherence and comprehensive supplier readiness oversight. Our vision establishes scalable, cost-effective solutions leveraging AI-driven insights to exceed performance targets. Our mission encompasses end-to-end strategy development through data-driven decisions, comprehensive make-vs-buy frameworks, regional manufacturing strategies, and cross-functional integration with partner ops teams. We maintain accountability for product cost targets, supplier readiness metrics, and program milestones while optimizing total landed cost and operational efficiency across FTR's portfolio.

Regulatory reporting product manager (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

Clearstream Fund Services is seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the development and delivery of regulatory reporting solutions within the fund industry. The role focuses on key regulations such as PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, and the production of factsheets. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between business and technology, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and timely delivery of data products that meet regulatory requirements.
This position requires detailed domain knowledge of the funds industry and the associated regulatory regimes, strong ability to work autonomously, a good understanding of how managed services operate, fast-decision-making skills, a thinking-outside-the-box approach and strong stakeholder management skills.

Your responsibilities:

• Own the product lifecycle for chosen regulatory reporting solutions: from identifying opportunities, gathering requirements, and writing specifications for IT development, to deployment and operational readiness as a managed service.
• Ensure compliance and accuracy: translate regulatory obligations placed on our clients (e.g. PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD) into clear product requirements and maintain alignment with evolving rules.
• Bridge between business and IT: facilitate communication between clients, sales, operations, and technical teams to ensure shared understanding of goals and value to be created by our services.
• Enable technical delivery: collaborate with analysts, architects, and developers to design and implement robust data models and reporting solutions.
• Deliver full-stack reporting products: oversee both back-end processes (data ingestion, modeling) and front-end outputs (factsheets, disclosures, dashboards).
• Drive Agile practices: manage backlog, prioritize tasks based on regulatory deadlines and business needs, and contribute to sprint planning and iterative delivery.
• Document and communicate: produce clear requirements, user stories, and presentations of released solutions, and manage proactive communication with management.
• Act autonomously: make informed decisions, manage priorities, and ensure timely delivery without constant supervision.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field.
• 3-6 years of experience in the funds industry, with strong exposure to regulatory reporting regimes (e,g, PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD).

jobs.description:
This role is for one of our clients

Compensation: $50 - $150 per hour

We're partnering with a leading AI research lab to build next-generation text-to-speech (TTS) systems capable of producing natural, expressive, and human-like voices. We are seeking Switzerland-based native Swiss German speakers to contribute high-quality voice recordings for training and evaluating cutting-edge speech models. This role is open to both experienced voice professionals and newcomers with a naturally clear, expressive voice and a good recording setup — prior voice-acting experience is a plus but not required.

This is an ongoing opening — we onboard new voices on a rolling basis, so applications are always welcome. The engagement itself is a single recording session of approximately 4 hours. A second session of similar length may follow depending on the client's needs, though this isn't guaranteed.

Your voice recordings will be used exclusively for the client's internal CX AI Agent. They will not be sold, licensed, or reused for any other product, dataset, or purpose.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Record high-quality voice samples across diverse scripts (conversational, narrative, instructional, etc.)
  • Deliver clear, natural, and expressive speech with strong control over tone, pacing, and pronunciation
  • Maintain consistency in voice, accent, and delivery across recording sessions
  • Follow detailed recording guidelines (environment, microphone setup, file formatting)
  • Perform multiple takes with variation in emotion, emphasis, and style when required

Requirements

  • Native Swiss German speaker currently based in Switzerland
  • A clear, natural, and expressive voice (prior voice acting, narration, or broadcast experience is a plus, not required)
  • Access to a professional or near-professional recording setup (quality microphone, quiet environment, pop filter, etc.)
  • Strong command of intonation, diction, and emotional range
  • Ability to follow scripts precisely while maintaining natural delivery
  • Availability for a single ~4-hour recording session, with the possibility of a further session of similar length later on
  • [IMP]: Your voice may be cloned for the client's CX AI Agent so please only apply if you are okay with voice cloning. Your recordings will not be sold or reused outside of this specific use case.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recording for TTS, audiobooks, IVR systems, or AI voice datasets
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition, Reaper)
  • Ability to deliver multiple vocal styles (e.g., conversational, corporate, energetic, calm)
