jobs.title: Flytta till Barcelona i vinter!
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av mobila bredbandsabonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

The main knowledge, skills and experience required of the Electrical Engineer are outlined as follows: Level 7/8 Degree in Electrical Engineering. Minimum of 3 years’ experience, preferably in the Water & Wastewater sector. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills Excellent planning, organisational, training, teamwork, problem resolution and presentation skills Excellent literacy, numeric and IT skills including proficiency in Microsoft Office and Autodesk packages Working knowledge of PLC’s (programming not required) and Variable Speed Drives / motor starters, valve actuators and instrumentation in general. Working knowledge of Trimble ProDesign (Amtech)or ETAP calculation software would be an advantage. Experience in a pharmaceutical environment and or food grade manufacturing environment would be an advantage. Full Clean driving licence. Work collaboratively with other engineering disciplines in Process, Mechanical, Control & Automation, Civil and Structural to ensure an optimum design solution is reached. Reporting to the Electrical Department Manager, design works include the compilation and review of Site surveys and condition reports as required. M&I Listings. Electrical load balances, MIC load calculations. Medium Voltage design. Generator design and sizing for back-up applications. General electrical services design. Lighting and emergency lighting designs. Earthing and Lightning protection designs Cable sizing/cable schedules. Review I/O of listings. Review of control panel drawings schematics. jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications

You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.

You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

Access to continuous learning and development through a dedicated learning platform.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an experienced Go-To-Market (GTM) Recruiter in Tokyo to partner closely with our Japan leadership team to attract, engage, and close top talent from an array of backgrounds. In this role, you’ll help build our Japan organization in a high-ownership, high-growth environment. We will look to you to advise and consult with hiring managers and interviewers, proactively source and engage future Notinos, and design a rigorous hiring processes while ensuring a delightful candidate experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the Japan recruiting process for GTM roles, primarily for Solutions Consultants (direct sales) and other GTM roles.

 - Operate autonomously across the end-to-end cycle, from direct sourcing and screening through close, while ensuring a thoughtful candidate experience at every step.

 - Run role kick-off meetings, define profiles, and align interview plans and scorecards to drive consistent, high-quality decisions.

 - Utilize internal hiring metrics and external market data to proactively propose recommendations and solutions to leaders.

 - Drive our diversity and inclusion strategy forward, with a heavy emphasis on sourcing and maintaining a well-balanced and diverse top-of-funnel candidate slate.

 - Build and nurture future talent pipelines for priority Japan GTM roles.

 - Establish trusted partnerships with the Japan leadership team to ensure Notion hires the right talent at the right time to achieve the company’s ambitious goals.

 - Ensure scalable, structured hiring plans for all roles with a strong sense of urgency and agency, while building repeatable processes and creative solutions that help the recruiting team scale for years to come.

 - Inspire candidates throughout all stages of the interview process, and build a customized close for each candidate.

 - Collaborate closely with peers and cross-functional partners, including Recruiting Coordinators, HRBPs/People Partners, Compensation Partners, Recruiting Operations, Executive Operations Partners, and Revenue Operations.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You have at least 5 years of recruiting experience, preferably in a high-growth, in-house environment. Agency background is also welcome if you have full-cycle IT/SaaS sales hiring experience.

 - You have a track record of directly sourcing, qualifying, and closing exceptional GTM talent (e.g. Sales, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, Professional Services) based in Tokyo.

 - You can partner with, manage, and influence leadership stakeholders effectively. You have coached and guided hiring managers and interviewers through the full recruiting process.

 - You have built diverse candidate pipelines and helped hiring managers build inclusive teams.

 - You have outstanding communication and interpersonal skills in both English and Japanese (written and spoken fluency in both are required.)

 - You have a relentless focus on delivering a high-touch, high-quality recruiting experience, while respecting candidates’ and hiring managers’ time.

 - You can multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.

 - You’re a team player with an optimistic attitude, and you’re comfortable wearing many hats in a smaller organization.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have owned the end-to-end hiring process at global SaaS companies.

 - You have managed roles and candidates across regions outside of Japan.

 - You’re a Notion power user!




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Model Capabilities
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has been at the cutting edge of AI since before ChatGPT launched. The job of the Model Capabilities team is to keep us there. We own the model layer of Notion AI: integrating frontier models as they ship, keeping inference reliable and economical at scale, and building new capabilities that other teams take advantage of.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Bring new frontier models into production quickly, making them available for our users and our engineers.

 - Make inference reliable: better error categorization, self-healing retries, and cross-provider failover.

 - Own observability for the model layer, driving down both time to detection and time to fix.

 - Build new model-level capabilities and help product teams adopt them.

 - Act as connective tissue across Notion's AI teams: find the gaps, unblock people, and make sure fixes land with the right owner.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Comfort with a moving frontier: The model landscape changes monthly. You keep up with it, form your own view of what's real, and stay pragmatic about what's worth adopting now.

 - AI fluency as a practitioner: You use AI tools seriously in your own work and have opinions about where they help and where they don't.

 - Production AI systems experience: You've built and operated systems on top of LLM APIs, not just prototyped with them. You understand token economics, streaming, tool calling, context limits, and how each of these fails in production.

 - Measurement before conviction: You don't ship a prompt or model change on vibes. You define what "better" means, build or use the evaluation to test it, and are willing to be proven wrong by your own data.

 - Cost and performance instincts: You treat latency and dollars as product qualities, not afterthoughts, and you can reason about the tradeoff between them and output quality.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $255,000 – $300,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role - Are you ready for a challenge?

The Information Security Officer is responsible for the day-to-day infosec tasks, including in relation to risk management, infosec governance, internal and external audit support, access management and monitoring and reporting of infosec events and incidents.

This role is part of our Information Security Department and will be reporting to an Information Security Manager.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

• Undertake internal security assessments and facilitate the creation of action plans with key business units;
• Perform information security operational tasks and day to day follow up of actions with the overall objective of ensuring the operational effectiveness of existing security controls, improve the overall control environment and reduce risk exposure;
• Assist with the review and maintenance of existing Information Security controls and the design of new ones in line with evolving business, security or legal/regulatory requirements;
• Actively follow-up access rights entitlement reviews and request validations;
• Develop and maintain relationships with business units, to emphasise and promote the importance of Information security, risk and governance management;
• Work with internal and external auditors in relation to information security audits;
• Conduct risk assessment activities and execute risk treatment plans;
• Analyse and support the remediation of information security incidents;

Your profile - Have you got what it takes to become our Information Security Officer?

• Studies or initial experience in a combination of risk management, information security, and IT roles;
• At least 4-5 years of experience in Information Security or IT Security;
• Technical background in the field of security technologies and architectures;
• Knowledge of technological trends and developments in the area of IT and Information Security;
• Good communicator, ownership, problem-solving, solution oriented, service oriented, ability to adapt to a fast-paced environment, team work;
• Understanding of risk assessment and audit processes and techniques, specifically within the domain of financial information security;
• Basic knowledge of network and application security, as well as authentication, identity management and penetration testing technologies;
• Experience with DLP, NAC, SIEM, PAM and intrusion detection software;
• Understanding of advanced security protocols and standards;
• Understanding of software and security architectures and principles of secure network design;
• Have good understanding of anti-virus software, firewalls and similar products;
• Knowledge of generic software development lifecycle processes;
• Fluent English is a must. Any other European language would be considered as an asset.
• Professional certification, such as a CISSP, CISM, CISA or other information security credentials, is an asset;
• Working knowledge of security and control frameworks, such as ISO 27001, CobiT, COSO and ITIL.

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: VODITELJ/ICA PRODAJNOG PODRUČJA - AREA MANAGER
jobs.description:
ZIEGLER je proizvođač vatrogasnih vozila i opreme s tradicijom duljom od 130 godina. ZIEGLER Grupa zapošljava više od 1.200 djelatnika diljem svijeta, posluje na 9 proizvodnih lokacija te godišnje proizvede više od 900 vozila. Dio je velike globalne grupacije CIMC, vodećeg svjetskog dobavljača logističke i energetske opreme. ZIEGLER d.o.o. posluje u Hrvatskoj od 2000. godine te djeluje na dvije proizvodne lokacije – u Zagrebu i Kutini. Zbog razvoja našeg tima i daljnjeg širenja prisutnosti na tržištu tražimo: VODITELJA/ICU PRODAJNOG PODRUČJA – 1 izvršitelj – Mjesto rada: Zagreb ili Kutina Idealan kandidat:

  • VŠS ili VSS ekonomskog, poslovnog, tehničkog ili srodnog usmjerenja
  • Najmanje 1 godina iskustva u prodaji, razvoju poslovanja ili upravljanju ključnim kupcima
  • Izražene komunikacijske, pregovaračke i interpersonalne vještine
  • Dokazan pristup usmjeren na kupca, uz fokus na ostvarivanje prodajnih ciljeva i poslovnih rezultata
  • Aktivno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu (minimalno B2 razina)
  • Organizirana, proaktivna i rezultatski usmjerena osoba
  • Spremnost na putovanja unutar dodijeljene regije
  • Interes za automobilsku i vatrogasnu industriju
Prednost imaju kandidati koji imaju:
  • Iskustvo u prodaji u automobilskoj, vatrogasnoj ili srodnoj industriji
  • Poznavanje postupaka javne nabave i natječajne dokumentacije
  • Iskustvo rada u ERP sustavima
  • Poznavanje dodatnih regionalnih jezika
Opis poslova:
  • Razvijanje i održavanje poslovnih odnosa s postojećim i potencijalnim kupcima na dodijeljenom području
  • Prepoznavanje novih poslovnih prilika i aktivno širenje tržišne prisutnosti tvrtke
  • Upravljanje cjelokupnim prodajnim procesom – od prvog kontakta s kupcem do sklapanja ugovora
  • Izrada komercijalnih ponuda, ponuda za natječaje i druge dokumentacije u suradnji s internim odjelima
  • Sudjelovanje u postupcima javne nabave te koordinacija pripreme natječajnih ponuda
  • Posjeti kupcima, održavanje prezentacija, demonstracija proizvoda i vođenje pregovora
  • Praćenje tržišnih trendova, aktivnosti konkurencije i potreba kupaca te redovito izvještavanje uprave
  • Ostvarivanje dogovorenih prodajnih ciljeva i doprinos rastu poslovanja tvrtke
  • Izrada prodajnih izvještaja, prognoza i ostale povezane dokumentacije
  • Predstavljanje tvrtke na stručnim događanjima, sajmovima i konferencijama
Nudimo:
  • Rad u dinamičnom međunarodnom okruženju
  • Priliku za rad u rastućoj industriji
  • Profesionalni razvoj uz podršku iskusnog tima
  • Ugovor o radu na određeno vrijeme uz mogućnost zaposlenja na neodređeno vrijeme

Ako ste zainteresirani za ovu poziciju, pošaljite svoj životopis i motivacijsko pismo na e-mail posao@ziegler.hr ili ih dostavite osobno u Odjel ljudskih resursa najkasnije do 22.10.2026. ZIEGLER is a manufacturer of firefighting vehicles and equipment with a tradition of over 130 years. The ZIEGLER Group employs more than 1,200 people worldwide, operates at 9 production locations, and produces over 900 vehicles annually. It is part of the large global CIMC group, a leading world supplier of logistics and energy equipment. ZIEGLER d.o.o. has been operating in Croatia since 2000, with two production locations – in Zagreb and Kutina. Due to the growth of our team and further expansion of our market presence, we are looking for: AREA MANAGER - 1 position - Work location: Zagreb or Kutina

Ideal candidate:

  • University or higher vocational degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field (VŠS/VSS)
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in sales, business development, or account management
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Proven customer-oriented approach with a focus on achieving sales targets and business objectives
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken (minimum B2 level)
  • Highly organized, proactive, and results-driven
  • Willingness to travel within the assigned region
  • Strong interest in the automotive and firefighting industries

Advantage:

  • Experience in Sales in the automotive, firefighting or related industry
  • Knowledge of public procurement and tender procedures
  • Experience working with ERP systems
  • Knowledge of additional regional languages

Job description:

  • Developing and maintaining business relationships with existing and potential customers within the assigned territory
  • Identifying new business opportunities and actively expanding the company's market presence
  • Managing the complete sales process, from initial customer contact to contract signing
  • Preparing commercial offers, quotations, and tender documentation in cooperation with internal departments
  • Participating in public procurement procedures and coordinating the preparation of bids
  • Conducting customer visits, presentations, product demonstrations, and negotiations
  • Monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs, and providing regular feedback to management
  • Achieving agreed sales targets and contributing to the company's growth objectives
  • Preparing sales reports, forecasts, and other related documentation
  • Representing the company at industry events, trade fairs, and professional conferences

We offer:

  • Work in dynamic international environment
  • Opportunity to work in a growing industry
  • Professional development within an experienced team
  • Fixed-term employment contract with possibility to extend to permanent duration

If you are interested in this position, please send your CV and Cover letter via e-mail to posao@ziegler.hr or submit to HR in person until 22.10.2026.

jobs.title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
jobs.description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

jobs.title: Mecánico / Service Technician - Relocation - Northen Europe
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Join Tesla: Bring Your Skills to Northern Europe

Do you want to help build a world of amazing abundance? At Tesla, that’s our mission.

We’ve created one of the most innovative vehicles ever made and as a Service Technician, you’ll help deliver an equally groundbreaking service experience to our customers.

Are you ready to take on the challenge and make a real impact in one of the world’s most sustainable and tech-forward regions? We have open roles across Northen Europe.

Why Move to Northen Europe? 

Relocating to Europe isn’t just a career move, it’s a life upgrade. Here’s what you gain:

  • Top-Tier Quality of Life: Consistently ranked among the happiest and safest countries in the world, clean air, green spaces, and safe cities.

  • Sustainable Living: Live in a country where EVs are the norm, public transport is excellent, and sustainability is woven into daily life.

  • Strong Tech & Innovation Ecosystems: Work at the heart of Europe’s clean energy and tech revolution, with access to cutting-edge tools, R&D and global collaboration.

What You’ll Do

Your Role: Service Technician at Tesla

  • Service, repair and improve: Use Tesla-specific software and advanced diagnostic tools to maintain and repair all Tesla vehicles.

  • Ensure top quality: Fix it right the first time. You’ll inspect vehicles with care before return and pre-delivery, because excellence is non-negotiable.

  • Collaborate ,across teams: Work with local and regional colleagues to share knowledge, solve complex issues, and continuously improve the service experience.

  • Grow with us: Access ongoing training, hands-on workshops, and a blended learning program to develop your technical and leadership skills. Your expertise helps shape the future of Tesla service.

What You’ll Bring

 We’re Looking For:

  • Technically experienced: Proven background in vehicle service, repair, or maintenance - automotive, aviation, marine, or industrial.

  • Team player: You thrive in diverse, collaborative environments and value shared success.

  • Flexible & adaptable: Comfortable working in shifts and across time zones to support global operations.

  • Clear communicator: Fluent in English (written and spoken), with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and respectfully.

  • Safe to drive: Valid driver’s license required (for test drives and vehicle handling).

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • A workplace that values you: Safe, clean, innovative, and fun, where your voice matters and your growth is prioritized.

This Is More Than a Job. It’s a Move to the Future.

If you're a skilled technician ready to bring your expertise to a place where sustainability, innovation, and quality of life go hand in hand, apply now.

Join Tesla. Build the future. Live the future.

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any factor, including veteran status and disability status, protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

For quick access to screen reading technology compatible with this site click here to download a free compatible screen reader (free step by step tutorial can be found here). Please contact ADA@tesla.com for ADA related questions or to request ADA accommodations.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice .

jobs.title: Job på Malta - Administrativ kundeservice - Book en samtale i dag!
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en Customer Support Representative?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

jobs.title: Support Engineer I (NYC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC (SoHo) office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)



Want to learn more about what we are up to?

 - Self-driving Company https://replit.com/blog/self-driving-company

 - Replit Agent at Scale https://replit.com/blog/evaluating-and-improving-agent-at-scale

 - AI Adoption https://replit.com/blog/ai-adoption

 - Build Open-Source Apps https://replit.com/build/open-source-app-builder
   
    

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

 - Operating Principles https://blog.replit.com/operating-principles

 - Reasons not to work at Replit https://blog.replit.com/reasons-not-to-join-replit



To achieve our mission of making programming more accessible around the world, we need our team to be representative of the world. We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non-traditional backgrounds.

Location: Copenhagen (Blågårds Plads / Tagensvej)

Pay: 175 – 185 DKK / hour (based on experience)
Start Date: As soon as possible

About Diamond Slice

Diamond Slice serves New York-style sourdough pizza by the slice in Copenhagen from our locations at Blågårds Plads and Tagensvej. We combine traditional American slice shop recipes with quality ingredients, cold-fermented dough, and high-heat deck ovens. We run busy counter, dine-in, and delivery services, and we are actively building for future growth.

The Role

As Kitchen Manager, you are responsible for the day-to-day operations of the kitchen. You make sure food quality is consistent across all orders, keep kitchen systems clean and compliant, and guide the kitchen team in close coordination with our front of house (FOH) staff.

  • Daily kitchen operations, including prep, baking, and ongoing quality control

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in the hospitality industry

  • Experience with pizza OR experience with management is required (experience managing a pizza kitchen is a strong advantage)

  • Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills

  • Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours

  • Comfortable working full shifts on your feet

  • Ready and available to work evening and weekend shifts

  • Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus)

What We Offer

  • Hourly wage of 175 – 185 DKK/hour based on experience

  • Training and technical skills in producing world-class New York-style pizza

  • A hardworking but friendly and supportive atmosphere

  • A growing company with opportunities to take on more responsibility and higher pay over time

  • A flexible schedule

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter to:
Email: work@diamondslice.dk
Subject line: Kitchen Manager
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING

Rolling and longitudinal seam welding

About the position

We are looking for a reliable and motivated Production Operator to join our production team. You will work with rolling of metal components and operation of an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine. You do not need to be a qualified welder or have a formal vocational education. The most important things are a good technical understanding, a willingness to learn, attention to quality and the ability to work safely and responsibly.

Your main responsibilities

Ø  Operate rolling machines and production equipment.

Ø  Operate and monitor an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine.

Ø  Set up and make minor adjustments to machines and equipment.

Ø  Monitor the production process and ensure stable production.

Ø  Carry out basic dimensional and visual quality checks.

Ø  Identify deviations and report problems to the team leader or supervisor.

Ø  Keep your workplace clean, organized and safe.

Ø  Follow company procedures for quality, safety and production.

What we are looking for

You do not need to be formally trained as a welder or have a vocational qualification. We are looking for someone who:

Ø  Has experience from manufacturing, metalworking, machine operation or a similar production environment – experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Ø  Has a good technical understanding and enjoys working with machines.

Ø  Is practical, reliable and willing to learn.

Ø  Can work independently but also contributes positively to the team.

Ø  Has a strong focus on quality and safety.

Ø  Can understand basic instructions, measurements and simple technical information.

Ø  Is able to communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Training and introduction

Full training will be provided. You will receive a structured introduction to the machines, production processes, quality requirements and safety procedures. Previous experience with automatic welding or rolling is therefore not essential.

What we offer

A stable position in a modern production environment.

Thorough training and support from experienced colleagues.

A practical and varied working day.

A workplace where safety, quality and teamwork are important.

Good opportunities to develop your technical skills and take on more responsibility over time.

Competitive salary and employment conditions according to qualifications and experience.

You will become part of a team where we value cooperation, respect and a good working atmosphere. We believe that good production results are created by people who work together, help each other and take responsibility for their work.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

jobs.title: Senior Tax Accountant
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Tax team is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Tax Accountant to support our global tax operations. In this role, you’ll run global indirect tax operations and strengthen the systems behind them. As Notion scales across products and jurisdictions, this role exists to make compliance, close, audits, and tax data more accurate, scalable, and audit-ready. You’ll own recurring sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business tax, registrations, notices, reconciliations, and related controls, while building exposure to income tax compliance and reporting. The work is hands-on and cross-functional: you’ll trace differences across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger with Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience partners.

 

This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take ownership of recurring U.S. and global indirect-tax filings, calendars, data packages, notices, registrations, and close support—with accurate, review-ready work.

 - Establish a reliable reconciliation and exception workflow across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger, escalating issues clearly and early.

 - Use AI-enabled workflows and data tools to investigate variances, quality-check work papers, and improve documentation while preserving human review and controls.

 - Make tax operations more scalable and audit-ready by strengthening controls, process documentation, evidence, handoffs, audit support, and SOX walkthrough readiness.

 - Become a trusted partner to Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience—and contribute to income tax compliance and reporting with guidance from experienced teammates.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - At least 3 years of public accounting and/or industry tax experience, with a primary focus on indirect tax compliance and operations.

 - Hands-on experience with indirect tax compliance or operations, especially U.S. sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business taxes, or other non-income-based taxes; this is the foundation for owning Notion’s recurring global work.

 - Experience preparing accurate reconciliations, journal entries, filings, payments, and audit-ready work papers, with the ability to connect activity across source systems and the general ledger.

 - Strong operational judgment: you manage recurring deadlines, investigate exceptions, keep documentation organized, escalate issues promptly, and drive assigned work through completion.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with a collaborative approach to working across Finance, Accounting, business teams, and external advisors.

 - Curiosity and learning agility, including willingness to build income-tax capability and demonstrated AI fluency—using AI to analyze data, investigate variances, improve documentation, perform quality checks, or automate repeatable workflows while validating outputs and protecting sensitive information.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $135,000 - $155,000 per year.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting (m/f)
jobs.description:
Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting

Role Overview

Within the Fund Administration department, the Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing a portfolio of complex and high‑profile fund structures, ensuring high‑quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, and timely reporting.

The role combines technical expertise, team leadership, and client ownership. The Assistant Manager acts as a key escalation point for both clients and internal teams and supports the Manager in driving operational excellence, risk management, and process improvement.

Tasks

Client & Delivery Ownership

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of sophisticated clients (Private Equity, Private Debt, Evergreen structures, Hybrid structures, Open-ended structures).
• Assume end‑to‑end responsibility for service delivery, ensuring compliance with SLAs, fund documentation, and regulatory requirements.
• Manage client expectations proactively and handle escalations independently before involving the Manager where required.
Build and maintain trusted, long‑term client relationships, participating in client meetings, onboarding calls, and post‑audit reviews.

Onboarding

During client onboarding, the Assistant Manager undertakes several crucial tasks to ensure a smooth transition and establish a productive relationship with the new client. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Lead or actively support client onboardings, restructurings, migrations, and system set‑ups.
• Validate fund structures, valuation methodologies, fee models, and reporting frameworks in line with legal documents.
• Coordinate across internal teams (FA, TA, back office, Corporate, AIFM, Risk & Compliance, IT etc) to ensure seamless implementation.
• Review and sign‑off data migration and initial NAVs.

NAV Oversight & Technical Review

During Net Asset Value (NAV) oversight, the Assistant Manager play a critical role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and smooth operations. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Assume overall accountability for the NAV oversight framework across the assigned client portfolio, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and compliance with fund documentation, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee the end‑to‑end NAV production cycle, including capital activity, income recognition, valuation inputs, investor allocations, and fee calculations.
• Perform in‑depth technical reviews and approvals of complex NAVs, including:

o Private equity, private debt, evergreen funds, and multi‑compartment structures
o Complex instruments (loans, profit‑participating notes, derivatives, look‑through investments)
o FX treatments, waterfalls, and performance fee mechanisms
• Act as a technical reference point on Lux GAAP, IFRS, consolidation and structure‑specific treatments.

• Ensure all NAV‑related deliverables meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal quality standards.
• Maintain strong documentation standards, including working papers, reconciliation files, and management review evidence, to support both internal controls and external audit requirements.
• Support the preparation of financial statements inputs by ensuring consistency between NAVs, accounting records, and statutory reporting.

Risk Management, Controls & Audit

• Act as a key control owner for the assigned client portfolio, ensuring that fund accounting activities are performed in line with internal policies, ISAE requirements, regulatory obligations, and client documentation.
• Ensure that appropriate preventive and detective controls are in place, operating effectively, and evidenced.
• Review and challenge unusual transactions, valuation judgments, late data, or deviations from standard processes.
• Act as the primary escalation point for NAV issues, breaches, or errors, ensuring timely resolution, root‑cause analysis, and clear documentation.
• Act as the primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit queries and timelines.
• Support the Manager in maintaining a strong control culture across the team and client portfolio.

Team Leadership & People Management

• Provide day‑to‑day supervision of Senior Fund Accountants and Fund Accountants within the team.
• Allocate work effectively, taking into account complexity, risk and deadlines.
• Review deliverables prepared by the team and provide structured feedback.
• Support training, development, and performance management of team members.
• Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and quality.
• Escalate capacity, performance, or quality concerns to the Manager with proposed solutions.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Continuously assess existing fund accounting and reporting processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Actively contribute to system enhancements, automation, and standardisation.
• Support the Manager in implementing new operating models, tools, and best practices.
• Encourage a culture of continuous improvement and risk awareness

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
• ACCA (or equivalent) – qualified or advanced stage preferred
• Strong knowledge of Lux GAAP and IFRS (including consolidation)
• 8+ years of experience in fund administration, primarily for closed-ended funds, open-ended funds and evergreen/hybrid funds, with experience in various asset classes (private equity, private debt, listed loans)
• Prior experience reviewing NAVs and supervising team members is essential.
• Experience in capital hedging and portfolio management.
• Added value for candidates familiar with public loans managed through Allvue or WSO platforms.
• Languages: English fluent; French and/or German is an advantage.
• Additional advantage for candidates with experience using Paxus.

Skills/Behavior

In addition to demonstrating IQEQ's Group Values (Authentic, Bold, Collaborative), the Assistant Manager is expected to:

• Take ownership and accountability
• Demonstrate sound judgement and risk awareness
• Lead and develop others
